For those of you or should I say us who really got into Kate Beckinsales azz-kicking gory days in Underworld, heres your chance for more of the same. Even though three years have passed in our time, Evolution takes up right where the first movie ended, but thanks to the magic of flashbacks we get some more background info on the blood feud and how it all began.Way, way back, Alexander Corvinus had two sons, Marcus Tony Curran and William. The first was bitten by a bat and became a Death Dealer with the fangs to prove it, and the second was bitten by a wolf to become the forefather and prototype for the Lycans who get all furry and howl at the sight of a full moon. William however, was unable to control his blood lust, and made quite a nuisance of himself, until he was hunted down and locked away forever, much to Marcuss dismay and anger. Having been double crossed by Viktor Bill Nighy, Marcus is out for revenge, and of course for blood.Back to present day, the war between Vampire and Lycan continues, and Marcus is awakened with some new tricks up his wings and a burning desire to set William free. Standing in his way is Selene, the hottest vampire action heroine in recent movie history Beckinsale naturally and her trusty sidekick Michael the hybrid Scott Speedman. Between them they unknowingly hold the key and the map to Williams prison, and soon find themselves in Marcuss sights.In between the fighting and hiding from the sun and such activities, the two leading characters manage to squeeze in a little nookie time, which of course provides some eye-candy for us the viewers with its strategic placement between all the carnage. The story line is a bit confusing if you havent been making notes, and dont ever ask Selene her age, but as far as action, CGI and drama goes, this one is a non-stop thrill. Recommended for vampire lovers and blood suckers everywhere.Amanda Richards, July 5, 2006

To understand and appreciate this movie youll need a little background information. First of all, its not one story, but a combination of three stories from the graphic novels of the same name, with a short clip from another story as an introduction.The introductory skit, starring Josh Hartnett and Marley Shelton, is from The Customer is Always Right, the others being The Hard Goodbye, The Big Fat Kill and That Yellow Bastard.Shot in a way that is as close to the original comics as possible, the movie is in black and white, except for certain highlighted objects in the frames that are vividly colored in stark contrast. Without significant amounts of nudity, it earns its rating because of the violence which is central to the plots, and boy, does that white blood flow and fly.The movie smells of Tarantino, but he only directs one small, and of course totally weird, bit, the majority being done by Robert Rodriguez, and Frank Miller, author of the novels.Each segment is illuminated by star power such as Jessica Alba Nancy, Rosario Dawson great as Gail, Benicio Del Toro outstanding as Jackie Boy, Michael Clark Duncan Manute, Carla Gugino Lucille, Rutger Hauer Cardinal Roark, Jaime King GoldieWendy, Michael Madsen brilliant as Bob, Brittany Murphy Shellie, Clive Owen Dwight, Mickey Rourke brilliant as Marv, Elijah Wood creepy as Kevin and not forgetting Bruce Willis Hartigan, in one of his best performances ever. I also liked Devon Aoki as Miho whose role brought back memories of Kill Bill and the Crazy 88.Without knowing the source, the movie would be a bit confusing, as characters can be seen appearing in all three stories, and after a while, some of the female stars start looking alike. Theres nothing light about this movie, and it may not be for everybody, but the action keeps coming and the blood keeps pumping, and its hard to look away.Amanda Richards, September 24, 2005

Five stars for one of the best movies Ive seen this year. Beautifully orchestrated, acted and performed, this movie version does the theatrical masterpiece proud.Gerard Butler is so handsome and yet so intense in his portrayal of the tormented Phantom that if I were Christine the excellent Emmy Rossum, that Raoul guy vocally gifted Patrick Wilson would have had to drag me out of that underground boudoir with wild horses and a bulldozer.Wilson seemed like a teenager in love compared to the agonized yearning of the Phantom, and in a different musical he would have been hopping around a gazebo in the rain singing Sixteen Going on Seventeen.Minnie Driver does a fine comedy turn as Prima Donna Carlotta, and although she doesnt actually sing in the movie, she does a credit worthy number during the credits. Miranda Richardson is perfectly cast as Madame Giry, longtime keeper of the Phantoms secret. Rossum is also a casting coup, and the doe-eyed Jennifer Beal look-a-like fully captures the essence of Christine, the Phantom perpetual flava-of-the-month.The movie had me spellbound from Act one, Scene one until the closing credits, and I highly recommend it to you.Amanda Richards, September 12, 2005

This is one of the most entertaining comedies I have seen in a long time. I started smiling from the start up tune Happy Together by the Turtles and didnt stop until long after Simple Plan finished their version at the end.Jamie Lee Curtis is absolutely brilliant as Tess Coleman, a harried psychiatrist with two children, about to remarry after the death of her husband. Lindsay Lohan plays her daughter Anna, a rebellious teenager who cant see eye to eye with her mother.Comparing the Lindsay Lohan of this movie with the wafer thin girl she has become, it should be noted that she looked so much prettier, happier and healthier then, that I wish shed look back at this movie and go out and eat something.You already know that this is a switch movie, and thanks to Lucille Soong as an interfering old woman, the switch is done with the crisp snap of a fortune cookie. Both Curtis and Lohan handle the change in their characters admirably, and soon both Tess and Anna get a first hand understanding of each others rather complicated lives.Mark Harmon has a supporting role as Tess fiancé Ryan, and Chad Michael Murray plays Annas love interest Jake, but this movie is all about the female leads as they get a new perspective, earn each others respect and generally change each other, while at the same time delivering the laughs.Tess and Anna switchFortune cookie lets them beHappy TogetherAmanda Richards, July 25, 2005

For pure entertainment value, I thought this was a great movie. Good vs. Evil, female superhero with hot red costume, villains with magical powers, martial arts action, dreamy fight scenes a la Hero and a valuable treasure to be protected.On the surface, this movie swept me away with its action sequences and special effects, but then I got to thinking, and that kind of spoiled it for me.Elektra Jennifer Garner at the beginning of the movie was the coolest thing in red ever. She was like Trinity Carrie Ann Moss from the first Matrix movie, unstoppable, inhuman, focused and deadly, plus she looked darned good in that outfit with her hair swinging around.As the story goes, suffering from a bit of burnout, she accepts one more assignment, and then suddenly has a change of heart when she receives her hit list. From here on, the writers strip away her intrigue and mystique, and it was disappointing to see a superhero suffer from OCD and insomnia, depend on an agent instead of a trusty butler, and generally get less and less super and more and more vulnerable. She doesnt even don the red body hugger again until the end of the movie.The bad guys then begin pursuing her new acquaintances, and she assumes a bodyguard role without even asking why one man and his daughter would be worth the effort. After a lot of ta-da, she ends up back at the training camp of her sensei, who although blind like all good mentors, is not an inscrutable Asian with a long moustache, but a cranky white dude named Stick Terrence Stamp.This brings us to the best part of the movie, with a group of villains with real superpowers, who of course choose to attack one by one so that the good guys can save the day. Kirigi Will Yun Lee is a real martial artist, and two-sworded leader of the bunch; Typhoid Natassia Malthe can kill with a touch, and she almost sucks the life out of Elektra with a lingering kiss; Stone Bob Sapp is like The Thing, skin like armor and built like a barn; Kinkou Edson Ribeiro comes and goes quickly, and Tattoo Chris Ackerman is by far the most magical, with body tattoos with lives of their own. These guys make the movie worth watching, and its really sad to see them go.Kirsten Prout handles herself very well as Abby Miller, the young girl that looks up to Elektra, and has a secret of her own, but Goran Visnjic doesnt have the satisfaction of a solid role to stand on.Enjoy this one for the action, but dont pause to think about the plot.On the side of goodElektra wields a mean saiTo save the treasureAmanda Richards, July 24, 2005

Right then - just finished watching this absolutely super movie, and am now going to piddle around acting rather terribly British, what? Dont get your knickers in a twist Duckie, Ill hop right to the point - I bloody LOVE this film.Loosely inspired by Pride and Prejudice, but in a way Ms. Austin never intended, what with all the shagging and all, the movie is not exactly like Ms. Fieldings book either. One of things I liked about the book was the little diary notes, which obviously couldnt be brought out the same way in the movie, and quite a few other side stories had to be scrapped as well, including the entire ending. Bridgets friends and family have had their parts drastically cut, to make way for a first class compact comedy, focused almost entirely on Bridget, Daniel loving the beaver Cleaver, and Mark Darcy.Never-the-less, like the book, the movie is a laugh out loud affair, with Renee Zellweger accurately capturing the spirit of the awkward and ditsy Bridget, Hugh Grant being the consummate cad, and Colin Firth sigh replaying an updated yet still straitlaced Darcy.Guest appearances by Salman Rushdie and Jeffrey Archer add a little literary support, and the DVD is loaded with features like deleted scenes, comments from the actors and director, as well as from Helen Fielding.My suggestion would be to read the book first, then watch the movie.Amanda Richards, June 5, 2005

Ben Stiller is a career character actor. The problem here is that he only has one character in his career, and it doesnt spread very far these days. Before you can say Feffer, Focker, Stroehmann, Tenenbaum, Zoolander quickly three times, hes off to his usual shtick of funny faces, potty humor, slapstick and embarrassing situations, and its usually up to his supporting actors to pick up the slack.Fortunately for this formulaic movie, there are some terrific supporting actors. Jennifer Aniston is great, but doesnt stray very far from her ditsy Rachel Green character; Bryan Brown overflows with testosterone; Debra Messing plays her graceless role with a good will; Philip Seymour Hoffman and Alec Baldwin are annoyingly obnoxious; and Hank Azaria lights up the movie like a full moon.In a nutshell, its boy marries girl, girl goes overboard for nude scuba diver, boy meets ditsy girl, boy does stupid and embarrassing things, boy does stupid and embarrassing things, boy does stupid and embarrassing things, boy does stupid and embarrassing things, ad infinitum.In case youre in the mood for a romantic comedy as light as a sponge cake on helium, I should warn you that they were a little low on romance when it was being made, but there was lots of helium available. Not that its an unpleasant movie, mind you, but rent it if you must. I wouldnt shell out a blind ferret for this one.Amanda Richards, May 24, 2005

The Kite Runner may be the best book I have read in recent history, and without a doubt, Hotel Rwanda wins the corresponding prize for movies. Unable to believe the senseless violence and slaughter of innocents, my eyes opened wider and wider as the movie progressed, until at some point, the tears could not be held back any longer.Don Cheadle aces a career making role as Paul Rusesabagina, the quiet, understated hotel manager of a five star hotel in Kigali, Rwanda, who breaks every rule in the management book to protect not only the hotel guests, but refugees from both sides of the genocide that rocked Rwanda in 1994, while the rest of the world looked the other way.A Hutu by birth and passport stamp, Paul is married to a Tutsi woman Sophie Okonedo, whose voice changes drastically in octave as the role demands, and by this distinction, his children are also Tutsi, and therefore branded as cockroaches to be exterminated.Because of his position and well-placed contacts, Rusesabagina is able to cling tenuously to his little safe house, putting up a brave front for the 1200 people he is sheltering from the Hutu tribal forces. When he finds out that the UN peacekeepers cannot help them, and that the rest of the world doesnt want to know about African problems, he resorts to the local language, securing protection by whatever means necessary from the authorities, led by General Bizimungu, who has a weakness for Scottish water of life, foreign currency and self preservation. Being only human, and in a crisis situation, he makes crucial errors in judgment, but by his conviction he manages to hold it all together for as long as necessary.There are too many powerful scenes to describe, and you have to watch the movie to fully appreciate the horror. There are no gory images as in Saving Private Ryan or Blade, but the Director manages to effectively portray the despair and mass killings without being offensively graphic or crude. One of the most heart rending scenes takes place on a road in the early morning fog, and this is the final straw that rips through Rusesabaginas brittle façade of being in control.Joaquin Phoenix you know I have to mention him, in a small role as a cameraman sums it up best when he said Ive never been so ashamed.This one is a must see.Amanda Richards, May 23, 2005

Twist-wise this is a heckuvagreat movie. Its a steaming, down and dirty whodunnit-to-who under the guise of an army training exercise gone wrong. Connie Nielsen steals most of the movie, even though her accent grates on the nerves sometimes, but otherwise shes got what it takes. I have to confess that I dont play video games - eye-hand coordination and lightning reflexes werent included in my genetic package, so this review is based on the movie - and nothing but the movie.Other than Milla Jovovich, no cast member did any real acting. Michelle Rodriguez had a fairly difficult role to play, but the snarling and eye rolling was just too much at times. She was necessarily tough, but the dialogue also really let her down. The rest of the cast was on par for a B Grade horror movie, and only slightly more animated than the zombies.This movie is what happens when you mix too many good things in a haphazard way. Imagine trying to write a coherent script when your must list includes zombies, were-dogs, sloppy genetic mutations with long tongues, a controlling computer system, an impregnable fortress, a knockout babe with amnesia, a SWAT team, biological warfare, viruses, spies and saboteurs, a battle on a train, and guns - lots of guns.The zombie scenes failed to impress, no gore to be seen anywhere - they just looked like a typical crowd of people in the mosh pit at a rock concert. The mutating tissue-thing was straight out of a Dean Koontz book, and most of the suspense scenes werent very suspenseful, because whatever you expected to happen - did.On the cool side, you had the wicked lasers to do the slicing and dicing, Alices Milla hot red zombie-kicking slit-way-up the side dress, and the fight scenes. Many parts may seem familiar, mainly because youve seen scenes just like them in other popular action movies.Next time let Alice do some Mortal Kombat with Lara Croft and you can call it a Final Fantasy.Amanda Richards, February 22, 2005

This is a movie that I initially passed over, always finding something else to buy or borrow as I dont steal, until I happened to catch the ending on television late one night.By the next evening it was in my possession, and despite having already watched the ending, I found it to be a surprisingly enjoyable experience.Al Pacino aced his role as Walter Burke, CIA trainer extraordinaire, and hes not a guy I would ever want to play poker with, even if I did play poker.Colin Farrells performance is pretty much like his other moviesexcept maybe Alexander, but I havent seen that yet, and I hate his blonde look, but he really does a great short, dark and handsome, tortured and persecuted thing. This time hes out of the phone booth and using his cell phone, whizzing through movie-style computer gibberish as James Clayton, the star recruit of the latest batch of CIA trainees.Bridget Moynahan gives much the same performance as she does in I, Robot, playing it smart and sassy with a real cute pout, and a concerned wrinkle.Surprises and twists abound, and though you know its all faked, and nothing is what it seems, it still draws you in. This is a brutally told but compelling version of the Aileen Wuornos story. She was a deranged psycho, sure, but Charlize Therons monster performance also allowed us an insiders view into the woman and her troubled past. While there can be no excusing her actions, this movie makes it possible at least to understand why she turned to prostitution, and then ultimately to murder.Christina Ricci is also excellent as the lonely lesbian who befriends Wuornos, and inadvertently, at least at first, sparks the violence that rages within Wuornos troubled mind. As the story unfolds however, the tough hooker becomes putty-like in the hands of the disatisfied, nagging girlfriend, falling deeper and deeper into trouble, in an effort to buy happiness for their most unlikely partnership.While certainly disturbing and at times depressing, youll find yourself unable to turn away, even though you already know how this story ends.To assist the people who are watching this movie for the .ummm. Cinematic experience, your chapters are six and fifteen on the DVD, and your new favorite song is Crimson and Clover.Well performed and directed, and thoroughly deserving of all the awards that have been heaped on it.Amanda Richards, November 26, 2004

This is the perfect Christmas gift to get any member of the group of free-loading moochers you call your friends. Its the perfect excuse to have a movie night at THEIR house, and make them ante up some wine, cheese, grapes and lots of chocolate, then hunker down for an evening of cornball romantic comedy with a difference.Chances are, with Colin Firth, Hugh Grant, Liam Neeson and Alan Rickman on show, you wont even notice that the storyline is hardly Pulitzer Prize material, but you do stand the chance of busting a seam when Hugh does his FootlooseSaturday Night FeverRisky Business impression at Lot 10 Downing Street, and Bill Nighy makes like Robert Palmer for a video shoot of the worst ever chart topping Christmas song. Theres also the incomparable Rowan Atkinson, making like Mr.Bean at appropriately inopportune moments.In case you think its all about the guys it is - but one cant take sides theres a brilliant performance by Emma Thompson, and also Laura Linney, who has the worst cell phone ring tone ever invented. An essential movie for the collection of any fan of things nautical, Peter Weir and the cast deliver an unforgettable sea-faring saga, fraught with danger, and brim full of human interest.The sound effects are spectacular, especially with the benefit of surround sound. My living room reverberated to the hammering of the nine and eighteen pounders, and every creak of the masts, every flap of the sail, every sour note from Captain Aubreys violin could be clearly heard. I could almost smell the salty air, as my other senses awakened to smell, taste and touch what my eyes and ears were already experiencing. Even my sixth sense perked up for a few hours.The battle scenes are vividly enacted, and the cinematography is excellent. The scene where the ship is becalmed is hauntingly beautiful, making any further explanation superfluous.Russell Crowe portrays Capt. Jack Aubrey as a fearless, intelligent and compassionate man, stubbornly loyal and prepared to risk everything to carry out his orders. He knows every member of his crew, takes the time to teach young midshipmen naval procedure, and enjoys musical interludes with his friend Dr. Stephen Maturin Paul Bettany. However, when the opportunity arises to combat the elusive French warship Acheron, he almost loses both his ship and his friendship, and pays a bitter price for his ambition.The captain of the Acheron plagues him incessantly, outwitting, outplaying and outlasting him in battle, and Capt. Aubrey has to resort to cunning and disguise to narrow the odds and turn the tide of the battle.A well told story, but drawn out with a few overly dramatic scenes that could have been more comfortable on the cutting room floor. It also helps to know your nautical terms, which Capt. Aubrey rattles off at top speed, so if you dont know your port from your starboard or your Nautica from your Sperry, you may need an interpreter if you want to fully absorb the movie.Amanda Richards, September 28, 2004

This movie is an enjoyable introduction to Bollywood Indian movies without being one itself. Its much shorter than a Bollywood epic, and there are no choreographed music videos included as part of the story, even though theres a lot of singing and dancing.This is in fact two love stories, the more touching one involving the domestic helper Alice, and the wedding planner P. K. Dubey. Back at the main story line, Lalit Verma, convincingly played by Naseeruddin Shah, has arranged a marriage for his daughter Aditi. Its a gala affair, with everything supposed to be perfect, but is in fact way over his financial capabilities.Aditi however, has been seeing a married man, but unable to ascertain whether he will ever divorce his wife, she agrees to the arranged wedding. As the wedding date approaches, she again reaches out to her boyfriend, and it works out not to have been such a good idea after all.Unable to live with her guilty conscience, she confesses all to her intended husband, whose initial reaction is understandable, but then he proves himself to be a real nice guy by forgiving her. Reality check: This is an arranged marriage. Hes never met the bride before. Doesnt know diddly squat about her. Did he forgive her because he fell in love with her at first sight?Anyhoo, its a romantic movie, so lets agree that hes a handsome, understanding, caring, unattached, straight, really sweet guy with a heart of gold. Can we clone him?As the family gathers for the big day, cousin Ria observes some untoward behaviour patterns that she recognises, and puts the damper on an uncles fun. Lalit Verma is now faced with a huge problem, and is forced to make an important family decision, which he does superbly.As the festivities are in full swing in the pouring rain, we get a sneak peek at the guy chosen for Ria, and hes certainly breathtaking. Good luck Ria! Monsoon Wedding 2 perhaps?Colorful and cultural, the movie has its share of stereotyped Bollywood characters, but smoothly blends traditional values with modern settings. It also touches on a lot of difficult subjects, and accomplishes this without affecting the overall lightness of the movie.One I wouldnt mind seeing again.Amanda Richards, September 14, 2004

Well at least there were lots of funny noises at meal time here too.This film takes you back before the beginning of The Lion King, and neatly fills in all the gaps that you never realised existed.Timon is the Flik A Bugs Life of his community, clumsy and discontent with his lot in life, and sets off to find his dream home, where he can fit in. He meets up with Pumba, and the friendship begins.The animation is great, the original cast give an excellent performance, the jokes and puns are non-stop, and there are new songs that are very catchy.Theres a funny karaoke sing a-long where you need to keep an eye on the insect thats setting the timing, and somehow excerpts from Fiddler on the Roof, The Good The Bad and the Ugly and other themes fit right in.Brace yourself for the finale, that involves synchronised swimming, para gliding, and a huge cast of characters.The only black mark on this movie is its length, at only 77 minutes, but on the bright side, its only 77 minutes to watch over and over with your kids.This is one of Disneys better sequels. It isnt a Toy Story 2, but a far better movie than many other direct-to-video disasters weve seen. Its laugh out loud funny, but children may not get all the jokes.Worth at least 4.5 stars.Amanda Richards, September 8, 2004

I just spent a couple of hours looking at this wonderful movie and the extra features. The aptly named Masterpiece Edition is worth every penny, and like The Matrix, should be included in any movie collection, whether you have a child to hide behind or not.Beautifully adapted and animated from Lewis Carrolls highly imaginative, high-trippin classic, the imagery and illustrated puns amaze and amuse, especially the little things like the rocking-horse fly, the bread-and-butter flies, the vultures, the pencil and hammer birds, the momeraths, and the bird in the tree Queenie Leonard yelling Ser-pennnnnt !The animators drew each frame based on the portrayals by the actors voicing the parts, and the stand-outs are Kathryn Beaumont as Alice, Ed Wynn as the Mad Hatter, Verna Felton as the Queen of Hearts, Bill Thompson as the White Rabbit, and the very flexible and versatile J. Pat OMalley as Tweedle Dum, Tweedle Dee, the Walrus AND the Carpenter, in one of the best scenes in the movie.With fourteen songs, this is the most musical Disney around, but unfortunately, the songs are not very easy to sing along to, making me sound like William Hung every time I try to impress people with my thorough knowledge of the lyrics.There are lots of interesting tidbits in the extras, such as the discarded Cheshire Cat song, and the fact that one of the songs was later re-worded for Peter Pan. There are other links between Alice in Wonderland and Peter Pan, but youll have to watch the extras to find out just what, cause Im not telling.For those who dont want to watch the previews at the beginning of the DVD, just press Menu and get plugged directly into Wonderland.Amanda Richards, July 18, 2004

The good things about this DVD are:1. The animals2. The farm scenes, especially the ones that show the various methods of ploughing the fields.3. The puppet skits dont repeat the same thing over and over again.4. The Old MacDonald song5. The song set to the Farmer in the Dell tune.6. The pigs sliding into the mud puddle.7. Has some good extras and not just flash cards and toy lists.The not-so-good things about this DVD:1. Too much of the music is slow, when it should be upbeat. Why plough to a lullaby?2. Younger children like it, but its not easy adult viewing. This DVD puts me to sleep.3. Some of the content is for babies, some for toddlers, but as a whole it doesnt hold the interest over 24 months.My son is now too old for the Baby Einstein series, and its time to move on. Its been a great three years, and definitely essential viewing for children.Thank you Baby Einstein, and goodbye.

Now THIS is more like it!This DVD clearly illustrates the numbers one to five, in a clear, fun format, with music, great visuals, and logical format. The graphics are simple and uncluttered, the toys are new, and the puppets are not doing the same things over and over again.It teaches not only counting, but also reading, and this is the first time in the series that the bonus material is as good as, or better than, the main feature.The main feature runs nearly 30 minutes, exactly as stated on the box, and the bonus material doubles the fun.An essential Baby Einstein DVD to jump start your child.

Our family owns every Baby Einstein DVD in the series, and my two year old son picks out the ones he wants to watch. He has recently become interested in this one after ignoring it for a few months.I have to mark this one down a little, as it is not as well put together as earlier ones like Baby Mozart and Baby van Gogh.The footage of the animals is excellent, and very educational in helping children learn to identify neighbourhood animals as well as other animals. I have cows and horses, but no otters in my neighbourhood. The sequences with the swan and ducks in water are outstanding.I didnt like the beginning with the cow with wings, even though it was a cute puppet. My son asked me what it was, and why the cow had wings, and is now on the lookout for flying pink cows.He identifies with the naughty mice who throw food around, and advises the mommy mouse to give them a time-out.The Pavlov puppet skits between animals are too long and monotonous, and the little skits with the other puppets are sometimes confusing, like when the frog is barking, and then quacks, which makes the duck bark instead of quack. The puppetry is also a little below the usual standard.Full marks for the animals, points off for the fillers.

This DVD introduces colours in one of the most innovative ways I have seen. Each colour gets individual treatment, with videos of objects related to that colour, children wearing the colour, and best of all, an introduction to the paintings of Van Gogh.You cant ask for better in an educational tool.It would be most useful for children 1 and up, but the use of colour is so good that 7 or 8 month olds will probably also find it fascinating.Highly recommended for your childs video library.

This is one roller coaster of a movie as two adventure seeking girls climb the worlds tallest tv tower in hopes of fighting their fears and instead find themselves for their lives. My stomach jumped at the site of them climbing and yes there was special effects but, they are done in a way that it is not so fake. All this and Stephen King himself said this is one good movie.

Ive seen this movie 2x now and I liked it the 2nd as much as the first. The love story between the two characters seemed so lifelike and real full of pure emotion.I hope there will be a sequel despite what k8nd of trouble Armie Hammer has gotten himself into.

Anyone who is a throwback marvel fan knows morbius is a serious marvel anti hero never big on comedy but big on being eerie and dangerous. From his days or nights hunting good guys in the books to then only hunting evil men morbius has been around a long time. Now here he is in the flesh ad Jared Leto bring the marvel monster to life in this overlooked movie. Yes its dark and gritty and not many laughs come out of it, but what you get is a good origin and another piece of the sony-verse to add to venom and carnage and hopefully soon spiderman.Action violence and a dark tale keep the movie from getting dull.

Forget about fancy horror films with all too complicated plots that wait too long to get down to business as this film is just what your looking for. With a grainy old 70s feel, to the creepy desolate house, the weird couple in it and a group of teen to 20 somethings out in the middle of nowhere and here we go.This movie was such a throw back with its chainsaw massacre vibe but much simpler. I loved the easy plot, the sick couple and the dialogue. Definitely a good little movie.

I have been a spiderman fan for over 45 years. Ive seen the cartoons, all the movies, etc and this was by far the best of them all. Assembling all of spidermans greatest foes in one movie to take on not one but 3 spidermen was genius! The action, the suspense, the story line that was weaved together so perfectly .I just love this movie. I give it 10 spiders;

Something about this movie ever really failed to keep my attention.from the opening scene on the bus, to the beach to the end I just was losing interest. I remember the trailer looking decent, bit the movie itself lost me from the start. When the cast was on the beach and it became apparent all of them were long fir this world I still could not find a reason to give it much thoughtSave yourself the boredom and skip this one.

James Bond is back and on the trail of a warped villain out to poison the world. Daniel Craig being the best bond imo since Roger Moore is back a lot more serious than ever before in the latest movie to the franchise. Bond is on borrowed time as his true love is being hunted down by a new odd villain, having been stripped of his 007 title we see the suave agent over his head in a race to save the world.Craig gives it his all in his latest and yes last outing as Bond traveling the world as well as trying to save it. Besides having a really bad villain we have a great performance by Craig showing why he is the right fit here. The ending may not be what you expect but its nice to go out with a bang now and then.

I like Chris Rock and always have, hes extremely funny one of the sharpest comics out there but he cant make a movie to save his life.til now.What we have on Spiral is a newold spin on the franchise with someone doing copycat executions like jigsaw and its a whodunit in the police department as to whos the killer.I love the saw movies.the traps, the mystery even though youve seen this movie before it works. Samuel L Jackson and Rock make this movie and even tho its not hard to solve the mystery its a decent ride.

Just could not get into this movie. I like both of these actors but this movie did neither any favors with too dry and slow a movie with a predictable plot and ending.Emotionless society ? How about an emotionless story.

A wild road rage movie that was enjoyable. Russell Crowe plays a great bad guy here who definitely has a rage problem and takes it all out on a young mother and her son. From start to stop this movie is all over the map and thats a good thing. To escape the covid or the pressure of life itself sit back, relax and watch this cat n mouse demolition derby of a movie!

This movie was pretty bad from the get go and it wasnt until the last 30 minutes that things actually got good. We found out just how the cleaning lady came to be and the action definitely started and then with 2 minutes left the dumbest ending took place and a bad movie just got worse.My take is that Shelly loved her doll house, she played with it and treasured it. She told Alice early in the movie how was like a barbie doll. At the end Alice was captive in Shellys room which to me resembled the inside of the doll house and now Shelly is looming through the window at her new doll house with Alice the real life living doll trapped inside.

I didnt have high hopes for this movie due to the reviews and some of the buzz however Im glad a gave it a shot. First off I found Tyler Posey to be a credible actor and he can handle and stay believable in an action role. Dont let his good looks fool you he pulled this movie off. Especially since he was in every scene.Secondly this movie is very action packed and suspenseful despite a slight lull toward the end.Really good showing for an end of the world type movie.

I love the VHS series, and Spring is such an awesome gem of a movie.I had to watch this to follow up on the creative minds from the previous two films, but I just couldnt get into it. I found it to slow and boring and the plot I was just not buying into.Ill stick with Spring if I want different but thats just my take.

A few years ago I saw hereditary and it was so good and powerful and shocking that when I found out this movie had the same writerdirector I knew I had to see it.This movie got buzz, gained attention for being different and I had high hopes and they were all squashed.First off this movie is 2.5 hours long! Its exhaustingly too too damn long! The story is hard to follow between the dialects and all the characters you need a road map to find out whos who. I literally had to go on Wikipedia and read what I was watching thats how bad this movie got.The beginning with the girls family was good and her raw emotion was on point after that this got ridiculous.

I read that this was one of the best horror movies of the year and thought Id give it a shot and so glad I did. Nice to see that scary movies with multiple killers are still around and have a nice size budget to play with.When a group of friends decide to partake in a little haunted house fun they get more than they bargained for. As a group of face swapping killers decide to take the haunted house to an all new level of terror!This movie was so good.the acting was excellent, the scares were perfect, the suspense level to top notch and the group who terrorizes the students did a darn good job!As the movie ended i saw the master of terror himself Eli Roth in the credits as a producer and that made me realize then who had a hand in this monster[master] piece.I almost would want a sequel but this is one of those gems that doesnt need it.

Such a good and powerfully sad movie about drug addiction and a fathers love for his son. Great acting as this cast made this story so believable and it touched the heart strings and makes you think about things. Carrell has done such a good job over the years with these dramatic roles and he masters this one as a father who would do anything for his first born.

First off you have to suspend all belief when you watch these movies and just go with the fun of seeing these girls in danger sit back and enjoy the ride,swim. I kind of liked this movie as far fetched as it was.girls in peril underwater, no where to go and when it seems they are out of danger they get in more trouble.I really liked how when it seemed as though they were safe that is when the killings began some surprising ones too. I did not see two of those coming at all and that late in the movie.Anyway it wasnt so bad but there is no need for a 3rd one because now itd be been there, swam that.

An edge of your seat movie that I was glued to the entire time! Talk about adrenaline flowing action, edge of your seat movie that was not all that predictable as one might think. I remember when the first trailer came out, the comments were that all the good stuff was in that trailer well let me tell you that is far from the case. This movie was so good that you not only do you not look at the clock you also dont want it to end at least I didnt.

A lot of times the sequel drops the ball and you wish it had never been made, but not in this case. John Wick Chapter 2 kicks right off from the first movie and does not stop to take a breath. Another bang em up all out bullet fest that is no holds barred.

I read this on a list of being one of the top scary movies to see before Halloween and well I missed the deadline, but just finished the movie. I knew going into this movie that there would be subtitles and that is no issue to me. However what was an issue that this movie is so over hyped and so over talked that the expectation is so high and I just didnt see it delivering.Was it a little creepy oh yes, and was the main character the girl eerie oh yes very much so but the rest to me was just so so. The girl made the movie, but even she could not hold this on together.

When I first saw this movie advertised I knew I had to see it and man am I glad I did. This movie makes the most of Octavia Spencer and proves she can do thrillerhorror like no one can. Highly recommend this.

I love these kinds of movies. The ones where its the character versus the world and this was one of those literally. A movie with little dialogue yet the story and scenery and action speaks for themselves. Sit back put yourself in his shoes and ride this exciting ride til the end.

I like a prequel that is done so well that you are locked into it and not wishing you had just watched the current ones instead. This movie is so well done, so suspenseful and has you wondering right until the end who will be Leatherface and who wont make it to the final scene. I love this movie. and I am hoping for a sequel that takes place not too far after. The mother was so creepy and so good it would be a waste not to have her in another one soon.

I got this for a Super Mario fan and I dont know who liked it more me or him. I remember this as being campy and fun with the great legend Dennis Hopper playing an out of control bad guy in human form as King Koopa! This movie brought back the memories and it was nice to see how they took all the characters from the video game and transformed them into this movie in unique ways.

This movie is one of the movies that you cant take your eyes off the screen for a minute or youll miss everything type of movies. Every little bit here counts as to whats going on.Without revealing too much a daughter has just lost her mother and her death has made an impact on her family. The two women were never close and in fact the womans family suffers from mental illness. The grandmother was really only close to one of two children the granddaughter and her death leaves ever lasting feelings that dont go away.This is a twisty, blink and youll miss a lot movie. It gives you just the right amount of slow churning spooky moments that keep you glued. While the ending is a bit confusing and Ill admit I looked it up for further explanation it really is a good watch.

As a life long marvel fan for over 40 years and a fan of the marvel movies I have to say this was greatly anticipated and a really good movie. If your a comic fan youll find that not everything is perfect, but what you get us good acting, great special effects, nice humor all tied up with a nice bow and a clue to whos in venom 2.With a different origin than the books venom starts off in this film trying to stop his host brothers from taking over the world and trying to stop the nefarious life foundation from aiding them in this plot.Do not miss this latest marvel movie! Yes it does not mention spider man and yes it is missing his character giving venom a thumbs up to carry the mantle but what it does have is a good supporting cast and a fresh start to the marvelvenom universe.

While the trailer really did sell me I found that movie itself was almost as good. Two young lovers set sail out on the open water with a destination in mind only to be caught in the middle of a powerful storm.This movie was beautifully shot with some decent action sequences telling the story of the seaman and his newfound love as they brave the treacherous waters. I liked what I saw and I believed the actors portrayals.

This movie is a slow moving suspense filled thriller with a father searching for his daughter. While this is original in concept I often found myself pre occupied with other things. It did just not keep my attention for long and I felt like the main character could not carry the film. Not a bad movie just not much of an attention grabber either.

I will say first off for about 90 of the movie I was hooked, had no real idea who was who and what was happening until about 30 minutes left and I started to lose interest. This movie leaves you guessing the entire time, is everything she she sees and says really true or not and that is the strongest point of the movie.The hospital itself was totally creepy and the staff pretty much expressionless which added to the spook factor of the movie for me. I liked when the mom showed up, a total unrecognizable Amy Irving with a small but take charge performance as the strong willed mom. She added something here a little more sanity to the story.When the truth to the movie is uncovered with about 30 minutes to go that is when I kind of fell of track here. I was no longer really on the edge of my seat and almost felt like they solved everything a little too soon. The scenes in the woods were good, so damn dark though I could hardly tell what was what but that added to the mystery of it all. I thought the movie rebounded itself in the woods as everything was coming together. I still did not know what was going to happen and I liked that about these scenes. The overall ending was more crazy over creepy though I am not surprised how it ended up.I would say this is a slowly burning creepy film with some surprises involved and worth the time invested.

One of the greatest directorial minds out there came out with a new movie earlier in the year and it was not that good. While this movie was CGI heavy and not that it is a bad thing it has not really anything else to offer. In a world where VR rules and anyone can be anything at any time a young man enters into a battle of wits and tries to claim the ultimate prize or lose it all.I just found this movie packed to the gills with so many cameos from other films from Chuckie the killer doll to what looked like Hello Kitty walking by that you could hardly keep track of everything going on. To be honest I lost all interest 35 minutes in and while I watched it I just let most go in one ear and out the other. Not one of Stevens best works of art.

So good.This movie has taken one of my favorite genres the "end of the world" type movies and put a different spin into it. It is about a family in a midwestern town surrounded by nothing just a vast emptiness of abandoned buildings and waste yet they live in complete silence. and the reason they do this is because they are always being hunted by some type of alien life form that feed on sound and that is how they hunt to kill.We as the viewer get to live through them, silently and scared. This movie has the right amount of scares and thrills all nicely wrapped up in a mostly silent film with the exception for the alien that is. that is a cross between Venom and the movie Alien.Get this movie.! Get it for its heart, its suspense and for just how clever it is. Never has a movie been so eerily silent and spoken such volumes.

I am a horror movie fan so this was easy for me to rate. I have seen many on social media tear apart this movie talking about how it was not like the original, and how the killers should have aged, whether these people are the same ones from the first movie and all I have to say is who cares.This movie has a setting that I liked a trailer park in the country that is dark and pretty isolated two parents are bringing their troublesome daughter to live with an aunt and uncle far away from home and friends hoping to change her for the better. And then with a knock on the door the trouble slowly begins. I liked that this movie had a nice pace to it, the first one was slower and more methodical and this one a little quicker and the killers dont waste anytime. The 80s songs in this movie were pretty cool and well placed too especially if you grew up in the 80s.I also liked that you do not know if these are the original three or what the time of the film is in. all you know is there is a similar pickup with three very menacing people and the simple question "is Tamara home ?"The kills were good and the fight scenes with the two main characters were good too especially against the last of the strangers fighting for his life. And I loved the ending.and the alternated ending too both were equally creepy leaving you wondering what if anything is next. Personally I dont see a sequel coming but you never can tell anymore. I just think that the reviewers are so negative anymore. I mean people tore this apart and were expecting from the talk the "star wars" of horror movies. LOLIn this you get some scares, a lot of action, new kills, and new people 2 to try and fight off the masked intruders. I liked this film, not loved but liked. And if there is a part 3. someone on social media said there ought to be a prequel of what happened between the Liv Tyler movie and this one. Who wants to see that ? And who cares. if there is a part 3 maybe in fact the Man in the Mask will recruit someone else or two more girls and go after someone else. Who knows. I think this is the end, at least until someone can come up with a new way to bring the evil threesome back to life.

This movie was both sick and stupid. First off for the first half of the movie the actors acted as though they were reading the lines of cue cards, the children were just plain awful actors! And the dialogue. the boy wanted to see Martins armpit hairs, and the Dad and the Daughter really loved talking about how she was on her period to a a friend at a party and to Martin. I found the acting and the dialogue to be so distracting it was hard to get into the story and then when you finally find out what is happening its such a hard pill to swallow that you really have to suspend belief here.I always thought that Colin Farrell and Nicole Kidman were two of Hollywoods leading actors but I swear these two have made nothing but crappy films for a long while now. Their choices anymore go straight to DVD and not in a good way. This movie while creepy and different was so bad and twisted that I would not recommend this to anyone, ever.

One of the better action westerns with a twist that I loved. When I saw this coming out I paid little to no attention thinking it was just another western and since the commercials reminded me of the "Hateful Eight" which I had already seen I did not want a retread.However I am so glad I gave this another look. with a great supporting cast Kurt Russell leads a group on a rescue mission against some cannibalistic Indians and to really say much more would spoil it for anyone who has not seen it.I will say hats off to the great Richard Jenkins who as his role as the "old man deputy" was so good and his dialogue was so sharp it made me smile during a movie when there were not any real laughs.See this movie if you like slow churning action with old west mentalities thats part horror movie and a little love story tossed in.

Great movie with a lot of humor and a lot of heart. This movie had so much to offer in a new movie villain Hela the Goddess of death, the Grandmaster and Surtur to name a few. The action, the laughs, the haircut.Another winner here by Marvel wrapped up with a nice ending leading right into the showdown with Thanos.

Jigsaw is back in a very good way. As a fan of this franchise these movies never get old, the traps get more intriguing and the guessing game still makes me wonder who did what to get here. I loved that John Kramer loomed over this movie as it made you wonder if the madman was still alive by some miracle and what his intentions this time around. Tobin Bell is so good in this part, his eerie voice and his overall look I just never get tired of seeing him.This movie is true to the series and hopefully will continue from here as I am already ready for another round. If your a fan youll love it and if your new to the series then your not so left out either.

This was so good and I mean good. I never saw the original though I do love Tim Curry, and I never read the book though Stephen King is a master at storytelling I am glad I waited none the less. This movie about a group of nerds, geeks, losers whatever you call them and a nightmare of a clown that terrorizes them hit all the spots. It truly does keep your interest and keeps you guessing never quite knowing what is real and what isnt.Just cannot say enough and eagerly await Chapter 2.

Suspenseful and creepy are two words that come to mind when watching this movie. An unknown apocalypse has occurred leaving everything scarce while a family in isolation tries to survive until others arrive that could be friends or foes.This movie was really good in all the right places, the acting was top notch and the house and outside especially made for good storytelling. The viewer did not need all the plot holes filled out, we did not need to know how the people came to be there to know that danger was everywhere and it was a kill or be killed type of enviroment.Good movie that was quick and mysteriously creepy with one of those endings I like from time to time that leaves you with the impression that no matter what happens to them now their lives are forever changed and not for the better.

Super creepy follow up to the frightening original movie. One of the original characters brother recruits some friends and starts making a docu-series on her disappearance and that is when things go very wrong. These movies always manage to make me cringe as to what is coming next, and I love the scares because it is what you cant see that is so disturbing.

This is another great spin off from the ultra scary series based on the "Conjuring" movies as Annabelle Creation shows how the evil was born in this doll. Many good scares and jumps are seen throughout this movie as we learn just how the evil was born with a really good story that keeps you hooked until the end. While I must admit I thought the first few minutes were really slow and dragging and had no idea where it was going until the real Annabelle had died and then things took a nice turn.The ending was wrapped up with a nice bow which I did not see coming as the movie came full circle from the past to the present explaining again how Annabelle has come from her roots to modern day times all while tieing up the prequel with the original movie. I dont know how they can do it, but I am already waiting for Annabelle 3.

The previews made this seem so awesome. a movie with Tom Cruise as the hero battling an all new Mummy and also featuring Dr Jeckyll and Mr Hyde and well once again the commercials made it seem so much better than it is. While this movie did have a lot of action and even some cool scenes and effects I found myself ignoring it and doing other things as I lost interest a lot. It was kind of Indiana Jones rehash to me with just different people. It was not the worst but by far not the best Cruise movie I have seen.

Nice follow up to the hit cult smash Gotg volume 1. This movie solves the mystery of Star Lords father while giving more great screen time to a hilarious Drax and Rocket Racoon along with Yondu. I will say that while this was greatly anticipated the first one was done so much better in my opinion. I was really hoping for more Thanos at least in the end credits to further the infinity war movie story line.Good acting and action not a bad movie but not a perfect sequel either. Many funny moments from the supporting cast.

Much better than prometheus with a nice twist of an ending. I will never understand Hollywood and the need for endless prequels, so many movies dont need them and I am not sure Alien did either. This movie is about a group of people assigned to find new worlds for a colony to grow when they are signaled to this new strange world and yes you guessed it the Aliens are all over it creating and evolving as they so often do.Michael Fassbender is here again playing a good and bad android who at least is a bigger stretch then the one he played in the last film. His motives are not that big of a stretch to be believe although I think they could have been revealed much fast as this movie tended to just put put a long in some places.Its def not the worst of prequelssequels I still think it is time to call it a day and end these while the interest is still fairly there.

While a lot of people are going to say Alien ripoff and you can make some comparisons. Life is a pretty good movie. This movie has a lot of suspense and it was pretty creepy and the thing "Calvin" you never knew where it was going or what it was going to do next. I found myself cringing at some of the scenes and it was kinda spooky and kept getting bigger.I would say if you want a decent suspenseful space alien movie than this is the one for you.
Sigourney is so much better than this garbage.

Best movie of the Summer! This movie is a throw back to the monster movies of old while giving us some great new creatures and some great performances with Samuel L Jackson playing a serious bad guy type character. King Kong was everything you want in a movie, awesome creatures, great fights, bad guys, the heroine who reminded us of the Kong movies of old and so much more. I was glued from the get go and this movie delivered.

A nice horror slightly science fiction-ish movie about a young upstart at a company who is directed to go to a private rehab facility and retrieve the companies CEO. Once there he tries to solve the mysteries the facility contains while trying to fight for his sanity.This was a good movie both visually stunning and well acted and while its running time did seem a little long and at times dragged in the middle the outcome was well worth it. Its a slow moving thriller that takes its time to unwind but when it does it pays off. Dane Dehaan shows here he can carry a movie as the main star and keep it interesting.

I wanted to like this movie, it got a lot of good buzz but I found it just dragged on too much and for too long. There is not a lot you can about it because it will reveal too many plot details Ill just say that I was not a fan.

Fantastic thriller that shows that once again with no big names you can still make a great thriller that keeps you guessing. Chis and his girlfriend plan a trip home to meet her white family and all is not as it seems from the first meeting. To say more would be a shame, know though that is movie will keep people guessing and thinking throughout the whole film. It is suspenseful and funny and def worth seeing.

Funny buddy movie as Will Ferrell and Marky Mark Wahlburg play competing dads for their kids affections in this funny funny movie that once again shows why Will is that damn good at comedy. I liked the kids, the humor and the pairing of these two for their second movie together as they have a lot of chemistry.Its cute and funny. highly recommended.

Decent thriller about two high school guys and phone pranking gone wrong. The intensity of this film and the suspense was pretty good although there for a while I had to ask myself how is "Mr Lee" controlling everything in the house. power, 911 calls, etc still it kept the drama going.In the end it was not too hard to find the killer though as you knew it had to be a previous victim. All in all decent enough.I like Garrett Clayton too for all his .very far from Disney film roles as he is not afraid to take chances.

In his second film outing Tom Ford has given us this wicked little gem and it is so good. This is a movie within a movie, or a book within a movie. whatever you want to call it, call this a seductive revenge served cold thriller that had me stuck to the screen from the beginning. Amy Adams is in a relationship and you can tell from the get go she is not happy, when suddenly she receives a manuscript from an ex husband and as she begins reading it we are as captivated as she is. deeper and deeper.Dont miss this movie as it has been beautifully shot and acted.

This was so good and so moving I can see why it won as it did last night at the Academy Awards. This is a story of a young boy who tries to fit in and knows of nowhere to turn until a few chance encounters start to shape his life. I cannot tell you how just mins after watching, it how overcome I am from the powerful performances and the real life-ness to it I feel. All these actors have given their all. and if you think that Mahershala was so damn good in Luke Cage and he was then this shows how good he can be on the big screen and take a smaller role and make it stand out. Here he plays a sympathetic drug dealer who in mere minutes captures my heart.

Although it is a very predictable psycho girl falls in love with a married man movie it was not half bad. All the players did a good job in their roles and kept the suspense up and the action moving along at a nice even pace. Morris Chestnut has been doing the leading man thing here lately and has been doing it well as it seems he is fitting nicely into that role.

Great western thriller that really shows why Jeff Bridges is so damn good! Two relatives trying to save their property decide to rob banks to help pay off the debts that the land has acquired and play cat and mouse with a grizzled old Marshall who is facing retirement while wanting to solve one last case.This movie is so good with some dry humor, a good bank robber story and two men doing the wrong thing for almost the right reasons. This movie deserves the buzz it has gotten, as the great Jeff Bridges pulls off another starring role as the Marshall and thumbs up to Chris Pine and Ben Foster as the family members who are laying it all one the line one bank at a time.

Another typical Madea movie with where she and her crew are out to help a family memeber, but this time it is during Halloween night. No big surprises here but the best and really only laughs are saved when Madea, Joe and Aunt Bam are onscreen. The main thing I liked about it was Joe was used much more here than normal and had most of the best lines and even cussed more than I thought which was a riot.

From the moment that word got out about this movie as it was being filmed to the time it was released I wanted to see this movie and am so glad that I finally have. This is a really really good horror thriller movie that has so many good things going for it that it is hard to keep them all straight. Great acting, a good story, plenty of suspense and surprises thrown in for good measure.Three friends living in the devastated decay that was once Michigan are down on their luck, have no money and really no future and the only way they can survive is from robberies of the affluent people that still habitat the area. Each is looking for one last payday and single out a blind Iraqi war vet who is supposedly loaded, living alone and just has enough money for the three to be set up and able to leave the area. Problem is they have picked the wrong man to mess with.

Flashy splashy movie about an addictive game of Truth or Dare minus the truth part that lets viewers either watch or play and if you play you can win big money with a catch. As the dares get more dangerous so do the stakes.This movie has great promise with two attractive leads, a lot of action, nice soundtrack and some good acting with all that going for it I became bored in the last 45 minutes and was more interested when it was over than what was really going on. In a way it saved its best for the beginning and middle and the ending to me fell flat.

One of the funniest movies has come to life as Seth Rogan and his posse come to life as grocery store items and products trying to survive in our world. This movie has everything you want and expect from Seth turned up a notch and even a dash of cute story telling thrown in for good measure. If you can stop and imagine what would Franco,Rogan, Hill, McBride and Craig Robinson do and say if they were trapped in a grocery store and tuned into food or feminine products then this is your movie. Its Disney on crack with an amusing story line that reaches all your expectations and then some. Not for the kids at all but this is one adult film you will love.

Good movie with all the trimmings. I will admit when I saw the original teasers for this film I was not impressed and even heard some negative feedback from people who had seen it, but when I read some reviews on here and re-watched the trailer I had to see it and am glad I did. To say much about this movie would give so much away, but what I will say is this.A disturbed mother of two who has had her fair share of troubles with her adult daughter and previous marriage is trying to hang on to her sanity. She has a friend and confidant in "Diana" and when Diana does not like someone there is hell to pay.Take my word for it this movie has some good scares, some great acting by the cast and a nice storyline here that works well. Usually when you see on the title "From the creators of." it is usually garbage that they are trying to see but this movie is worth seeing and not just because the people behind the Conjuring have made it.Good action, good scares and while I am not sure it deserves a sequel it def could stand on its own and a non sequel movie.

I remember this movie from when i was much younger and it was always my favorite disney movie and still after all these years still is. How I fantasized about having Elliott as a friend and the adventures we could have. It was such a good movie then with a lot of humor, songs that I still remember to this day and a touching story that still holds up.Great performances from Helen Reddy, Red Buttons, Shelly Winters and Mickey Rooney highlight this movie but it is still the dragon that made me smile and maybe even shed a tiny tear when he flew away for the last time. This is the second time I have seen it as the first time was in the 70s when I was a kid. and it still brings back the happy memories.

Great new updated version of the Jungle Book hits all the marks and is perfectly voiced throughout this movie by its wonderful cast. With real life special effects this movie takes us on a familiar adventure with a few changes as the man cub tries to leave the jungle and head to the village where he came from. All the characters are present Baloo, King Louie, Kaa, etc as they attempt to seduce the man cub to show them the secret that they think he possesses.The cartoon has come to life and it could not have been done better.this movie is a joy for people of all ages!

Great nail biting film that loosely follows the first film but manages to create its own path and actually is 10x better. This movie follows conspiracy theorist John Goodman who has never been creepier as a man who believes the world is coming to an end and he with his guests seems to have the capabilities to survive.or do they ?Great film here with a lot going on in the bunker and especially above ground. John Goodman has never shined brighter and the rest of the cast do him justice supporting the story. You get to decide .is this an alien movie, an end of the world movie, a crazy man just imagining it all or all of the above.Dont miss out on this one.

I wanted to like this movie but I just couldnt get invested in the story or characters. If you want a dollhuman story then stick with mean ole Chucky or the equally evil Annabelle.The story just went on and on and you could call what was happening next before it happened.

I remember when this movie came out there was so much buzz about its performances and how good it was and all the credit it got was deserving. Ryan Gosling at his finest as a man in over his head with the mob, and Albert Brooks as a loathsome total sleezeball of a man who is part of the mob.The movie centers around and driver who meets a girl and her son and tries to forget his past and live clean except that he keeps getting pulled back in and a cat and mouse game begins.Great acting, good storytelling.edge of your seat movie one of the best out there.

Another Tarantino twisty tale of greed and murder set in the old west that hits the spot. Great ensemble with so many powerful performances and surprises that only can come from one of Americas best filmmakers. The old west never looked so good and seemed so bad as a group of men and one lady try to survive in a mountain lodge in the dead of winter. If your a Tarantino fan this is as good as it gets. plenty of dialogue to chew on and plenty of violence and suspension.

Beautifully edited dark disturbing movie about a girl who is slowly coming into her own. At times hard to follow and some scenes are dark and hard to see this movie is powerful enough to keep your interest.

Another cartoon favorite brought back to life in this set as the entire series comes to colorful dvd. The dog with his trusty sidekick cat named spot leaps through the office turning from mild mannered janitor into the "number one super guy" Hong Kong Phooey. All the laughs are back looking better than ever, reminding me of the olden days when cartoons seemed so much better and Saturday mornings were appointment television.If your new to it youll love the comedy and funny action and if your a fan itll make you smile again.

Garbage back and forth movie that tries to be a little Tarantino at times it failed that just never quite gets good.Man in the desert one night has a stranger stumble into his camp and after a few short words and a quick fight one of the men leaves the other, but also leaves his id behind and so the cat and mouse games begin.There was a minute in this movie I thought hmm potential and then when they both left the desert I thought.hmm no and as the movie went on it got worse. And an unseen Mark Walhburg cameo did nothing but make it worse.Skip it!

Fantastic reboot that has the heart of the older Rocky movies but provides a new look and take to make a really good movie. The son of the late Apollo Creed decides to follow in his fathers footsteps and goes to his fathers long time nemesisfriend for help in getting started on a professional boxing career. With Rocky Balboa by his side the young fighter learns about life and boxing and tries to win the light heavyweight championship of the world while he fights to maintain his fathers legacy as a champion.Great feel good movie that ties in the old Rocky movies with present day life. I was glad to see that they remembered to talk about Mickey, and Paulie and mention Adrienne and Rocky Jr. as it gives this movie a walk down memory lane for fans who grew up watching the previous movies. Michael B Jordan has really come into his own over the last few years and this role shows how far he has grown and what he can do onscreen.I look forward to Creed 2 as they have left the door open for more.

Funny feel good movie with two of the funniest out there Fey and Poehler as sisters who are throwing a party and trying to fix their stalled lives. This movie has many laugh out loud moments and clever jokes that will def make you smile and remember just how good these two are together.

Fascinating story of Uday Hussein the son of Saddam and his life and how he lived in as told by his body double. This movie has it all the greed, the power, the madness of a son of from royalty and what he did with that power. Its moving it raw and it is a seductive movie that draws you in from the get go and never lets up.Dominic is one of those actors who you may not remember his name at first but you remember his performances. He has the looks and the ability and every role he takes he becomes the person he is playing and he does not fail here at all. He brings a little humanity to Uday while making us despise and loathe him for his actions. This is a good sleeper film that cannot go unseen.

The Merc with the Mouth stayed true to form in this movie taken from the pages of Marvel and played expertly by Ryan Reynolds. Excellent movie with a ton of action, violence, comedy by the truckload and a nice mix of the origin and the story going forward. This is one of the best Marvel movies out there that tells it like it is and gives us some of the xmen and supporting characters that makes us love Deadpool so much.Highly recommended!

Nice action movie that is taken from real time events. Some really breathtaking views of the climbers on the mountain as they set out to reach their goal and survive the hazards. A little confusing at times to tell who is who under the gear but all in all a decent movie.

Beautiful fun masterfully done film that takes the old legendary magic of the original and throws in some new things to make one terrific movie. The force is alive and well as the next generation of young jedis do battle for the force and supremacy. The old faves are here for the ride as Luke, Leia, Han Solo, and Chewie have returned to join a new group that must stop the evil Kylo Ren and the darkside.Awesome movie well worth the wait! So coo to have it back.

Moving powerful film about a woman who at an early age was abducted and now with her child and their will to survive they try and live a normal life in a world that has seemingly passed them by. This was an emotional, suspenseful movie that was so good it is no wonder that it received the nominations that it did. The boy was so brilliant when he spoke tears came to my eyes and the mother Brie Larson who no wonder won best acting nod was so believable and so perfect in this role.Its a touchy subject taken from a true story that is given such emotion and heart and done so well. Wow, what a seriously good movie.

Daniel Craig is back in fine form as James Bond who in this outing is finding out all the bad things that have happened to him as of latein the Craig films and all the deaths that have occurred are due to one man from his past. If Skyfall was good and it was then this movie just might be that much better. Great fight scenes, great new villains, a beautiful car chase scene and plenty of nods to the other Bond films make this one a cant miss. It held my attention the whole time, whereas in Skyfall I was looking at the clock this movie for being 2 12 hours flew by and makes me anxiously await Daniel Craig signing up for possibly one if not more.

Dark suspenseful movie that was full of really cool twists and ran strong until the last 20 minutes. A obviously mentally ill girl is the caretaker for her dying brother, the live in a huge house and obviously have money. As her brother lays dying she is informed that he has taken care of her and she never needs anything. The day of the funeral as she hides in her home 3 intruders break in seeking money and this is where the fun begins.As I said above, it was good with plenty of traps and blood and some gore to make things interesting but when the truth is revealed it was kind of a let down. I would have preferred this to be somewhat like the Collector movie where this time the Collector is a female and once you "break in her house. you dont break out". All in all good movie, great performance by the girl and supporting cast.

Great Action Movie! Owen Wilson is moving overseas with his family to work on and accept a new job when total chaos erupts and now he is forced to fight for his life as he and his family try and flee the country with everything and almost everyone against them.To say anymore would be wrong, but this movie is a non stop thrill with some really breathtaking moments. the rooftop jump alone made my heart skip a beat.Action galore!

Twisted tale based on seeing is believing. Two twin boys are playing outside one day when there mother comes home in bandages and expresses some weird behavior. She sets strict rules, and def does not act like their mother at all and seems to not be able to tell the twins apart. As the boys decide it is time to find out whether this woman truly is their mother a deadly game begins that can only end with tragic consequences.Great movie with nice performances by all, beautifully shot and edited and mysteriously plotted throughout. Highly recommended.

Great great movie. After a series of flops M Knight returns to true form in this spooky grandparents from hell movie that delivers big time.After having been separated from her parents for years a mother due to the urging of her children decides it is time for her own kids to finally meet and get to know her own parents, and what seems like a grand idea soon turns into a big mistake.This movie has it all jumps, dark humor, sweet yet sick grandparents, awesome acting from a younger cast and some real good surprises. I could not recommend this more as it had me on the edge of my seat wondering what the mystery could be and I still had not figured it out upon the big reveal. For those who might say the reveal was delivered way too soon I disagree as it left even more tension and chills.Great Great movie. now M Night lets see what you can do with a follow up!

A little bit "The Strangers" and a little bit "Funny Games" Knock Knock is a movie about a loving father and husband who is left alone on the weekend while his family goes to the beach and he stays at home to finish up on work on a stormy night when there is a knock on his door and that basically kicks off the movie. This movie is suspenseful at times, funny in others, a little sick, maybe a tad of scary tossed in for good measure and this movie kept me hooked the whole time. Yes there were some time when you see it and your like .why doesnt he just do this, or call the police, or say this. but that happens in every movie. I thought the movie had a nice budget, good actors, nice action some good thrills and 3 good looking leads.I especially liked the girls as you never quite knew what was going on and what the motivation was and how they would do almost anything to achieve the goal and as a viewer your never quite sure what the goal was. And there is a lot of complaints I have read about the ending when in fact it was actually quite clever. if you pay attention and this is not much of a spoiler.he accidentally liked his own video as he was trying to delete it. Just brilliant!This movie was just what you expected when you saw the trailer, two good looking girls are up to no good and of course Keanu Reeves cannot help himself. Good movie!

For a movie that got little trailer action and behind the scenes word had this movie not fairing to well I have got to say it was AWESOME! As a big time Marvel the studio got this one right all the way from start to finish. More humor than other Marvel films this one had the perfect mix of action and light comedy with a nice story and some excellent acting. Paul Rudd pulled off the perfect role as Scott Lang thief and absent down on his luck father who stumbles into the world of super hero crime fighter with the help of genius scientist Micheal Douglas in a great role as the original Ant man.The Avengers franchise has successfully managed to spin off this third wheel from Marvel and along with Iron Man, Thor and Captain America we now have another movie this is both beautifully acted and produced,I am def looking forward to the sequel allegedly titled Ant man and the Wasp.

I am a huge Fantastic Four fan and despite the bad reviews and the even worse box office opening I have to say this movie was not half bad. Way better than the cheesy Jessica Alba version this movie takes on a more serious approach to the team how they began and what brought them all together. When you first see who the team would consist of actor wise there is reason for pause but once you see them in action they really start to gel onscreen and the criticism of the actor who played Dr Doom and the character itself was uncalled for. this Dr Doom was more serious before he wore the mask and after and def played a good enemy of the team.Tons of special effects here and a lot of background information on how the team formed and why. if there is any flaws I would say that maybe too much time was used for the origin and not enough time for the final battle although when it happened it was action packed. I could have used more Dr Doom time and maybe even running time as this movie could be called a tad rushed. Overall a nice effort that was overlooked and under appreciated by many.

I love Melissa McCarthy in her sitcom Mike and Molly, I loved Melissa in Tammy and identity thief but this movie is just not as good. I think she is hilarious but this movie could just not do it for me at all and I am disappointed. I thought the first few minutes were cute but after that the movie just kind of limped and was to predictable and not as funny as her other stuff. She is funnier on snl and that is saying something.Big fan just not of this film.
