Great sequel with tons of action and a new spin on the old movie franchise. Great plot twist that def will keep the series going as Arnold always comes back.

Great cat and mouse thriller with Anthony Hopkins as a jealous husband whos wife has cheated on him one too many times and plots the perfect murder while Ryan Gosling plays an ambitious D.A. who takes this last case in his district. This nail biter of one upsmanship is a good good movie that I highly recommend.A sleeper movie that shows once again how good Hopkins is when he plays bad, and how good Gosling is as an underrated actor.

Not the best, not the worst. The film is another one of those end of the world types where there are few survivors if any and not a lot to look forward to in life. A young woman named Ann is all alone in an extremely small town, her family abandoned her to look for survivors elsewhere and she has managed to farm and hunt to survive with no help at all. Another man named John shows up he too all alone and desperate and slowly he and Ann bond over their misfortunes and hopes of taking what Ann has and with his knowledge improving life for both of them that is until Caleb shows up.Somewhat mysterious with a different type of personality that Ann and John has Caleb is also a survivor of the worlds fallout needing help and takes advantage of the hospitality that Ann provides. There is a mistrust that John has for Caleb instantly and he can see there is a bond developing between the two and that is where the movie gets interesting.I liked this movie for the characters down on their luck have done the best they can do to survive in the situation they are in. All 3 actors have taken this small movie and made it into something and there is a surprise twist that you cannot see coming literally.and as good as it is it also ends the movie on a sour note. I would have liked to have seen the outcome of Johns decision and what had become of Ann even though in my opinion I got the feeling she was very sad and John himself seemed the worse for wear.Nice sleeper movie, slow at times and again the performances were fine. not the best movie and by far not the worst.

Excellent boxing movie that was gritty and raw with a superb performance from Jake Gyllenhaal and thumbs up to Forest Whitaker for another great supporting role that he played. Raw action story of a boxing champion who went from the top with everything to nothing left except his will to live and win. Such a good movie somewhat of a modern age "Rocky" but more life like.

One great movie! From the first preview that I ever had seen to the end of this cute and funny movie it was so good and so worth the wait to see it. Amy Schumer was fabulous as a girl who has a commitment problem and just bad luck with men in general, while Bill Hader has some relationship quirks of his own. Every character stood out in this movie from John Cena in a nice little supporting role to LaBron James as Haders cheapskate bestie.This movie was funny in all the right spots and had a healthy dose of heart too where it mattered.Funny, witty with some laugh out loud moments and a nice story to and debut for Amy film wise.

Very cute and funny sequel that holds up to the first one in both style and substance, laughs and heart. I surprisingly loved the first one even though it is not my type of movie and so looked forward to this one and was not a bit disappointed. Rebel Wilson clearly got a bigger role and more air time which is fine with me as she makes me laugh the most. Great songs and musical numbers. you just cant beat this feel good movie!

Tom Hardy is a good actor, Charlize Theron is a great actress but in this movie I just could not get into their performances or the story itself. Honestly even though he is probably too old to play the part I missed Mel Gibson in this role.A lot of action here and great scenery but try as I might Mad Max was never my kind of movie.

Awesome sequel and actually much better than the first in my opinion. with a great villain, many great appearances and action galore plus some much needed fleshing out of the characters that we did not get to see in the first movie. Ultron was the perfect foe so wickedly evil and powerful with an axe to grind as many comic book fans know and here he comes to life bent on taking over the world. I loved the introduction of Scarlet Witch and Quicksilver and the integration of Falcon and War Machine to the roster.This movie was far superior as if it could be. to the first and I def recommend it to all comic fans and stick around for the closing credits as we get a nice scene with Thanos with a set up to Avengers 3 and 4 respectively.

Excellent thrill ride movie as two kids running away from home stumble across a cop car and wanting to live out every young boys fantasy take it on a joy ride, playing games pretending to be cops etc and then comes big bad Kevin Bacon. Kevin Bacon plays a crooked sheriff who wants his car back and to keep his tracks covered and that is where the story starts to get good.You have to love Kevin Bacon because as he has gotten older he has taken more chances in his career choices and here is another turn as a really mean crooked coke head of a cop who is in hot illegal pursuit of two teen runaways. This movie has car chases, good action, some intense moments, funny dark humor and two kids who do a wonderful job of being kids who are in way over their heads in this chase movie.

Great action movie that reunites all the cast from the original movies in one form or another and manages to send a heartfelt farewell to Paul Walker. This was a really awesome movie with some jaw dropping action scenes and a nicely woven plot that manages to bring everyone back as they are being hunted by great bad guy Jason Statham in his quest for revenge.As the movie comes to a close you can see how they set up the Rocks much rumored spin off franchise of his own and they have said goodbye to Paul Walker in such a way of grace with flashbacks throughout the series of the movies.As much as I love these movies and as much as Fast 5 breathed some much needed life into them and 6 was great as was this it is time to close the door and go out in a classy way.All in all one of the best of the series.
Distracting waste of time.and this is coming from a major.see almost anything horror fan!

Great sentimental walk down Sesame Street seeing all the old and favorite muppets and learning all about the life and times of Caroll Spinney. Nice movie that sheds some light on the background of one of the most famous men behind the most famous bird in history. Shed some tears, have some laughs and learn all about what it takes to bring big bird to life as well as Oscar the grouch.Loved this movie!

I never read the books so I am coming at this as just a movie watcher. Rich mysterious seemingly perfectionist Mr Grey is enchanted and obsessed with Ms. Steele. He wants to lavish her with clothes, cars, a beautiful penthouse apartment among other things but control her life especially sexually. I will tell you that the entire time I watched this I kept thinking I had seen it before.and perhaps better and I had done many years before in a movie that shocked audiences and critics alike and it was called 9 12 weeks.In that movie the lead character becomes consumed with a woman who finds him mysterious and dark and becomes just as obsessed with him as he her and along the way they fall in lust and possibly love. Back to shades. I found the movie intriguing but I was not turned on. I found the characters interesting but I was not hooked on them. I found myself slightly involved but it was not a "i cannot tear myself away from the screen type movie". The def left the door open for the sequel with a rather abrupt ending as Ms. Steele who upon finding out what Mr Grey does to those who disobey him walks out presumably of his life.If your curious about it walk but dont run to see it. cause your not missing much.

Julianne Moore is one of Hollywoods best actresses and here she proves it again. This is a sad and heart pulling movie about a successful working mother who is accomplished and brilliant and now suddenly finds herself beginning the stages of alzheimers disease. The movie is all about the progression of the disease and the effects that it has on her marriage and her children. I cant say enough about this movie but I will let you decide for yourself. I was not sure I wanted to see it but am glad I did.

Good movie. that is a love story, a mystery, a thriller and a scary movie all wrapped up into one.Evan just lost his mother and is full of rage, he has a job that is important to him but not all that great and is a loser at love and after a bar fight he finds himself wanted by the police. His boss and friend tells him he needs to get away for a few months that he is a liability to himself and others and after seeing what the bar fight could cause him he decides to go to Europe on an unplanned vacation and that is where he runs into a mysterious beauty named Louise. Louise is lab worker, a beautiful mystery who only comes out at night, does not want a relationship and keeps Evan at arms length. She evades questions and pictures, says she does not love him and just wants to be with him on her terms.Evan meanwhile finds work with a wise old farmer who teaches him a little about love and evolution, and as he works the days and pursues Louise at night he finds himself drawn to her and falling in love with the beautiful enigma. This move was so good on so many levels. the mother passing away pulled at my heart strings, his feelings of being lost in life and love seemed so real and true. The camera work, the scenery, the landscapes were so beautiful but at the same time set the tone for the secrecy of the country.When you finally start to put the puzzle together and see exactly what Louise is and what she is hiding is kind of confusing and the last half the movie slows way down as Evan tries to put everything he has learned into place and tries to feel out his future with Louise. This is a true romancehorror movie about life and love and Evan says it best as the movie begins to fade and he says. you only fall in love one or twice in a lifetime.If your looking for a thriller with a heart this is it. If your looking for something different then this is it. If your looking for suspense and intrigue then this is it. If your looking for a man who has nothing else left for him but this woman no matter what the future brings then this is it.

This movie came out some time ago and missed it thank god I did not pass it up this time. A superb supernatural thriller about a box that holds inside it an evil force that whoever open it releases a demon. Based on a true story this movie does so much with so little and you will never look at a moth again the same or if you happen to look at the inside of your mouth in a mirror you will think of this movie.Jeffrey Dean Morgan plays a workaholic coach and father of two who fights for his daughters life when he cannot separate one of his daughters from the box that controls her. Kyra Sedgwick plays the mother who at first cannot believe what she sees and then is helpless to stop the chaos.Such a good film. before the Conjuring and before Insidious this movie set the tone of supernatural horror.

Great little movie with a lot of heart, a great script and nice acting by all. Noni is the self made girl on top of the world, a singer and pin up girl known around the globe with money and gold records and a fast paced lifestyle. All she wants to do is slow down live her life and make her own decisions, but with the demands of her label, the press and her strong willed and ambitious mother all pulling at her the bottom is ready to drop out.This was a really good film and so well acted it just flowed so naturally. I would so recommend it and have already to friends.

Spooky cat and mouse game of mystery and murder is what you get when you try to stop the balances of life and death. Olivia Wilde is so good in this role as a woman with baggage working with her old friendlover on a secret experiment about bringing things back to life even though they should not. If you remember the movie "Flatliners" from long ago then this movie does it better.what happens when something is too precious to let go but to deadly to let live and what happens when you try to tamper with the scales of life and death ?A nice little movie with a few cool kills and a nail biting ending.

Richard Gere was so good in this role about a father, husband and respected businessman who risks everything in his life to have it all. He is consumed with money and power and his beautiful art gallery owner girlfriend on the side. He lives hard, plays harder and in the boardroom he demands hard work and total devotion. This tale of greed gone wrong is a fun ride from beginning to end with nice performances from Tim Roth as a cop who will not stop until he gets his man and Susan Sarandon as the wife who has over looked everything until now.Gere plays a cad so well that you want to see him get what he has coming, but then you hear his voice and see his emotions played out and you want him to be ok and pull through things.Great movie!

Zane is a writer who has produced and written a series of shows for late night cable that are steamy and erotic that can be liked by everyone no matter what your preferences are. Think the Red Shoe Diaries with a mostly African American cast and a lot of sex. The men are all hot and sexy and the women are sultry and inviting it was series that I watched throughout the years in all of its various incarnations. When this movie came out and I saw that Zanes name was attached to it I knew it would be good and the trailer alone fogged up my computer screen. Boris Kodjoe is one of the hottest names in movie and tv and he def steams things up when he is on screen not to mention model Tyson Beckford, Sharon Leal and wait til you see William Levy omg where did they find him.he steals every scene he is in.A housewife and working mom has it all handsome husband, big house, two perfect kids and her own successful business not too mention a very powerful sex addiction. Think of this as every movie you have seen Michael Douglas in where he is addicted to strong sexy powerful women and cant say no but ad a black woman and make her as equally as addicted and your all set. The main character has a great sex life and a great marriage but as the movie goes on she finds it is simply not enough as she cant get enough. She finds a challenge in a new client who seduces her over and over again first only for sex but he finds himself consumed by her and she him. While late work nights keep her husband busy she finds herself wanting to be with the client more and more. While she goes back and forth on what is right and what is wrong she eventually catches the eye of club hopping and girl stopping ladies man Tyson who instantly also becomes smitten with her.As the movie goes on she finds herself trying to juggle between keeping her secret life together, holding her business above water and finding a way to keep her family intact. This movie has it all, hot sex scenes, drama lies and deceptions all in under 2 hours. Its a hotter Lifetime movie with better bodies, a better script and a decent ending. Def a hot movie to pass the time with.

Sometimes some of the best movies require little dialogue and just the let the actions of the actors themselves set the tone of the film and this is one of those movies. Scarlett who is not afraid to take on projects where she almost never plays the same character is an alien obsessed with others and wants their very souls as well as skin to complete a mission. This is a movie that requires you to think in the abstract, outside the box and take in the beautiful and sometimes spooky surroundings.It is both trippy at times and a little spooky and then ending is really something you do not see coming.

In a not so far off futuristic world the zombie virus is spreading all over, people are scared and dieing and the quarantine stations are filling up quick as people have to decide if they want to say goodbye to their loved ones and leave them there.or worse.Arnold Schwarzenegger is a father of a teen whos daughter has contracted the virus and now he must decide what to do and how if possible can he save his daughter from becoming what he fears most. Maggie is a slow slow slow moving movie, very darkly lit and pretty depressingly set. Schwarzenegger has few choices as the dad, sending his daughter off to quarantined, kill her or try as he might let her live out her life and stop her before it is too late. His wife is torn, his other kids are sent away to avoid the virus, crops and food is scarce and money is at an all time low. The police are trained to kill or quarantine anyone infected and the neighbors are all conflicted and as for Maggie herself she wants to be as normal as possible but sees that option decreasing as the virus is spreading through her body and her desires for flesh are consuming her.I will say that I did like Arnold in this movie because finally after all the years flexing his biceps and getting away with the one liners his age is catching up to him and his days of being the top box office draw are over. As he is in his twilight years he is taking on new roles and in this he plays a character about as far from anything he has ever played but this really doesnt work for him.

When I saw this was produced by the same men who made the fantastic smash Youre Next I thought this movie would be awesome.hot leading actor, a little violence and some mystery. What I got was hot leading guy, action and a script pulled out of the garbage.The lead actor is a super soldier gone loose on a small town once lived in by a former military partner of his and now the guest is there to cause damage and carnage on the small town. After helping the youngest son fight off the school bullies and charming the pants of the daughters girlfriends, the main character starts to lose his grip as his secrets come to light.After guns, explosions, several deaths and a fight at the local high schools fun house the worst ending this movie could have come up with has happened.thats if it couldnt get an dumber.What a waste of time.

There is something about Franco and Rogen that makes me want to only be able to take them in small doses. I loved Pineapple express and I loved loved This is the end.however this movie I could never really get into. I liked the cameos and maybe the first hour but after that I lost complete interest. I had heard how this was the funniest movie ever but it was wasted on me for sure.

A boys life through the years. This movie was decent enough, had many characters come and go throughout the film that were relatable but it was way way too long.A coming of age story seen through the eyes of a boy as his mother and father cope with their lives and loves and the ups and downs of childhood. You can really see how Patricia Arquette managed to win the Oscar with her performance as the mother who cannot win at love and is doing all she can to keep her family together. While this is not a great movie it is a good one that gives you some pause to flash back to your own childhood and see where you where you were and where you are now.

Action packed movie that delivers the action and the pay off. Keanu is back as a man who has lost everything in his life when suddenly out of nowhere his long dead wife has sent him a gift just before she passed away that is a special reminder of the time spent together. That is when the movie kicks in the action.a Russian mobsters son with a penchant for guns and violence and fast cars decides to take from the wrong man. This movie was a roller coaster ride if there ever was one and Reeves who waited so long before he came back fast and hard made the right decision. Fight scenes galore, fast moving cars, action in every type of scenario you can think of and great performances and dialogue that cant be beat. Time moved by so quick as John Wick was a modern day Terminator determined to right wrongs and get revenge. This movie rocked !

This movie got a lot of crappy reviews from people on here, but I chose to give it a shot and in this case I should have listened to the reviews. While there were a few cool effects this movie did not keep my interest at all and I found myself surfing the net for a better movie to watch.I would suggest maybe skipping it and going for something with more scares as this offered none.

Nice story and great acting as Leo really stretched here as a wall street shark who finds that greed is still good. Good and entertaining story about the rise and fall of the power brokers of wall street and the scams that they are capable of pulling off. A little long in the time department but still a good story with some nice performances.

A strikingly and strongly intense movie that will leave you breathless and glued to the screen until the finale! I loved this movie and I am not even into band or this type of music at all but the sheer performances by JK and Miles were so spot on that I could not movie in fear that I would miss something. It has been a long time since I have seen a performance by someone who could command the screen and make you almost scared for the performers but JK Simmons did just that.I so strongly recommend this movie to anyone and everyone, the performances, the story and the writing were so good.why this was not seriously looked at for best picture I would never know.

Nice road trip movie about the relationships between parents and one of their sons. I can see why this movie got all the hype and if you ask me Bruce Dern was robbed and Wil Forte deserved to be nominated for something as well. and June Squibb omg what cant you say about her character as she was def the comic relief!This was a touching and sometimes a tad sad movie about the Father who goes back home to claim what he thinks is a million dollar prize and the relatives and the town troublemaker who come calling for a piece of the prize.It is a tad slow paced at times but oh so worth the watch and the scene with all the brothers watching the football game in the living room is a scream.

Overall this has been a good trilogy being the first one was the creepiest .who could forget the first scene with the harpysuccubus just eerie. The second movie being the bloodiest. the cult that wanted babies was off the chain gross and this third movie that tried to tie it all up but just couldnt get the job done. It is no secret that unlike the first two movies there is no found footage and that was kind of a let down as this helped the creep factor in the first two movies. Although most of the scenes were not done well the magician was pretty damn good and the one where the group was attacked by the cultists. now that was good and bloody.If you liked the first two movies stick with them as they really made the vhs movies creepy good and I would pass on this one.

A twisty sometimes confusing horror tale about an evil mirror that brings out the worst in people. Without giving away too much a mirror possess a family and throughout their lives drives them all crazy and to the brink of murder.This is a very confusing movie in the beginning and throughout for the most part, I had to read ahead about it to follow up on what was going on. Some decent scares and gore with a twisted wrap up at the end.

What a creepy and sometimes disgusting movie that comes from the mind of director Kevin Smith.Justin Long plays a smart ass cheating boyfriend and co host of a podcast that tackles the subject of oddities, myths and unusual stories and runs them down on air with his on air co host. When he is scheduled to go to Canada to interview one of his subjects and that interview falls through rather than return home empty handed he finds another possible interviewee right under his nose. This is where the movie picks up as his interview subject is an old man who tells the tale of being shipwrecked and drowning only to be rescued from out of nowhere by his savior who he names Mr Tusk. As the movie goes on. Justin finds out a little too late that the man is def not who he seems to be and that he has a sinister agenda in store for his guest that involves Mr Tusk and his rebirth.The movie is creepy and sometimes a little unwatchable especially as the transformation takes place. And the cameo by Johnny Depp is totally ridiculous.

Excellent dark and somber tale of a thiefdrifter who is down on his luck with nowhere else to turn and he comes upon a car crash that literally changes his life financially and personally. Jake has a knack for playing these damaged characters and this guy is no exception. with some great supporting performances from Rene Russo and Bill Paxton this movie is a cant miss.Just like one of the many crashes in the film you get a feeling you dont want to watch yet you cannot look away !

I waited years to see this movie, first it came out to theatres to good reviews but did not stick around long enough, and then I never saw it on cable just did though here and man I am glad I did. This movie was so awesome from the start.great action and a wonderful performance by all with some suspense throughout the film and a great ending to tie it all up. I highly recommend this movie if you want a good story and some edge of your seat performances, a nice cameo by Lian Neeson who first tested his tough guy persona here before he went on to film the Taken series.I would def watch this again hands down.

Great trailer! Crappy movie!This movie put out such a good trailer, dark scenes looked like some spooky things going on, a creature sighting in the woods and yes a nearly abandoned cabin in the woods on an old forgotten road and yes with the found footage theme. So far so good and then.the movie started.The friends who are out to party down in the woods in the long for sale abandoned cabin hit something late at night that makes a dent on the car, and after hearing some loud cries in the night and not a car in sight still decide to make the trek to the cabin despite the fact that they walk and walk until the find it and it is creepy and dark and horror movie ready. All decide to sleep in the car and low and behold in the am the car has blood on it and the damage shows a wad of hair and you would think they would be scared , no way though they decide to go biking and swimming and while two of the friends decide to go in the woods and have sex one of the friends sees a bigfoot in the woods near them and heck rather than leave now they decide to wait up and see it out later when everyone is asleep.After a bike chase through the woods that is a little exciting and more sightings the movie starts to go downhill fast. The friends do dumb things, the found footage idea kind of is pointless as it is not really "found" at all and not that scary. When we finally get a good look at the monster bigfoot it is pretty average aka dumb looking and not so frightening and then ending with the one guy who was taking all the footage.with him talking to the bigfoot and the way it all came together had to be the dumbest ending of all time and give you one of those. I WASTED ALL THIS TIME ON THIS MOVIE TO SEE THIS CRAPPY ENDING feelings.Nice idea bad script.

I thought the first Purge was a good idea, well acted with a nice plot line and this movie.it kicks the first ones butt ! Once a year for 12 hours the city goes dark and the citizens can go darker. To stave off the population control and crime one night a year the citizens are free to commit acts of violence unpunished as the people are able to do as they will, but suffer the consequences. A mother and daughter in peril as their husband and father has sold himself to the highest bidder to be killed so his family has money and can be safe, a young couple trying to flee the city are suddenly trapped in the very hell that they tried to escape from and a cop whos child died at the hands of a drunk driver roams the streets to kill the very scum who kill others.This is a survival of the fittest movie with great action, dialogue, a great plot with twists and turns and an insight on what people will do for pleasure when they are given free reign overnight. If you thought the first one was decent this one blows it out of the water, while the first one was confined in a house this one is out in the open on the city streets with more threats and more challenges to survive. Numerous villains to count, a real storyline and a new action hero in Frank Grillo that I hope to see more and more of. See this movie !

This movie got so much buzz, so much hype and no one would really talk about it without feat of revealing the ending. I anxiously awaited this movie and as it started I could feel the tension building and the mystery deepening. Did he do it ? Was an outsider responsible ? The evidence, the clues, the blood.the flashbacks and then the mystery solved after 2 hours.What did I just see ? I mean come on the plot got a little far fetched and yes you could not predict the ending in a million years. I thought after seeing this that it was a lot of hype and the payoff was luke warm. I will say that the wife played an over the top super bitch at the end who finally got everything she deserved and then some.A good movie but not a great movie!

Great movie that captures awesome action and gives fans a fresh look at the DC universe and the Suicide Squad. The squad is created to hunt down and stop the Riddler, seems easy enough right ? Not so much.the Riddler has been captured by Batman and delivered to Arkham so the squad has to break in there and find him. The Joker comes along for the ride with so much action, explosions and double crosses that any comic fan will love this movie.

This movie got huge reviews and made quite a bit at the box office and there were some laughs, but most came from the trailer and you have seen them already. I like Zac Efron as he keeps making strides in roles and picking things that are never the same thing twice however the same cannot be said for Seth Rogen. I like the guy but really get tired of his same old stoner role of the week it is just getting too old and too predictable and hard to watch. Some funny gags but this was not the greatest movie.

Nice action with a twist. I really was looking forward to seeing this when it came out and I am glad I did. Idris was so convincing as a murderer on the loose and was evenly matched here with a strong opponent in Taraji as a wife and mother that happened to answer the door on the wrong night. I loved the cat and mouse, back and forth suspense and the fact that Taraji was not a helpless victim made the movie all the better.If you like good action, great acting and like a little twist that answers questions in the end than this is your movie.

Not a bad movie and certainly not the best either. Jason Statham plays his usual character, a man who just wants to be left alone and after a botched drug bust, decides to leave law enforcement and head into the swamp lands of Louisiana with his daughter. He soon runs into the family of backwoods bad boy James Franco who plays a greasy meth maker with a bad attitude. Franco is called into action by his drug addicted sister after Stahams daughter embarrassed her son and now they want Statham to leave town.Throw in a semi corruptible sheriff, a biker gang and you have a body count in the bayou. Like I said your typical Statham movie with a not so convincing Franco as a bad guy. This film would have been different with the roles slightly reversed as the same old characters that Statham plays in my opinion are getting old, but thats just me.

Great follow up sequel from the James Franco movie as Casaer is now the king of the jungle so to speak and leading his fellow apes building a new world while those damn dirty humans are on the other side of a wasted and wore torn California without power and not much else trying to survive on their own. As the apes try to get along with each other and the few humans they allow in their world a ravaged and rule happy Gary Oldman is getting ammunition together to take over ape city and start a war.Great effects, lots of action, I loved the nods to the older Dawn Movie that only a true fan would see and enjoy. The ending set up another movie and I am looking forward to it.

One of the best Marvel movies to come out this year and that is saying something if you count the Captain America and Iron Man franchises. Guardians not only follows the rich marvel comic history of this team and its villains but it blends in so much humor and action and heart its just hard not to look and want to look again. Chris Pratt really does and outstanding job as StarLord, while Rocket Racoon and Groot provide much of the comic relief. And who would have thought of all people that Josh Brolin even being the great actor that he is.who would have thought he would be chewing up the scenery in a marvel movie playing one of the most iconic bad guys of all time Thanos!I love the story and all the characters and while in a way it seemed to run long.I did not let it bother me instead just go along for the ride and enjoy this latest marvel masterpiece.

This was an awesome reboot from a reboot the writing, the acting, the special effects.all done to near perfection. It some peoples eyes, this is called a reboot. However, it feels more like a prequel. But judging from what i just saw, i cant wait for the sequel with Gary Oldman because it literally just blew my mind.Great action and performances from all the cast and really sets up Ceasar to take over in the next film!

A nice horror movie that is not a sequel to those bad leprechaun movies with Warwick Davis, but yet a total reboot with a good story and good action. Friends are traveling through Ireland on a trip to see the sights when they stumble across someone in a pub who can show them the irish countryside and more sights. As the friends take the man up on the offer they soon realize that there is someone of make that something that is out in the woods with them and it is trying to get inside the cabin.From there you have some good gore and a nice story as to why they are being hunted down and why the man in the bar was so willing to show them the irish countrysides. The movie presents a nice twist in the storytelling and makes the townspeople show their true colors.I really liked this reboot and the story was refreshing as was the acting. Here we have a monster movie with a storyline behind it that really makes the characters stand out. The town villagers were really well played having been so nice in the pub, but now here they are showing how cruel they can be by offering these kids to the creature.I dont know if there is going to be a sequel. but I was really pleasantly surprised by the quality of this movie. Good location, believable story and acting and some good gore.
Big action with every whos who in action movies over the last 15 years. Not a bad movie but it may be time for Stallone to sit back and count his money and leave the action for the new breed.

Clever and funny little movie no pun that I had seen ages ago and wanted to revisit again. A wealthy couple, a killer midget nazi assassin, and The Wizard of Oz all rolled up into one funny and weird movie. I loved this movie as it reminds you how funny Chevy Chase was in an unexpectedly good movie.A must have for tongue in cheek humor.

I read a lot of buzz on this movie some good and some bad though all in all not a bad movie to watch on a lazy day. While there is a lot of flip flopping you can def get a feel that something is not quite right in this family. The mother has a few issues with her husband, her daughter, her daughters boyfriendlover and most importantly her marriage. The father seems a little odd too, while he may be quite the catch at work when he is at home he seems to be pretty much neglected by his wife no matter what he does. He spends a lot of time in the basement for private time, while his wife reads up in the bedroom on how to improve her sex life.You get a feel all of this things while the main problem seems to be .why is her mother suddenly missing and what happened to her. As the movie unfolds you finally see what happened and maybe not in the way you would expect. Here is my take on the outcome. the mother was rather unbalanced and not that nice at all. She seemed to have a problem with her daughter, and her daughters boy toy though I think her problem was that she is jealous of the attention he gives her. The father seems rather insecure and not cared about at all. In some aspects I would say the wife is a bully and because of her treatment toward him he scurries off to the basement to find solace and ahem relief while she looks elsewhere for some form of relief of her own.Like I said above an okay movie for a lazy day, decent performances by all but nothing to write home about.

A really good movie with action and a great story despite almost no dialogue. Robert Redford is on a sail, a sail on the ocean when his boat is severely damaged by a series of swells that take its toll on his vessel. Trying to repair the damage it is only then that more bad storms and damage are on the horizon and as the only passenger he must make some last minute decisions.Such a great story with real raw emotion, the ocean as his friend and enemy, deadly sharks, the storms and no help in sight what an exciting movie that really holds your attention. You feel like your the captain and its your life on the line and time is not on your side. I cannot say enough here you just have to see it.and I promise you will be glued to the screen!

Sweet DVD compiled to bring you the highs and lows of the falling of WCW. Everything captured from the inception of the NWA wrestling of old to the transition to WCW, to the arrival and humongous birth of the NWO to its destruction. Interviews you have never seen, footage and matches from all the pay per views. The NWO story is one of the best and why the federation that was one time on top is no longer was really interesting. The Goldberg years and all covered here. Wrestling fans unite this one is it.

I was a huge Transformers fan when I was a kid, the cartoon was def appointment television on Sunday mornings and when the movies were made I was pretty stoked. The first one was a classic and probably the best of the series with all the characters that you remembered with some new ones tossed in. The second one in my opinion was a bust, the fallen character was a joke and when Optimus Prime died it did not mean much because you knew in 45 minutes he would be resurrected. The 3rd movie I could not get into it was just trying to out do the first 2 and by then it was too much too soon and I bailed before the ending.Now we have the latest incarnation with the debut of the dynabots if you watched the cartoons you did not even need to ask who they were and instead of Shia Labeouf we get Marky Mark Wahlburg and a new cast of humans. The first hour was excellent, just a whole new spin on things. A bounty hunter autobot who is into killing the other autobots, Kelsey Grammer as a ruthless goverment agent who has plans of his own and a new decepticon with a voice and motives similar to one of my faves Megatron! New autobots join along to help Optimus save the earth and Mark from the bad guys but the problem is this movie goes along too damn long ! it is 2 hours and 45 minutes of the same thing over and over. A whole hour went by without much of anything new and by the time you got to the end you knew a few things.Mark is a refreshing change from ShiaThere is def a sequel coming from this movieand Megatron is reborn.If your a fan watch it. If your on the fence skip it and if your bored after the first 45 minutes skip ahead to 2:20 minutes to see the cool conclusion.

One of the best shows on television comes to life on dvd in this awesome collection. Every cliff hanger, every show from the start to finish with behind the scenes stories and comments. I anxiously awaited this set to come and watched them all from Southfork to Ewing Oil as J.R. plotted and stabbed every one in the back on his way to the top. Such a good show that is still timeless.

Don Jon is a ladies man through and through. He rarely goes home alone and then again he rarely sees the same girl twice until he meets a challenge in Barbara. She seems to be the ultimate catch but just cant get past some of his ocd ways and his obsession in porn. Throw in some great performances by Tony Danza and another top notch scene stealing appearance by Julianne Moore who knew she could make Levitt better and you have an interested movie. It was funny and thought provoking and sexy.

Captain America is back and action packed! This is a very well done sequel with tons of action from Cap, Nick Fury, the Black Widow and new addition the Falcon and everyone gets good screen time and does not disappoint. This time around SHIELD is imploding and HYDRA is making a name for itself in the terrorism market trying to take down cap and his friends at all costs.We get to see a few Hydra hold overs from the first movie, and the introduction of Crossbones and his originend easter egg the only thing I would say was lacking was the main bad guy who was behind the scenes. He did just not work out for me, one thing that did though was the winter soldier aka Bucky Barnes! Tons of cool fights especially in the end aboard the shield heli-carrier with the soldier and cap one on one.A def recommendation to add to the Marvel movies that have come out as of late.and a great way to introduce the Avengers: Age of Ultron to us all.

The King of the Monsters returns in this big movie blockbuster in a big way ! While I will admit that the 1st hour of this 2 hour movie dragged when Godzilla finally does appear he gets to fight not 1 monster but 2. They are calling these creatures Mutas but I would call them more like a flying praying mantis like creature. I am looking forward to a little more classic monsters in the sequel Mothra anyone or even Rodan would be awesome. All in all a good movie with a decent story.
Love comic book movies but this one was more cheesy than I had remembered. It was ok but worth a second watch.

I waited years to watch this movie and it was well worth the wait! This movie is about two partners who are more like family than they are co-workers. They live, eat and breath being cops and prove that sometimes you have to cut a few corners to get the scum off the streets. I found this to be a roller coaster of a movie, you never knew what was going to come next but you knew it wasnt gonna be good.I highly recommend this movie!
Love this movie. Saw it in theaters years ago and had to own it.

Was a little boring for a Bond film. Somewhat disappointed. Craig is stellar as usual but the action was limited. The opening sequence didnt have the movement like the first film. Overall slow and not attention grabbing.
This franchise never fails to deliver pure entertainment and adrenaline fueled fun.
Liked the action. Jeff Bridges was a little incoherent at times. Juilanne Moore looked great as a bad witch.
Great show and Maslany is a superstar!
Funny as I remember it!

A very god movie. Has that sci fi element that you dont expect, cause its not in your face in the beginning. The tension builds up between the characters all the way to the end where you rejoice and shed a tear or two of joy. Loved this movie the first time I saw it and had to own again, this time on DVD and not VHS.
Love this movie. Ive watched it over and over before I bought which is something I should have done a while ago.
Great action adventure film and cannot wait for part 2.
Love this show!
Very entertaining and heart provoking. Octavia Spencer and Chris Evans were brilliant. Ed Harris was awesome and a surprise.
Even years later it outshines as a good scfi action strong female lead film. James Cameron knows how to entertain and Sigourney Weaver is a tough cookie.
This movie would have been much better without RZA. I accepted Russell Crowe as a bad ass but RZA was not convincing as an actor, and definitely not a martial arts actor.
Great storyline and action packed as usual. Robert Downey Jr is the perfect Iron Man. Don Cheadle fits his role perfectly.

I like the drama and sincerity of the acting. And I especially like that the Queen had a brother who was as equally evil and mean as the queen. The insecurity of the queen was actually bought on by how she was treated in the past and not because she was so insecure about her looks. It was a good story but just alittle unclear as to which guy Snow chooses in the end.

This movie wasnt about being a Black movie but a good film about relationships. Anyone can see it and enjoy it. Kevin Hart was hilarious as usual and the women were gorgeous. Great film and cant wait til part 2.
Great plot line- great acting- a bit graphic and violent!
This show embodies womans relationships helping each other and woman in labor. I love the characters , the nuns struggles and how they have strong faith - LOVE THIS SERIES!
Great movie but Hollywood takes its liberties. This miracle staircase was built with no nails, no glue, no center support! Staircase of Loretta chapel in NM IS TRUELY A STANDING MIRACLE!
Cute idea of a movie- great action but I did not like that the "bad character" has a lisp  trying to make his character funny I did not like the nudity in the very last scene. It was not called for.
Whats not to love in this continued saga
Loved this cute movie
Great Christmas feel good movie!
Terrible version of this movie, poor acting! And I love Henry winkler ! I donated this movie
Another feel good Christmas movie!
A feel good Christmas movie!
The best actor of this movie wS James gandofini! Silly plot
Bought this for gift and the recipient loved it
Boring movie, donated it
Loved this hallmark movie! Gets you in the mood to start baking Xmas cookies! Yum
Bought this for a gift for 70 year old woman who grew up watching these movies!
Loved the movie!

As always PBS came up with a winner in this enjoyable series- characters, costumes, story line very very interesting! Maggie Smith is EXCEPTIONAL! Her lines ate witty and funny! Great writing! The twists and turns in the continuing plot keep you very interested!
This is the first in the series The Hobbit- great story line- GREAT ACTING- loved the costuming and wigs! TRUELY takes you on the journey with then!
This is the 2 movie in the series THE HOBBIT- this movie continues to seek out the dragon-Incredible scenes of the dragon! TRUELY enjoyed it! Cant wait for part 3 to come out!
Great TRUE story of California surfer Jay Moriariry. The acting is great and scenes of the waves incredible! A heartfelt story! I recommend it highly!
I loved this movie! Explains a lot! 2 great men of faith in history!
John is always funny for all ages! You will laugh outloud!

Back in the 80s Crime Story was the best crime show on. I bought it as gift and the recipient seems to enjoy it. With HD TVs now, the quality of picture is good not great. It was a great price for the 9 disc set!
Incredible story of how these ladies work together and form loving friendships! A must see!
I could sit and watch this for hours! So educational too!

This video is on a par with SLOW TV videos except for the English speaking host. This was so much better than having to read subtitles on the Norwegian SLOW videos that have become so popular. I have been to England and Wales, Llagollen specifically. I miss it terribly as I am stuck in the wild state of Texas. Fortunately, we are getting rain finally to help with the drought. This video series is so refreshing and enjoyable. I recommend kicking back with a pot of tea in front of the fire or not and just relaxing.

Very predictable. There is not any scene where one cannot predict what will happen next. No plot twist. Very disjointed. Too many stories to follow that have no continuity. Dont let the kids watch, there is nudity, soft porn, and anti-American propaganda and too graphic in some scenes. The character of Jack Ryan is shallow and I dont really care for the lead actor. There are so many better productions for this character without having to resort to tawdry footage. I gave it until episode 3 and then I switched it off. I gave it a chance.

Comes off preachy and boring. The propaganda mill is continually turning in this ridiculous film. I kept wait for it to arrive at a point but it never came. Poorly written and targets only one actor which makes this pretty nearly a monologue by a fanatic. Dont waste your time.

I have really enjoyed this series although I would like to see the subsequent seasons. It ran for more than just one season. I really like Kim Delaney and the judges are, to say the least, interesting and sometimes amusing. I have worked in the legal system many years ago and courtroom drama is far less dramatic than portrayed for television. I am sure that some of the scenarios have occurred in real life but . . . Fun series nonetheless.

Having the Directors Cut is essential if you love this movie. Hubby watches it time after time and never tires of it. Getting the Blu-Ray is nice as we have surround sound speakers with our TV and the clarity is much better. This is certainly worth a couple of extra dollars.

Very little to like about this film including many of the actors. Glenn Close? Really. She was awful. The writing was way off from the book and the music was intrusive in trying to guide the audiences feelings and moods. The music was too loud and use of it endeavored to upstage everything and everyone else. I cannot imagine how anyone could enjoy this film. I stuck with it only to be able to write a fair review. There is no big payoff at the end and I am sorry I wasted my time. I normally fall at the feet of many English actors but the direction, script and acting was too flawed to endear me to any of them. My advice? Find another way to spend your time to avoid being bored half the time and annoyed the other half.
Always great! Fun series, I would like to see more Van Damme movies and series in the future. He has still got it!
Would watch this over again. Martin Clunes makes a wonderful Sir Arthur. I am happy to have had the chance to see him in such a role and I hope there are more of its kind on the way.
A very entertaining movie. Lots of action and a good story.
Both seasons one and two are great. the shipping was fast and the dvds were in fine condition. no problems.

Great, funny and classic comedy. John Lithgow and Jane Curtin performances are priceless. French Stewart is warm and wonderful and typically represents that odd person in everyones family. Tommy Solomon, a character lots of the younger generation can relate to. Kristen Johnston, the classic beauty with a warrior edge gives a fun and wonderful performance cementing her comedic style. This is a series for everyone.

So far, this is the best of the Thor series. While it is worth it to see the first Thor to best understand the story, this is even better. I would look forward to a third in the series if it comes out. This is a good quality CD and I highly recommend it for lots of fun.
This is another fun movie. We seem to enjoy the sequel just as much and maybe even more than this, the first film. It is visually rich and enjoyable as are many of this genre.

This is one of the best movies I have seen and I hope a sequel is coming soon. The score is great as is the acting and entire production. This is what a movie should be. It is fast paced and visually astonishing. I like it with the theater sound up. One does not get bogged down in the story as it is pretty straight forward making it more fun. I highly recommend this movie. It is fun and light enjoyment. Wish I had seen this in IMAX, however, enjoyable at home.
Love this series. Great characters and lots of fun! I hope this series produces more great episodes. I highly recommend this season.

We love this series so much that we watch it while having dinner. We find that the cheerful atmosphere lends a positive note to the evening. We have been watching from season one and have enjoyed every minute.

We have been watching Big Bang Theory from season one and find that as time goes on that the series is maturing. We are enjoying the occasional cameo by celebrities and especially Wil Wheaton who brings a lot of fun to the series.
Season one is really a must have season. We have really enjoyed seeing how the Big Bang Theory series started and this season introduces the cast in a very entertaining fashion.
Just as the other seasons, we have found this one just as fun. We recommend this entire series for a very entertaining time.
We have been watching Big Bang Theory just recently and fellin love with the cast and their great performances and the very funny dialogue. We find this series worth watching over and over.

This DVD has many of my Holiday favorites that our family enjoys every Christmas season. Anyone who has this DVD will tell you how much fun it is to watch with all generations. These are classics that have survived the test of time.

This is my favorite Jeff Daniels movie. It is one of those movies that is funny and gives me a warm. fuzzy, delightfulframe of mind. It is easy to transport oneself to Escanaba and feel as though you are right there in the woods. Thecharacters are hilarious and Jeff Daniels is natural and at his best. I talked like a Yooper for days after watchingthis movie. Eh? I even made pasties. Tradition at its best.
It was requested by a friend. They got a kick out of receiving it.
Purchased as a gift. They loved it. Excellent picture quality, practically new. Great story telling, many older, now deceased actors. Very pleased with purchase.
Love it, very different. Theres going to be a lot of AI shows now, this one is pretty good.
I read the novels, I like this guy as Harry
It has definitely grown on me.
Absolutely great, really enjoyed the collection
Unusual psychological thriller dealing with multiple personalities and old Appalachian witchcraft andor legends. I thought it was quite entertaining, I enjoy the bizarre and unpredictable fictions.
It was OK. I really was not that impressed.
This set is amazing. Well worth the money. I can watch this anytime I want to relive the memories of a group of scifi greats. Great to compare to Prometheus.
Its nice to be able to get a copy of these oldies but goodies. They just dont make them like they used to.

This was awful. Lacks all of the fun and energy expected from a Bond film. The female 007 seems just thrown into the mix to make a political statement; that character doesnt really even need to be in there. Also geesh could they have lit or dressed that poor actress any worse? Even her dialogue is mushy and hard to make out, she was badly recorded. Everybody is such a yawn. Classic Bond films are filled with dynamic characters and distinctive performers who spark on camera. The film is predictable and drags for lengthy segments, with a few brief almost-Bond-Film-worthy action sequences that never quite nail it. A lot of it makes you cringe with empathetic embarrassment for the actors. This is definitely one you can miss.

The first episode is good but the show gets even better as it goes along. Its fun, silly, witty, goofy, touching, and offers some great spookiness. All of the characters are appealing, and the performances and direction suit the vibe of the show. I liked the pacing, editing, and other technical aspects; the somewhat low-end feel works because the story follows a Youtube ghosthunter, so you stay in the feel of that kind of footage and presentation. It appears that the first season was done in 2020, so apparently they dont plan to do any more, which I think is unfortunate, as this show offers a lot and seemed to have a great team that put it together.

Well crafted film with a retro 50s theme that enhances the suspense by relying upon technology available back then. Subtle elements enhance the sense of being absorbed in the story in an almost dream-like way. Dialog heavy, but it works due to the nature of the story, along with quality editing and performances. Other craft elements such as lighting, sound, and sets are all well done. The film doesnt rely upon gore, sex, or foulness to tell its tale. There are a couple of swear-words timely incorporated, and thats about it. After seeing so many badly made programs lately, this was rewarding to invest my time in.

There is literally nothing well done in this film. Theres not much else to say. The craft aspects are awful. Acting and directing are awful to the point of being cringeworthy. Dialog is so bad Im sure whoever wrote the screenplay is someones relative who scored the job on family connections only. The script likewise seems written by coddled, inexperienced, untalented people who have zero insight, awareness or observational skills of pretty much anything. It is without a doubt one of the worst films Ive ever seen. Im confused at how this ever got out of post-production.

It was cute, but I cant imagine how this premise, as it is handled here, can hold up for an entire season or more of episodes. This reminded me of skit or improv-type work. A translucent fourth wall with heavy leaning upon dated references for humor is fun for a few minutes, but then starts to feel sort of pathetic.
I guess if you are in the mood for a film that starts on a down-note, and becomes more and more of a downer from there until pretty much the last couple of minutes, here you go.

A few factors made this show better than I expected.The competitors all had prior experience with baking. One isnt watching a bunch of complete amateurs. I found it informative, as the contestants used techniques on a more professional level. Their discussions and comments were often informative. I learned quite a bit simply from watching the competition.The setting was appealing. An airy tent, festooned with pennant Union Jack banners and views of a beautiful lawn and garden area, is much better than a typical studio set. Each contestant had a well designed compact kitchen set-up, and everything was open and easy to see from all angles. The camera work was great, as was the lighting.The two judges were sincere, considerate but honest, charming, and knowledgeable. Their comments were also quite informative.The baking challenges were intense. These certainly didnt seem to be easy tasks. So the program generated a fair amount of suspense, without relying on negative drama and histrionic behavior for viewing interest. The competitors dove in and all did an impressive job generally, especially considering the circumstances under which they were working. They also showed a nice sense of camaraderie, sincerely supporting each other while being clearly competitive. The casting of the competitors was excellent, with a good range of different types of people that were all charming and impressively creative.The only thing I disliked were the two hostesses. They generally came off to me as irritating and just sort of weird. They were given lines or improvised that were intended to be humorous, but their delivery was nearly always flawed, and their humor juvenile. They also frequently chose to speak in really annoying "funny" voices, notably every time they announced the start of a challenge with "BAKE!" I quickly came to dread their bits during the programs. Still, they both seem like nice people who were genuinely into it.Note that this show will definitely stimulate your appetite! But it is also inspirational. I actually baked the night I watched the second show because of it.

This is so heavy-handed, its like a bunch of Neanderthals put it together.I was willing to put up with the bombastic direction and performances, but the choice to have the mother speak in a manner that sounds worse than someone scraping their fingernails down a chalkboard forced me to give it up. Perhaps her voice reflects an uber-realistic interpretation of the character, but it makes listening to the program a form of torture. Actually she isnt the only performer in the program whose voice made me want to shut the door on these people.

The production values were higher than I was expecting. Likewise with the casting, direction, and performances taking into account that this is a heavy-handed genre. The film is not excessively gory, with the bad guys verging on being humorous while still creepy. It is a predictable plot, and on the slow and uneventful side, but okay if you are in the mood for some casual watching.

Im all for being lenient with irrational plot points, but this film is riddled with so many ludicrous decisions chosen to drive the plot forward that it squashes suspense and atmosphere. Blatantly obvious good choices available to the protagonists are ignored in favor of doing something ineffectual instead. The films structure highlights rather than misdirects away from these weaknesses. Some films are able to distract from irrationality problems through various tricks, but this film doesnt succeed in that regard. Beyond that, it is ponderous, predictable, lacking in character development, unappealing and uninteresting. The only plus is that the female protagonist is brave and not a helpless quitter.
A confrontational film that is suspenseful and moves at a good pace. Some twists and turns that explore a number of issues.

An excellent film that I think would be particularly good for children studying World War II to watch. It gives some insight into the war on a personal level. The story and the men definitely deserve five-star ratings. The film is well-crafted, with a visceral directness and suspense that doesnt overshadow the exploration of the characteristics that helped these men survive. The only reason I didnt give the film a 5-star rating is that it doesnt quite score on artistry as, for example, a film like Apocalypse Now features.

Okay honestly its a low-budget film with amateurish characteristics. But there is one brief scene that is hilarious and I thought it was worth it just for that.Its certainly not the worse film at this production level that Ive seen.

I found this to be formulaic and predictable from the start. I cant really comment on why because I dont want to spoil the film for someone else, but the film still is suspenseful in the sense that I was hoping maybe my initial assumptions were wrong. Its a nicely crafted, directed and acted piece, with the sort of claustrophobic vibe reliant on multiple hints via symbolism that one would expect in a dream-state. I also did not find this to be really a horror film at all, even considering a few scenes are dark. Actually it is surprising how unterrifying the dark scenes are, which is an interesting aspect of the film in itself, and relevant to the overall theme.The film has English subtitles, which are well done and concise, so as not to distract from the film itself.

Watching this was like discovering an old scifi B movie that you somehow missed before.It is reasonably lively and suspenseful with a lot of unintentional or was it? humor, with some notably hilarious dialogue. Features all the cliches that youd expect to find in a classic B film.

A rare truly excellent film. I really am grateful to every person who funded and worked on this film so that I could have the great experience of enjoying it. It gave me the feeling that I have when I am lucky enough to come across a truly great scifi novel, the type you cant put down. There is a sort of geologicalatmospheric symbolism going on in tangent with Time-Space dynamics that hits you in a visceral way. The human element is solid and genuine, without seeming tacked on to the scifi parts. Everything is woven together just right. Okay, their hair doesnt float in Zero G but hey, I can overlook that. :

This guys films are always enjoyable for the gentleness of the stories and the humor. Serious themes are explored and serious things happen, but the overall vibe retains a classic old-school American cinema quality. The characters fit certain iconic personality types, but each has something quirky or different enough to keep them from seeming cliched or too predictable. This has a great cast with excellent chemistry between them. Everything feels very natural even though the story is presented in a stylized way, with a lot of events and issues taking place quickly. I particularly liked the exploration of the issue of Christianity in Christmas celebrations and displays, a timely topic of freedom of religion and free speech in our nation. The film in a sense uses a feather to strike a heavy blow against negating the religious ideals that many people wish to be free to make during the Christmas season.

Kind of insulting to the viewer actually. As is all too common in films, young women are presented as essentially idiotic, helpless bimbos. The acting throughout is awful, presumably due to awful directing decisions, since we know at least some of this cast can deliver. The casting seemed wrong for every character as well. The story is ponderous, boring and predictable. Overall the film is just so shallow that it could have been made in Flatland.

It is impossible to take this so-called experiment seriously when utterly inaccurate measurements were used.Just a few examples:-He uses flatware "eating teaspoons" as if they were actual "measuring teaspoons". The two are entirely different in terms of measurements.-He uses novelty measuring cups which are likely to be inaccurate; it is surprisingly hard to find truly accurate measuring cups-but he should have tried, if he wanted anyone to take this experiment seriously.-Further, he doesnt even use the measuring cups he has properly. To properly measure, you fill entirely and then level off. He would either underfill or overfill. Likewise when he was scooping amounts with a spoon, each spoonful varied in amount from the next.-When he scoops out portions with an eating spoon, he generally heaps it overfull. This typically equals more like one tablespoon. So, for example, if he added ten of these "teaspoons" to his dish, he wasnt eating "ten teaspoons" but more like THIRTY teaspoons.-I question the accuracy of the claim that the "average" Australian eats 40 teaspoons of sugar daily. Further, his documentary experiment is flawed, in that if such average is correct, that allows for people eating actual sweets, which he stated he did not do. So, in essence, if he is claiming that the average Australian is consuming 40 teaspoons of sugar daily in just regular foods, then that in itself means the so-called average quoted is utterly incorrect, since the average includes the consumption of sweets.-So, assuming that throughout his experiment he remained so careless about accurate measuring, he was not consuming 40 teaspoons of sugar daily, but 120 teaspoons of sugar daily. So yes I imagine he would get fat etc. by consuming three times the normal amount every day.For a documentary that has a main premise so reliant on accurate measurement comparison, I find it amazing that no one involved in this project bothered to address that very basic flaw.

While laid up for 10 days with Covid, I was hunting for something different on tv that wouldnt require brain effort to follow. Voila! Canal living in England.I remember seeing narrowboats and locks and the canals on a trip to England years ago so a chance to delve into more detail was appealing. The entire show is slow, soothing and just light fun.We did the RV life full time for two years in the US and this is very similar, but significantly less stressful and more relaxed.
I have always loved this movie. Its classic Steve Martin comedy without being over the top. The house in this movie is just gorgeous.

I liked this movie. It was not an action flick or overwrought in any way. Frankly, I could not care less about any lessons or statements intended. I was interested in the characters and in the end, this soft dystopian fiction with a happy ending.

I remember a couple of years ago an acquaintance harassed me multiple times to join this pyramid scheme selling sweat pants. leggings, I guess. She went on and on to everyone we jointly knew about her get rich quick nonsense and the awesome clothes she was hawking. It was laughable, sad and ridiculous. I had no idea that this LuLaRoe or whatever was so widespread and cult like. We all just thought she was being scammed on a more localized level and looking like a 7 year old in the tasteless clothing she was so desperate to sell us.This company and others like them. Amway etc need to all be outlawed. Vulnerable people who either gullible or greedy get trapped in debt and the constant pressure. Yet they really never get ahead and become solvent. Multi level marketing is a pyramid scheme and theres absolutely no reason for it to allowed in any way or shape. The last I heard, our acquaintance was selling her inventory for 5 a bag full at a local flea market.

Somehow, back in the day when Lost aired once a week, I lost track of it around Season 4. I never finished the series. So now Im back to start again and watch it all the way through.I had forgotten just how well done this show iswas. The opening scenes of episode one snatch your attention and just hold you throughout. The mysteries begin to pile up left and right. Anything is possible and theres still comic relief via Sawyer.

I love a period show with the costumes and intrigue. Unfortunately, this is just a choppy, scatter shot mess. Overacting, actors obviously too old for their characters, bizarre and jarring music choices and a plot that makes no sense and goes nowhere. After 1 and a half episodes, Im out.

I love Tim and will watch this strictly for him. However, they can send Naomi Campbell packing. Her attitude is just entitled and condescending toward everyone.I like seeing a different class of designers trying out here compared to the old Project Runway. These folks had much more grown-up takes on clothes and dressing a wider variety of customers - not just the size 4, 6 feet tall waifs you see stalking the runways.

Finally. A Star Trek that feels like real people with real emotions, reactions, humor and drama. The traditional Star Trek world building and canon is upheld here, but the characters are darker, fuller and better. Im fully addicted.

Im on episode 3 of Season 1 an Im hooked. Queen Latifa is just so good. She has a charisma on screen combined with legit acting skills that makes you lose track of time.Yes, some of the physical fights are over the top and unrealistic - she never has a bruise after a 3 person fist fight. Nonetheless, the show is good enough for me to overlook some nonsense. Theres a little humor, some clever dialogue and lots of action.

This is very much a nod to old film noir style of who dun it movies. Theres certainly a bit of comedy tossed in and Mr. Blanc has a hint of Nick from the Thin Man movies of 30s. It was a nice twist ending that was both ridiculous and satisfying.

We have loved Doc Martin for all 9 seasons and were very glad to see at least one more season is coming along. This is smart, compassionate and funny television without being over dramatic or mushy. Season 9 brings some shocks and some joy and puppies. I hope they give us a clean final season that ties up the loose ends and acknowledgement from Port Wenn for Doc Martins hard work and honesty towards his patients and family.

I have to say that I like this TV adaptation more than I expected. I liked the movie a lot, but was unsure how a TV show would work.The show is giving us flashback style backstory here and there. That really adds depth and answers questions left from the movie. The different train cars are well done and in great detail as each episode discovers more of the train. Well keep watching for sure.

Im surprised by how much we like this. Its definitely a soap opera, but disguised as a drama and history lesson. The acting is solid and each storyline melds with the others to create a twisty, sidewinding and addictive show. The villains are truly despicable and worth hating.

Brusque, grouchy, disinterested in emotional entanglements and funny all describe the Doc. Yet he still has heart and you grow attached to him. The Portwenn villagers are comfortable, silly, and earnest with a huge dash of eccentricity. My husband and I both love this show.

Outstanding. After the trainwreck of Tales From the Loop, we were wary of Upload. Turns out this is funny, mart, interesting and just a tad twisty. I love the idea of Lakeside as an endless, reinventable heaven with the catch of requiring an endless data subscription that costs a fortune. The show is clever and unique - the Grey Market freakshow full of sketchy third party sellers of sketchy uploads was great. The actors have some chemistry together and that makes everything flow smoothly.

I love a fun, fast moving disaster movie and this one is pretty darn good. There are several enormous plot holes, but thats ok.this isnt a documentary after all. I love the design of the Ark ships. The special effects were loads if fun. This is a popcorn, margarita, rainy night and good company sort of movie.

Ok there are definitely plot holes throughout the entire movie. But.its still a fun way to kill a couple of hours during quarantine. The world outside the train is terrifying and fascinating and I wish we knew more about it. The interior of train is a micro civilization complete with good, evil, insanity, love, despair and hope. We enjoyed the movie, but cannot see how an entire tv series will work from this.

This is a mash up of Twilight Zone, Eureka, and Stranger Things without the humor, warmth or fine story telling of any of those shows. We watched 4 episodes and decided thats all we care to see. All were filmed with this overtly extra dramatic nonsense trying to be artsy. Trying so hard just leaves every scene shot too dark, in dreary colors and moving at a glacial pace.The stories all loosely connect, but truly, none of the characters feel important or worth caring about. The underlying ideas of AI, time manipulation and mind swapping are all things that can and have made for terrific sci-fi, just not in this series. Its slow with bad music and no action or forward movement for most of each episode.

We need to watch more foreign films. The Korean Zombies are freaky fast and vicious! This is both smart and scary with a dash of humor here and there. The movie accomplishes a ton in the relatively tight, tiny spaces of a train. That ratchets up the tension without feeling forced. Well done and better than a lot of of the US zombie stories.

This is one of the few movies that I dont mind watching more than once. The chemistry among the actors is good and you can accept the as friends from the beginning. The special effects are good and the idea of a split second deep freeze is terrifying. Definitely a solid movie choice if youre stuck at home during the quarantine.

Im in the middle of a trial of Acorn and I have fallen in love with several shows so far, including this one. First, I could look,at Aaron Pedersen all day long. I had no idea this mini series was based on existing characters from a movie collection - Ill be looking for those next.The landscape of the town and cattle station is just beautiful - reminded me of Deep West Texas. Its rugged, dusty, hot, rough country and all of the characters reflected that. None of them were fake Hollywood in pristine makeup or hair. they feltlooked real. The story builds slowly and picks up the pace as the mystery unfolds and we learn more in each episode. The ending wasnt outstanding, but it did make sense.

Ive been down with flu that became pneumonia for the last 14 days. TV is a sanity saver when you feel this bad and are bedridden. Ive been binging tons of shows that I never really paid attention too before, including Bobs Burgers. This is smarter than it seems at first glance and has a lot of heart. It has definitely grown on me and season 5 has been the best one so far.

The colorized update is great. So much more fun to see the dresses and various decorations in the houses in color. I loved this show as a child and I still love it now. Its clean, feel good entertainment. No violence, no drugs and random silliness is a nice way to spend rainy winter evening.

Yawn. This is badly acted with a pretty low level script and dialogue. Its like a terrible, off brand copy cat of the outstanding Big Chill. Just without the stellar cast, realistic interactions and chemistry. The characters felt extra angsty and stupid. Boozing your way through infidelity and immaturity is just not funny or compelling.

Not living in a vacuum, I had heard of the Chinese One Child Policy, but never fully understood the implications of that. Rather than providing birth control for couples at no cost China punished and tormented women after the fact when they got pregnant a second time. The millions of forced abortions and fetal bodies simply disposed of in public dumps is horrifying.The abandonment of thousands and thousands of babies to die in the streets or be sold off for adoption boggles the mind. It does not matter what the reasoning was for the One Child Policy. The entire program was evil and created monsters out of ordinary people by making them choose between murder or being tortured and killed themselves. The truth is the Chinese government is not civilized and displays zero basic compassion for people or animals.

I absolutely loved this little miniseries. It was one of those shows that felt honest and pure from minute one. No faux strife or angst and that was wonderful. The trip was amazing and his homemade wagon was ingenious.

Unbranded is the best film Ive seen in years. Quite simply these young men embody the spirit of Texas, the west and Gig Em. We have mustangs and Andalusian Mustang crosses on our West Texas ranch and I can attest to solid, honest dignity and ability these horses have that domestic breeds just cant equal.This film is beautifully shot and the scenery is hypnotic. Theres no obvious Hollywood nonsense either with the horses, the gear and the trail. The opening scene is as real as it gets - wild horses, bad cactus and a lesson learned the hard way. These young men love the horses and their passion for the project is charming, warm and rings true. I came away feeling true jealousy and the inspiration to do another long ride of my own through the Christmas and Chisos Mountains of deep West Texas.

This is not an action or horror film. Its a studied look at the effect of one Ebola patient and the medical staff treating him. Their job was to help him if possible and to protect the entire city from being exposed and infected. They fought hard and paid a huge price, but stopped the disease in its tracks in their city. The fact that this actually happened makes their quiet fear and desperation truly heartbreaking.

Sometimes you run across a hidden gem and wonder why you have never heard of it. This movie is that from. Its light and sweet and very charming. A gentle look at the changing world of women in the decade after World War Two. And an Australian point of view which something new and very nice.

This is the first tv show in years that I have been so drawn into that I turned my phone off and put away my tablet so I can focus just on the show for every episode.
