Im somewhat divided on how to review this film. I thought the first half was pretty cool. I liked the creepy doll, the creepy parents and the house in the middle of nowhere. It started out with a very Gothic feel and that excited me. I was waiting for all the unexplained creep out factor stuff to kick in. The actress was great and the supporting cast added a lot to the film. I enjoyed her struggle trying to figure out if there was something really going on or if it was all in her mind. That being said, as the movie progressed I got more and more excited, certain that I knew how it would end, but then it didnt.Instead, another character showed up inexplicably near the end of the film, changing the entire point of the movie and acting like a bad imitation of a psychotic killer. The ending was left more or less hanging, and I am still struggling to understand the how and why of it all. Some movies that leave an ending open to interpretation work well, but for me, this was not one of those cases. It just irked me.

I liked it well enough until the aliens cruised in and made it ridiculous.I was happy enough with this movie for the first two thirds of the film or so. I thought the guy Goodman was just a bit off his rocker and really thought he was saving peoples lives from some disaster that probably didnt exist. I was okay with that. It seemed logical. The main character was a great and expressive actress that had a little fire in her and that was cool. But then all the stuff went down and she realised she could breathe the air that was supposed to be toxic and then aliens showed up and I lost all respect for this film. Blah. Dont spring aliens on us in the last five minutes of the film and then end the movie in such a way that we have no clue what is happening next. I was annoyed.

There were things I really liked about this film. The actors were pretty great, especially the lead actress. She has the kind of wide eyed expressive face you want to see in a movie like this. I liked the way she handled things even when she was struck down by tragedy. The revelations that come later in the film about the refugee camps and what the government is doing in a private facility are pretty awesome. I also thought the cast worked well together and had a lot of chemistry, which made the movie a lot more interesting.Really, the only thing I didnt like about this movie was the end. There really wasnt much of an ending, in my opinion. It was just sort of.done. And I still had questions I wanted answered. Hate when that happens. Either way, there were some cool scenes and it was worth the time to watch.

This movie requires a full box of tissues to watch, but it was one of the most romantic, sad and yet beautiful movies I have ever seen. I watched this with my husband after the kids went to bed and we both cried like babies at the end. I love movies that make you feel like the characters are real people that you can understand and relate to, and this film has those. There were things that made me laugh and things that made me stop and think. This is a wonderful date night movie.

This is a very cute movie with excellent animation, and fun for the whole family. My kids loved this movie from the first few minutes and we are all hoping there will be more of them out in the future. This movie doesnt have a lot of gross humour and had an interesting plot. I particularly liked the bunny cop, as she was determined and yet cute and sweet. The kind of characters I want my kids to look up to. The little people and the big people all thought this was a perfect choice for a movie night.

De Niro must be desperate for a movie role. I rented this knowing what I was getting myself into, but I was expecting it to be stupid funny not just stupid stupid. Im sorry to say that I am actually embarrassed for the actors in this film. I wouldnt want this on my resume. Seriously, this has to be one of the poorest films ever made. The movie basically has no plot and although a few times it raised a smile, I just kept thinking that none of these people will ever have the same respect they once did after this.Parents please regard the R rating for this one, unless you want your kids to get a really shocking early education. Blech!

I really expected that I would love this film because of Tina Fey. Who doesnt love her? But, to be honest, I thought this was possibly one of the most boring films of the year. Yes there were some random fight scenes and some pretty cool explosions, but this movie never captured my full attention and for being listed as a comedy on redbox, I really didnt find most of it funny.Im sure there are a lot of people who loved it, but for me, it was just okay. No plans on adding it to my collection.

I love Sally Field and have been a longtime fan of her work, so therefore I was really curious to see her in a role like this, and although there were parts of this movie I felt were a bit silly, she, as usual, made it worth watching. Especially her outfit changes throughout the film. I found parts of this film touching and easily related to some of her embarrassing situations. I think most women will relate to one of them or another. I liked that this movie ended the way it did, where we arent totally sure what is going to happen next.

This is definitely a winner when it comes to heartwarming movies the whole family can enjoy. The guy they picked to play Eddie the Eagle was a good choice. He looked similar, his antics were just about right and he was the kind of lovable hopeless character that a film like this needs. I particularly enjoyed the end of the film, and almost shed a tear or two. Almost. Overall, I thought this was a fun movie that I will likely add to my collection.

This is a beautifully made movie that is not true to history, but tells a story so amazing that you will forget about that minor detail. I really loved the acting in this film and the dialogue was so well written that I watched it again the day after I rented it. That rarely ever happens.I was enthralled with the story and the way the director worked with the actors to portray the life of a couple of artists going through major changes in their lives. The emotional angle of this film was well handled and I was impressed that the film did not make light of such a serious subject. Even the ending of the film was handled with grace. This was a great movie that I want to own.

I liked this movie quite a lot. I was thrilled with the fact that it left most of the ridiculous elements of re-enacted history alone, save for possibly the whale chasing them from scene to scene. The acting was good and it was nice to see that the director chose to leave the scenes where the characters had to make terrible decisions in order to survive, in the film rather than cutting them out in favour of more fanciful things. This is an emotionally moving film with some wonderful acting and good action scenes.I wasnt sure what I would think of it, but after watching it I can definitely say that it is one of the few movies I will probably watch again.

My kids and I watched this movie recently, and I was not prepared to be as impressed with it as I was. The acting was great, the movie was interesting and there was enough humour in it to keep us giggling throughout. Paul Rudd was very good in this film. The kids particularly got a kick out of the scenes that had Thomas the Train in them toward the end.Overall, this was a great movie to watch with older kids. I definitely want to add this one to my collection.

Good research and a well chosen cast made this an interesting film. Some of the special effects were worth the watch just by themselves. The story line was a little over the top at times and the love story a bit predictable. Some scenes reminded me of gladiator, but on a lesser scale. Overall, not bad but not the best film I have seen.

My kids really liked this collection of short films. They especially liked the one that has the birds. I was impressed that there is nothing in here that is inappropriate for young children, and even for short attention spans the films satisfy. The characters are all cute and the films are all funny and colorful. The music is nice and loud and you can either play the films one at a time or play them all at once, depending on your preference. I would recommend this to anyone who has kids, and even those who dont. Really enjoyed it.

This is a very emotional and moving movie. I thought Russell Crowe did a fantastic job of portraying John Nash and he was very believable, especially during the institution scenes. Watching him struggle with his own demons throughout the movie was pretty amazing. This movie I wouldnt recommend for the highly adventuresome movie goer. A lot of the film is very quiet and there is a lot of dialogue. While the dialogue is interesting for those who appreciate very psychology-based plots, if you are looking for mile a minute action, this isnt it.I did notice that they left out a lot of important and rather commonly known elements of the real John Nashs life. I suppose this was to make the movie fit the script, but there were some things I would have liked to have seen in the film. Perhaps if the movie had gone on to describe his later years those gaps would have been filled.Either way, if you are interested in mathematics, mental illness or just appreciate a good movie, I think this fits the bill.

Have you ever watched a movie and then thought, boy there is no one else they could have picked that would have played that role better than.so and so? Yep, that was this movie. I was thrilled that the movie was so filled with adventure and also had a great love story. If you are a fan of the classics and ave read this book, then you will know what I mean when I say movies based on classic literature sometimes tend to frighten me. Probably why it took me until now to actually sit down and watch this movie.One of the things I was the most impressed with, is that the scoundrels are really people you find it easy to dislike and the hero is really heroic. I thought the acting was wonderful and overall this was just a very well put together, exciting movie.

Well hmmm. You know? Yep. This movie does have some spectacularly cool moments. Dont get me wrong. I particularly liked Gary Oldmans portrayal of the infamous vampire. He made this role look almost as good as Bela Lugosi would have. I thought the cast was pretty good, although I found Lucy to be entirely annoying and was actually thrilled when she met her demise. I dont think thats much of a spoiler, if you have read the book or seen the countless other movies, right?What got me about this movie and made me really rather dislike it, was that it was titled "Bram Stokers Dracula." Really? I was not aware that Bram Stoker took the liberty while writing his book of telling the forlorn tale of the Romanian Ruler Vlad Tepes. The combination of these two elements may have worked for me if the movie did not sound like it was going to be based on Bram Stokers version. There is blood, boobs and silliness running rampant in this movie and although some may enjoy that, it just made me roll my eyes.In the end, I thought this was a half decent movie where the bloody love story took precedence over the actual comparison to the book it was supposedly based on.

What I liked about it: The continuing story of Shrek and Donkey was told and it was fun to see the characters back in action. The same voices returned to play the main parts. The animation, as always was top dollar. I thought the story line was well written and the music was fun, just like the other movies.The hmm: This movie wasnt as funny as the original, nor did I feel it had the same overall charm. Shrek starts the movie feeling sorry for himself and an ogre having pity party just isnt cool. The kids got bored half way through. I still like the original better.

I watched this movie with my kids last night, and it was the best childrens movie I have seen in recent years. The plot is wonderful, the voices are so perfectly Scottish and the animation is so amazing I know I have to watch it again to pick up on all the things I missed the first time.The story this movie tells is so unique and refreshing. There is a lesson in this movie, but it is delivered in a gentle way that kids will both understand and appreciate. The movie also has a lot of humor and some total snort you laugh so hard moments that even parents will get a kick out of.I just cant get over how well this movie was made. It is incredible.If I had to nominate a movie as the parents choice of the year, this would be it for sure.

I was happy to see that this movie is as funny and well animated as the first one. My kids and I laughed our way through this movie from beginning to end except for a brief sad spot near the end. The animation in this movie was even better than the first one. The colors are vibrant and the audio is nice and loud. This would make the perfect family movie for an evening in. Id recommend it to other parents. There is nothing gross in it and the humor is appropriate for even young kids.

When I saw this I knew I had to have it. Jaws remains one of my favorite books and movies of all time. This DVD has a lot of bonus materials including storyboards and outtakes. The movie is very clear and the music is nice and loud. I was happy with this version and glad I purchased it. If you want to add jaws to your collection I would recommend this DVD.

So, this is a great movie. If I hadnt read the book already I might have given it a five star rating. My problem was, after reading the book I felt there was too much information left out of the movie. I didnt really get that much of a sense of how the characters felt about the situations they were in from the movie. The book explains things so much more adequately. I did think the cast was great and did an excellent job of portraying the books characters. I Maybe its because I read more than I watch movies, but this one just felt a little flat to me. It wasnt bad, I just didnt think it was as great as I had heard.

Hotel Transylvania was a movie that my family and I got a big kick out of. Adam Sandler was the perfect voice and personality to make Count Dracula come to life. The supporting cast was wonderful and the overall movie was pretty funny. There is some bathroom humor in this movie, so if that offends you or if you dont want your kids watching it, you should be aware before you let them view it. It isnt anything vile, but there are some references to things that not all parents will find appropriate.What I did like about this movie, was that the story line was strong. The father was trying to protect his daughter and as the movie progresses, aside from the humor and the silliness, the movie actually has a point, which is saying something for an animated movie these days. I loved that all of the original horror characters like the invisible ,an, the hydra and and the werewolves were involved in the story.All in all, this movie made us laugh a lot. The kids enjoyed it from beginning to end and the animation was great. Id recommend it.

The graphics in this movie are some of the best I have ever seen. The owls look so real and the world they soar through is truly a fine example of digital art. The movie itself, had my kids pretty much glued to the TV throughout. The sound was the only problem we found, no matter how we set out TV up, the voices in the movie were so quiet we could barely understand them. Not sure if that was a problem with my particular DVD or not. Otherwise, excellent movie and highly recommended.

This movie had some funny spots that made me and my kids laugh. I was a bit disappointed that the original cast wasnt doing the voices. The animation was pretty good as you would expect, but I didnt feel this movie lived up to the first one in the regard that there just wasnt as many lol moments. The kids liked it well enough, but I would take the original any day.

I picked these up just before Christmas last year and have finally made my way through all of the films. First things first, some of these movies are terrible. I expected that. Being a lover of all things black and white and B movies, the horror classics included in this 50 volume set thrilled me to no end. If you love the old vampire films and spooky graveyards at night, this is a great collection for you. The DVDs are arranged in small envelopes and without the book in the front, you might get a little frustrated trying to find the movie you are searching for, but otherwise I liked it a lot.

If you are looking for serious films that are conversation starters later, go somewhere else. If you are like me and want to plop on the couch with a bowl of popcorn and watch movies where you can see the strings holding up the spaceship.well this is the DVD collection for you. The films are all old, super cheesy and all put a smile on my face. The discs are organized in black paper envelopes and the booklet in the front tells you which movie is on what disc. This can get confusing since the disks all look the same and the titles are very small, but otherwise, I like this set very much. I would recommend this to the sci-fi buffs. Classic.

Oh ugh. Im not even sure what to say about this poor excuse for a movie. I have always been interested in this case, and I suppose I fooled myself into thinking there was enough historical evidence to stretch it out for a full length movie. If you have doubts about this movie, allow me to assist you in your choice. SAVE YOURSELF! DONT DO IT! STEP AWAY FROM THE PROVERBIAL LEDGE! There is really no nice way to say that this movie just stinks. Worse than gym socks. The movie isnt really even about the Black Dahlia. I wont give away the entire plot as I dont want to spoil it right like it could get worse but I will say that if you are watching this movie because you care about the history of the actual case, you will be sorely disappointed. If you watch it because you like seeing a shirtless Josh Hartnett.maybe it deserves more stars. I hated it!

I expected to really like this movie as I love Chicken Run, but it just wasnt what I was expecting. The humor seemed to come in spurts but the stuff that was actually worthy of provoking more than a half-smile just wasnt frequent enough. The animation was pretty good and the storyline was pretty original, but I just didnt get the enjoyment out of this one that I thought I would. Even my kids didnt love this as much as I had hoped they would. They tired of watching it halfway through and found other things to entertain themselves. I suppose if you really love pirates or you really love claymation, it might work. I just didnt think it was as good as the hype.

I couldnt imagine watching this movie and not falling in love with it. The little mouse is so adorable and the movie has such good animation. Usually when I see the a story book come to life, I always like the book better, but I feel like they did such an excellent job of making this movie, that it really reflects the story accurately.My kids have watched this movie over and over again and never seem to tire of it. The version we have has the Gruffalos child on it as well, which is also a great movie. I would recommend this to parents as a nice, clean movie for kids.

I didnt like this movie as much as I thought I would. When held in comparison to other Tim Burton films this one fell a bit short in my opinion. The constant black and white felt a bit dreary after a while and although the characters were cute, I had trouble paying attention to this movie. My kids watched it with me and a certain part of it made them sad enough to cry. I thought it was creative and the animation was pretty good, but it just wasnt a movie I really look forward to watching again.

My kids got a kick out of this movie and it kept them entertained for the duration of the movie. For me.eh, not so much. I was looking forward to the scene between Norman and the frog in a jar and it wasnt in the movie. I know that sounds silly, but it was one of my favorite parts of the book and so to not have it in there was a let down. The graphics were good and there were a few parts that actually roused a laugh from me, but for the most part, I thought the movie was only half as good as the book was. The kids wanted to watch it again, so for them it was a good experience, but I just didnt love it as much as I had hoped I would. It wasnt awful, I just thought it could have been better.

I watched this movie with my kids yesterday and I was somewhat surprised that we laughed all the way through it. Unlike the last few Ice Age movies, it seems the writers actually remembered what made these movies so great in the first place. I thought the introduction of teenaged-drama with Peaches was a nice way to go with the storyline as it broke up the monotony. How anyone can watch this movie and not fall head over heels in love with Granny would be beyond me. She was our favorite part of the movie for sure.As always, the animation was great and I was pleased to see that Scrat had some pretty good screen time. Overall We found this movie to be a worthwhile addition to our collection. Great family entertainment.

Acting-A - the acting is so believable the actors carry you thru the bad parts of the story line. terrific acting.Plot- B- Too many times where its too annoyingly hard to follow. Chronology is sometimes impossible to decipher in the flashbacks, but it is incredibly unique. I despise flashbacks, but this show is at least 12 flashbacks and I got addicted to it despite them. It took a week when I was sick to binge watch it. But up until 4th season there arent enough words to describe how fantastic and addictive this show is. 4th season starts a different time line of events and totally screws up chronology. 5th season sort of explains the new timeline. 6th season makes it look like everything could possibly work out right.[spoiler alert]Not. The end is very unsatisfying and doesnt live up to the build-up especially if you are Christian. You could look at the end in a bit more cerebral way and say Even going thru Hell on the Island they all made it to Heaven. But it is never what you go thru that gets you to Heaven, and there is absolutely nothing you can do that gets you to Heaven. Its believing what Jesus did on the Cross and rising to life that takes you there.

Innovative show. Not the same ole crime drama. Superb acting all the way. It was a great premise. Some episodes are thought provoking. And they have a nice touch of humor. Well worth time spent watching.

As each tidbit spilled out into the public arena, I could tell something stank to high heaven in the deep state. This put all the pieces together in a coherent flow. If only Congress would get some guts to instigate the consequences deserved by the liars and cheaters we could finally call the US Justice system great again. If only the fake news proponents would swallow some truth pills we might could trust them again.Not.

Starts out great. But no wonder there are so many smartalec kids in the world, they have so many stereotypes like the little girl in this movie. Nothing new in comedy or dialogue. The dog is adorable and hilarious. The kid is not adorable or funny. It isnt her fault, its stereotypical writing and directing. Dave Bautista is good like Vin Diesel in the Pacifier-good facial expressions and he has a fish named Blueberry.If you like smartalec kids and a script that makes the kid seem smarter than adults, youll like this movie-otherwise stay away.

Terrific movie. Reminiscent of Jane Austins kind of character development - completely modern, of course. No sex scenes, no horrible language. Extremely well articulated - the actors speak so you can understand them. A story about two very different people who find wholeness and love in the others differences. Very well done.

First, this movie is rather graphic in places, and the language is kinda foul in places, but not excessively so, although Gods name is taken in vain-but frankly it is used as a curse on the person, but flippantly, so I guess it isnt in vain.I normally have the whodunit solved by the middle of a movie. not so. The one who I thought it was all the evidence if very convincing I was sure and decided not to watch the rest because it was so easy to figure out. So I fast forwarded a bit and discovered it wasnt the person I thought. The reason it is hard to figure out is because you arent given ALL the facts. But then that is rather real life isnt it? You really dont have all the facts about another person.The suspense is good. The character development is great. Each person suspicion falls upon has motive until you getdig a little deeper. Then one by one the usual suspects are eliminated and the motive dissipates for that suspect. When you finally figure out the motive then you know whodunit.

This is a very good movie. The acting is pretty good, but does leave a bit to be desired. However, the story outweighs that. It says it is based on actual events, but Im not sure I believe that. The suspense is good, the tension is believable, and the boys are cute. One thing. that church wasnt a Southern Baptist church-just sayin

After I got over the fact the intro had nothing to do with the story, it is only backstory that you get in bits and pieces during the six episodes, I was able to really enjoy this mystery unfold. I dont like it when a mystery is told from 2 or 3 points of view. This one is from 2 POVs. The solicitor and the cleaner, NSA or CIA or someone who cleans up messes.It has a premise that is engrossing, but the outcome, the reason behind it all, is not quite plausible to me, but Ill leave that for you to decide for yourself.Acting is superb. The story wraps around you so you might as well settle in for a cozy 6 hours-you wont want to stop watching no matter how late. It is a sophisticated plot with many prongs and few red herrings. So each moment, each fact, each disclosure brings you closer to what really happened to Linda Simms that night.

Inspired by a true story. This is a wonderful movie, fairly good acting - by both the good guys and the bad guys. Its one of those movies that when youre done watching it, you feel better about people and you really dont feel like youve wasted your time. Faith-based film. PG-13 because of mature subject matter, not for foul language or for any graphic scenes. Worth your time.

I really like Nicholas Cage and John Cusak. Powerful acting to portray a story from real life. I question the how Cindy could get so dumb after reading Hansen so accurately in the beginning especially after being so heart-stopping scared. I figure thats Hollywood for you-the real story has to be jazzed up to make it "better." Not. However, desperation makes a person do some stupid things, and Cindy was desperate.Since it was Nicholas Cage, I knew it would have a lot of F-bombs, and it did. I wasnt prepared for the nudity and torture though. I fast forwarded through all that and didnt miss a thing.The movie was good. Not something Id watch again.

Good story, good premise. Well executed. Wish Tom Skerritt had a bigger part! Worth watching.But PLEASE children, when you walk on any roadway, PLEASE walk facing traffic NOT with traffic. No wonder that truck almost ran over her.

Wonderful! An excellent murder mystery equal to Agatha Christie and Sherlock Holmes. Lots of twists and turns, bu Mr. Whicher is good at what he does.The acting is excellent. I love the nuance of expressions that speak volumes without a torrent of words. Just excellent. Cant wait to watch the other two.

Classic Christie, however, unlike almost every Christie book Ive read something about the era and the setting didnt quite mesh. Maybe it was the nuances in the acting. But. The book was published in 1949, and I really wish the setting had stayed true to the era it was published. There are references to several things that would have been normal in 1949, but really strange in 1957. The rock n roll scene wasnt all that true to 1957, more like 1967, and that surprises me greatly because Jullian Fellowes helped write the screenplay. But then, I doubt there are many people watching this film that were even alive in 1957.The house is magnificent, Glenn Close is superb. The actors both from the U.S. and across the pond were all superb. The story very close to the book, some license was taken when moving it to 1957. Well worth your time and money.

Isnt it amazing! Great story, great special effects, pretty good acting, AND Clive Owen even though he plays a bad guy. all without foul language. See Hollywood, it can be done, and its still an exciting movie.

Extremely good.The opening is a bit gory. I cant imagine anyone doing something like that for revenge [not a spoiler]. The acting is superb, and there are some humorous spot if you like British humor, which I do.The premise is quite good, and I found the numerous references comparing Sir Arthur to Sherlock a bit of cream in my coffee. The story line weaves in and out and in again around the small town of Worley sp? and Crannock. The substory of Arthurs love affair with Jean winds through the plot at wonderful places. As it unfolds you discover several reasons why Artur is so animated when it comes to Georges innocence. The mystery is very good, and I really like it that you find out pertinent details when Arthur and Woodie find out.This was all around a very good story. The suspense is light, but the mystery is deep. Keeps you guessing to the end, which is another thing I particularly like in mysteries. The similarity to Sherlock Holmes is almost parallel, but as Georges sister points out, Sherlock is wrong occasionally.

Emily Blunt is a fascinating actor, but this film, script, and director dumbed her down and dampened her strong character into nothing. My favorite actor in the whole thing was Jeffery Donovan, and he had maybe 5 lines? I expected a lot more and got a very shallow something that left me wishing Id gone to bed to read a good book instead. What a waste. Beside all the foul language what do you expect for an R rated film? the characters were cardboard, never developed. In the trivia thingy, the director took out 90 of Del Toros dialogue. What? No wonder he was cardboard.The scenery is fantastic if you like desert, dry mountains, and fascinating topography. I loved it. At least the cinematography was well done, and you could see faces, and the music didnt drown out the actors talking. I just hate that when it happens.The story revolves around the unlimited unfettered flow of drugs into the U.S. and prosecuting the mules and the middle guys does nothing to stem the tide. So, according to Hollywood, the best way to fight the nasties is fighting nasty with no morals, no ethics, and a lot of bullets. Theres a Mexican cop that you see snippets of him sleeping, and talking with his son, and eating breakfast several times, but I guess since [spoiler alert, although he doesnt have that big a part] he works for the drug cartel he deserves to die with a bullet in his back just so the guy can get to the head of the snake. And since the head of the snake kills families, and made a mess of Del Toros family, his family gets to die in front of him.This movie crossed the boundary into all kinds of wrong. Why is Hollywood so fascinated with trying to make us believe the end justifies the means? So glad I didnt pay for this movie.

Probably the best of all the movies. Suspense abounds-especially the sewer scenes can hardly believe they shot those scenes in a real sewer. Katniss is so true to herself that [spoiler alert] the ending makes a LOT of sense to the other movies. Something happens, something so ultra wicked and heart breaking that Katniss finally realizes whats truly going on behind the scenes. I might have figured it out at the end of 3, but I was too captivated and engaged in the movie to do that. Loved it.

A clever and funny film, though not quite on the level of Alexander Paynes best films. But I do love the way our effects on the climate are smartly explored in this movie. And really good performances from Matt Damon and the cast. But I think the film ran out of steam before the end. Still, a very good movie.

This may not be up there with Boogie Nights or There Will Be Blood, but even PTA on a lesser day is better than most filmmakers will ever be. The movie never comes together one hundred percent, but there are so many great moments. so many terrific performances. Just so watchable!

The Boys S3 continues to be subversive and just deliciously wrong. By the end of three full seasons, there were times I felt the show might be a little played out. But then it would bounce back with something fresh and wild. Herogasm! Count me in. This is definitely not Marvel. I like Marvel, but its nice to see something else that doesnt move or feel at all like standard comic book stuff. Id go for another season. And Ill be watching for spin-offs!
Really good film. Love is love, even in rural America. Good writing and Mark Whalberg is excellent in the lead. I strongly recommend it.

While Sean Connery will always be the ultimate Bond, Daniel Craig is a close second. And he gets a great send off here in his 5th and final Bond film. Really, a satisfying arc to the Daniel Craig series of Bond films. I actually cried at the end! I dont think Ive ever done that at a Bond film before. Yes, it was a little long. And although I love Rami Malek, he wasnt the greatest villain. But it was a fun film with some great effects and chases. I cant wait to see where the Bond films go from here!
I was pleasantly surprised how much I liked this film. I think the critics underrated it. Its appealing and entertaining. And I really loved the characters. Good film!

Ive always liked films that feel lived in. I dont know if any of the things depicted in the film happened in reality. But the feel real and believable enough that they could have. I was absorbed by this. An artful blending of realistic drama and suspense. Kudos.

Woody Allens best films were almost all in the 70s, 80s and 90s. But for a later Allen film, this had its moments. Elle Fanning steals the show and turns in a terrific performance. And the film was beautifully shot. If youve seen lots of Allen films, the themes will be familiar. And the movie is a bit hit and miss. But like I said, it had its moments.

If youve ever known anyone with Alzheimers, this film and its brilliant deconstruction of time and place do an incredible job of capturing the confusion and disorientation of dementia. Its so well written and masterfully laid out, you wont understand all the fragments yourself at first. Brilliantly takes the viewer into that frightening and upsetting experience. And what can I say about Anthony Hopkins performance? Hes been turning in one great performance after another for decades, and this is one of his best ever. Not an easy film, but well worth the watch.

Wonderfully made, this was an eye opening series of films for me. I really knew very little about people in the U.K. with a culture of West Indies origin. Im ashamed to admit I wasnt aware about the extreme levels of systematic racism they were subjected to. This was a powerful series. I now want to go watch the 1980 UK film Babylon, which I now understand was a decades earlier forerunner of this series.

I could have given this one star, because its really that much of a weird mess. But I watched it all the way through, so I guess Ill give it two stars. I kept thinking, its Andrew Garfield. And some of the reviews are so positive. It has to get better, right? Nope. Just ick.

This is a film that can be really funny, but it also has real depth to it. Its smart, with a great story and terrific characters. I particularly loved the Sunday character. You just had to cheer for her and her sisters. Its a lean, fast movie - just a little over an hour - with an excellent comedydrama mix. Five well earned stars!

I cant say this wasnt an affecting film. And its not impossible for people to come together and help others. But how often does that really happen for single mothers in need? I didnt dislike the film, but I didnt really believe the reality it was portraying, either.
When Groundhog day came out it was a really fresh idea. Now we get a couple GD themed movies a year. This film was cute, but being stuck in a time loop is just getting a little old.

I admire that this film depicts a very grim, post-apocalyptic setting and really goes for it. Doesnt hold back. Its not a story for the faint of heart or anyone looking for something feel good. But I loved it. I have a thing for survival themed films and this one had me the whole way. It pulled me in with a very human story at the center of this dark reality. I cared, a lot. Which is more than I can say for some the films that just got nominated for the Golden Globes. Its also just a very well done, well shot film. It was a take no prisoners story that really paid off for me.

Overall, I think this was a very fine film. Affecting, intelligent. And a great meeting of the minds what-if scenario. Some things were better than others. The actor who played Ali nailed a young version of The Greatest. The Malcolm X character was played with some of the real Malcoms fervor and zeal. But having read Malcom Xs biography, I find the real Malcolm was stronger and, at times, more severe than he was played here. I understand though the film wanted to capture more of his humanity and vulnerability, which I could appreciate. The boxing scenes didnt look like anything like the way the real Ali fought and were a bit flat. And it took quite a while for the film to get going. But once it does. once it brings these four great men together, its very good.

The Shinning was shot in a different aspect ratio then it is presented on Amazon Prime. The image is stretched to fill the screen, which distorts the entire image. I wasted 3.99 for a rental. If youre a fan of Kubrick, this is completely unwatchable.
Im not always a horror fan. But Im a sucker for 80s style horror, which this movie nails! Its fast, fun, suspenseful, scary. Its really well done. Id watch this movie again in a heartbeat!

This a very well shot film, especially on what I assume was a modest budget. Its well directed, but the filmmaking is better than the writing. The story is about 75 minutes of meandering build to a not terribly interesting conclusion. Certainly this is a filmmaker to watch. But Id be more interested next time if either someone else wrote the script or if this director can evolve his storytelling skills. Not bad, but not a really satisfying movie, either.

Im not always a fan of horror. But then again, horror films are rarely this brilliant and well crafted. Ari Aster does an amazing job directing this film. The visuals, framing, the elegance of the filmmaking is up there with any film from last year. There is a ritualistic brutality to the film. hence the folk-horror genre. But the world Aster creates is so fascinating, I couldnt take my eyes from the screen. One of the best films of 2019!

Ive seen many films that centered around death row before, but none that got to me quite as strong as this one did. I cried more than once. Michael B. Jordan was good, but Jamie Foxx and Tim Blake Nelson gave the real stand out performances. Sometimes the dialogue was a bit obvious. But it was still a powerful film of social justice, made all the more relevant by recent events. I can strongly recommend this movie.
Such a fun, retro-movie. A great mystery-comedy-drama. The cast was stellar and Rian Johnson does a great job writing and directing. I thoroughly enjoyed it!

Every day the news is off the charts depressing. So a little light and joy is really needed right now. This movie delivers laughs, friendship, joy, love. and just made me incredibly happy! A group of outsiders coming together make this cafe feel a little like the 80s sit-com Cheers to me. A place that makes you feel at home and laugh at the same time. Though Turnover is more family-friendly. But still, that same welcoming vibe. Featuring a great cast and story, this a sweet film, very lovingly made.

I love Elton John, and I thought Taron Egerton was excellent playing him. But the film was hit and miss for me. Some of the production numbers of Eltons songs were great. Others felt flat. And though I admire the films honesty about Eltons drug problems, the movie focused on it so much, I just wished it could have spent more time on other aspects of his life. A decent film, but as a comparable, not as good to me as Bohemian Rhapsody.

I read about this two day shot film. Its a marvel it was done in that time frame. But even without that qualification, its a terrific film. A wonderful blend of sci-fi with comedydrama. Its vibe is feel good, heartfelt, but in a very sincere and affecting way. I love a movie like this that makes me care early on and holds me throughout. Just wonderful storytelling.

This is a super-suspenseful, interesting, disturbing film. And an excellent addition to the found footage genre. Its a film that will make you uncomfortable. But in a really good way. The acting was excellent and I wondered throughout who was telling the truth. or if like Kurasowas classic Rashomon, in no one was. The movie deals with the incredibly relevant subject of mental health. Its not an easy film to watch. But for the suspenseful ride and the points the film makes, its well worth it!

A really charming, sweet, funny movie. With every lead role filled by a terrific actor. I was charmed throughout, and laughing. My favorite line of the film: Do you know what we call arranged marriage in Pakistan? Marriage! Truly an enjoyable film.

Its not great. I love Anne Hathaway and Rebel Wilson. But they deserved a better, funnier script than this. I wish this could have been as good as Dirty Rotten Scoundrels. Sadly, it wasnt. Not as funny or as smart. An OK movie for a Sunday evening.

A sweet and charming film. Better than I expected it to be. A very good cast, especially Zoe Kazan. I can watch just about anything with her in it. For a Friday night in quarantine, it fit my mood perfectly!
Well done, emotionally resonant and believable film. Akwafina and the whole cast are terrific. I was involved throughout.

Almost all of Woody Allens best films are from the 70s, 80s and 90s. Blue Jasmine has a great cast especially Cate Blanchett in an Oscar winning performance and some really good moments. But the movie is artificial in many ways. And the story is so lifted from A Streetcar Named Desire I half expected Cate to utter, I have always relied on the kindness of strangers. Good but not great film.

Ill admit, the action and stunts were great. But the movie felt so LONG. They could taken out 30 minutes and I never would have missed it. Maybe the MI series has just gotten tired by this point. Ethan Hunt has been saving the world since the 90s, and I guess Im pretty over it.

I thought Id give a Clue another try, as I havent seen it since the 80s. I remember it being funny at times but very hit and miss. Thats still the case. Hey, there are a lot of great broad comedies from the 80s. Airplane, Stripes, Ghostbusters. the list goes on. This has a great cast. But its still a little over the top and not incredibly funny. Sorry.

A really good film that wonderfully brought to mind Denzel Washington and Devil in the Blue Dress. Intelligent, suspenseful and true to its times. Great cast and story, and set here in my hometown of L.A. This is a terrific period piece with authentic roots. Excellent!

A sweet, beautiful, positive film. In these ultra-gloomy times, I cant tell you how much I appreciated that! I got really emotionally involved. Truly cared about and cheered for the characters. And the singing was great, too. So glad I rented this!

Sports movies can be kind of cliche, but not that this one. Its real enough it feels like the filmmaker might have drawn it from life. But this was also really good filmmaking. Good writing, great twists. A really good cast. Some religious overtones, but they were more about faith. Not a preachy film, but an affecting one. This was way more than I expected. Terrific storytelling!

I dont know a ton about martial arts. But the love story in this film intrigued me. And Im always looking for movies with strong female characters. or with women who find their strength. Im so glad a took a shot with this film. It exceeded my expectations! The love story was even better and more unique than I expected. It was really affecting. Two battered and beaten people who find something in each other. And the martial arts was actually pretty great!

Just when I thought there was nothing new in the found footage genre, along comes She Walks The Woods. A new spin on a classic genre. The film is fun, creepy, well done and filled with genuine scares. Theres real tension in the methodical build of the story. Though its a horror film, it all feels very real and genuine. I wont give anything away, but I strongly recommend this movie!
I really tried to get into this. The animation technique is great. But after awhile I just couldnt get into the characters, the plot. It was so slow and uninspired.

Given this film is set in the world of late night comedy, I thought it would be more of a comedy. But its not that funny. Subsequently, I almost stopped watching it early on. But Im glad I didnt. Because what the film lacks in comedy, it makes up for as a drama about women in the almost exclusively male world of late night talk shows. The characters were better fleshed out than I expected. Emma Thompson, whom I love, is absolutely great. And though a side-bar in the film, her husband played by John Lithgow is a nice addition. I didnt love the film, but I did like it. Im really glad I stuck with it.
Still one of the funniest movies ever made. Ive seen the movie probably 10 times, know all the jokes, and I still laughed through the whole thing! I love Airplane!

A methodical, interesting and very intelligent film. The atmosphere and intellectual underpinnings are more important to the filmmaker than ceaseless action. If you crave that, great. Almost any super hero movie will do. This on the other hand is an insightful meditation on extremes in a time of civil war. If you want a film that will challenge your mind and your senses so beautifully shot then this is for you.

This is a movie filled with surprises. Its a small indie that through its energy and suspense, grows into something very large. And that suspense does build, slowly but surely, throughout the story. The drama gets really intense! The film just grabbed and held onto me throughout. Great direction, cinematography and acting. Just an excellent film!

Having a career is important. But what if you have that, but not love? A good question for a movie. This is a very relatable film. Funny, sometimes serious, always watchable. I liked the characters a lot. Good soundtrack, too! Just a very well made indie. Enjoy!

Matching the level of Season 1 was almost impossible, it was so good. But S2 of Fleabag comes close. Not quite the same sense of revelation this go around. But still a funny, sad, intelligent group of characters. And just very well written.

I really enjoyed this indie horror flick! Its not a big budget, special effects filled ride. This movie gets its scares from genuinely creepy and suspenseful moments. It brought back memories for me of summers playing ouija board with friends not something I recommend and reminded me a little of The Amityville Horror. Its a really well shot film and I was in suspense throughout. I definitely liked this one!

This is a very intelligent story about an important decision by one couple, and how that decision reverberates and effects their friends. Its not a movie filled with action or car chases, but a thoughtful meditation on long term relationships, marriage, friendship and life. Its subtle and involving and has almost a European filmmaking quality to it, which I loved! The film is filled with quiet insight and real, authentic moments. Its very well acted, written and directed. And as artful as it is, the story is very relatable. Really, just an excellent film!

Im not always a fan of horror. But when its done right, I can really get into it. This is horror, done right. Like The Blair Witch Project, which Char Man is definitely akin to. It has genuinely scary moments, but alternates with humor as well, which I really appreciated. Its of the found footage genre, with a little touch of a mockumentary vibe. It worked as a good, creepy horror film. Not cheap scares, like things jumping out at you all the time. but genuinely spine-tingling, creep-out scares. Oh, and as a resident of California? I particularly responded to the backdrop wild fires, as our fire season here is now about 7 months long. Really good, scary movie!

Beautiful Boy went beyond my expectations. It was so genuine. I think film critics really missed this film. It took us through terrain weve seen before in drug addiction movies. But it sucks you so deeply into the inevitable cycles of addiction that you cant tune out. Youre there, especially with the father, feeling like youre in a cycle you cant break. Great performances all around and well directed, too.

This is a film that will interest a lot of Americans like myself. A personal and true glimpse into a Muslim family in India, especially looking at one inspiring woman who wants to play cricket professionally. We still have some ways to go on inclusiveness in the Western world. But this documentary reminds us as hard as it can be at times for women in our culture, how much more challenging it can be in other parts of the world. But the woman at the center of this film is so optimistic, even when going against family tradition, its hard not to get involved with her story.This is a beautifully shot, heartfelt movie that anyone can find inspiring. I highly recommend it!
A wonderful blend of comedy and drama, with fantastic performances. It moves with great pace but never loses its humanity. Well done!

When you think of romance or relationships depicted in film, invariably cliches pop to mind. Boy meets girl, Jennifer Aniston-cuteness, inevitable bliss. To quote the film Annie Hall, If only life were like this.Elephants is about love, but it eschews such simplistic ideas and instead gives us a look at a relationship that feels authentic and lived in. Theres such a wonderfully complicated mix of emotions between the characters in this film. Thats the norm in life, but not in the movies. where we often go to avoid lifes pain rather than confront it. But Elephants doesnt shirk from that complex reality but embraces it. Which makes not just for good entertainment, but makes this film art. Something one rarely finds in film.Theres joy here, laughter. But also genuine sadness. And theres real craftsmanship to the filmmaking. Beautifully shot, well-acted, with great music. Writer-Director Alex Hanno is a sure hand behind the camera. With work like Elephants, we have a real artist to watch in the years ahead.Bravo to Elephants!

Great satire! Especially at taking on the male dominated, corporate top of that industry and skewering the hell out of it! Think Spinal Tap meets a modern Vinyl. with a healthy dollop of feminism that makes you want to cheer for the female characters in this world. The music is great in the film and the characters are memorable. You will absolutely believe the reality of the music industry as it is portrayed here, even as you laugh at it. A very smart and funny movie. I cant recommend it enough!

Really good crime-drama mix to this film. Very believable and realistic setting, tone, cast. It was hard hitting. Prostitution, drugs, pimps, violence. The movie doesnt let you in for an easy time, but its well worth the ride! Very good.

I laughed a lot watching this movie! At times I felt I shouldnt, given the dark subject matter. But the laughs came anyway. Its a funny, scheming, wonderfully wacky dark comedy. With touches of drama and surprising moments of tenderness. This film is just a pleasure. Enjoy!

A terrific character study focusing on a grieving mother and a young woman claiming to be Anne Frank. Its painful at times but also quite absorbing. A heartfelt drama told from a very unique angle. Very well written, directed and acted. A real work of art. Dont miss it!

A really good conspiracy thriller! Good action and suspense with an edge of your seat plot. After just a little while of watching I was hooked. And from there my interest never let up. A number of nice, early foreshadowing moments that pay off well done the storys road. A terrific cast with characters that really involve you. I truly enjoyed this!

Tons of great moments in this series. So many characters to love. And the setting is great! Marijuana is legal in California and this series rings true to its environment, in a comedic way.It was just terrific fun. I didnt want the series to end! I hope theres a Season 2. Strongly recommend!

Mid-life woes and relationships. Not an easy subject to get laughs from. But this film finds them. It also mines very genuine, thoughtful moments. and then can take enjoyable, surreal turns. A little bit of everything, but it all works! Its a diverse and really well done movie. I found myself laughing and yet relating to the characters. Definitely a film I would recommend.

This was more than I expected. Its a very fresh take on the Hans Christian Andersen story. It brought new life to a classic tale. The Little Mermaid as a burlesque dancer? I love it! This is not Disney but a complex, adult love story. The lead actress was omg beautiful. Check it out!

A great mix of science fiction and horror. The story has a wonderfully creepy tone. Underscored by the whole look of the film. Its a very intelligent movie. Sci-fi thats not about special effects but more about ideas. I like that! Definitely worth the watch.
Darkly funny at times. Its an anthology with a lot of diverse segments. Like a horror buffet. Eat up and enjoy!

Good film. It unfolds as a mystery, jumping back and forth in time. Its storytelling that involved me with a very stylized, cinematic style. Particularly nice use of mixed media. Its not always easy to watch but its worth it as the movie is quite haunting. Im generally not a fan of serial killer stuff. But this was so well done, I still have to recommend it. Pretty cool!
The digital code is expired and these discs won’t play in our blu ray player. It says they’re the wrong format.

If you have time for workouts that are over 30 minutes then this dvd will be a great addition to your routine. In both workouts there is a timer bar along the bottom of the screen so you know how much time is left. In the stepping strength workout there is also a small clock that shows up for the cardio intervals. I know some people don’t like having these features, but I like them. Especially the interval clock. If you need to modify and make things a little easier you can watch Debbie for modifications. I feel that both workouts are challenging without being too difficult. You can always use heavier weights if you want to increase the intensity. After doing both workouts I felt like I had exercised, but I wasn’t exhausted or super sore. If you don’t like floor work you don’t have to worry because there is none in either workout. There were some familiar moves from previous releases but there are a lot of new ones also. If you’re a fan of Jessica Smith then I’m pretty confident that you’ll like these and if you have never tried one of her DVDs then this would be a good one to try.

Even though I love yoga I normally don’t like routines that focus on just stretching. Whether it’s deep stretching or dynamic, usually after 5 minutes I get bored or my mind starts to wander off and I start thinking about things that I need to get done. For some reason I can’t explain, that doesn’t happen when I am doing yoga. I bought this DVD because Jessica’s stretching routines that were integrated into other DVDs weren’t as boring for me. To my surprise, I didn’t get bored and I stayed focused with all 3 routines. I enjoyed doing the dynamic stretch to get my body awake and moving. The deep stretch left me feeling really relaxed and calm. Total stretch is great for doing after a cardio or strength workout and kept me from feeling sore later. I can see myself using this DVD quite frequently.

I own most of Jessica Smith’s dvds, including Walk Strong 1 and 2 and this is my new favorite. The variety of workouts in this set is wonderful. The dvd that has 15 minute workouts is great for those days where you don’t have much time, or you don’t feel like doing a longer workout, but also to add on to another workout if you do have more time. The variety and number of workouts is what I like the most though. It keeps me from getting bored with this set. Before I purchased this set I had done the Walk Strong 1 and 2 again and timed it so that I would be finishing them up when I received this one. I was able to jump right into this one and I honestly feel this was the best one yet. I feel it is a progression from the previous sets, but some people will probably disagree with me on that. It’s just my personal opinion. After the eight weeks I do feel that my arms, legs and abdomen are more toned than they were before, even though I workout regularly and had just completed WS 1  2. I believe that you get out of a workout what you put into it, so if you really give this your all and do the drop set technique, there’s a good chance you’ll see a difference in strength and toning. I used 5, 8, 10 and 12 pound weights while doing this program. Also I increased my step from 1 riser to 2 about halfway through the program. Jessica also has a new calendar that is 6 weeks long and incorporates this set with her previous dvds that is free to download, so you can continue on after the 8 weeks and continue to utilize her previous releases. There are modifications shown to make the exercises easier or harder, but if you are new to exercising I would start with one of her other dvds first. Also if you have any medical issues you might want to check with your doctor or watch previews before purchasing as there is floor work, lunges and squats in these workouts. I got a lot out of this set and I’m glad I purchased it.

I really enjoy doing this DVD. Whenever possible I like to workout barefoot so this DVD is perfect for me. I like the energy of the cardio flow section. It gets my heart rate up to a decent rate and I feel energized for the rest of my day. The sole sculpt was fun to do. Its not like most strength workouts and I like that. I have plenty of DVDs with the traditional workouts that use weights, so I liked that this one was done barefoot and with light weights. To me it has a nice, flowing vibe to it that made the time go by quickly. The core stretch is done mostly on the floor and I like the unique moves that Jessica always seems to have for abs. I felt that it was pretty effective and its my favorite workout on the DVD. Cardio Dance Sculpt is just fun to do in my opinion. You use a chair for part of the routine and the time goes by quickly. Jessicas upbeat personality makes her workouts fun to do and Im always surprised at how quickly the time goes. Ive had workouts where I was constantly wondering how much longer until the end and I never feel like that when I do this DVD.

I wasnt sure what to expect when I bought this DVD and I was worried that I wouldnt like it. I have practiced yoga regularly for over 10 years, so I thought that it might not interest me, but since I like Jessicas other workouts so much I decided to try it. Im glad that I did get it. This isnt like Rodney Yee, Seane Corn, Shiva Rea, etc, so if that is your expectation then you wont like this DVD. This is however a nice, soothing DVD that has yoga poses to help you stretch your body. You wont be doing sun salutations or power yoga. I enjoyed the soothing and calm feel of both workouts. They are both good to help with increasing your flexibility and stretching your muscles. If you are looking for something that has a yoga feel, but isnt intense then I think this is a good option. Jessica does a good job explaining what to do and how to modify the poses so that they are comfortable for you. I am glad that I bought this and I will be using it regularly.

This set of workouts has variety which keeps it from getting boring. I dont find them to be difficult to do, but I still got sweaty doing them. You get out of a workout what you put into it. She shows different modifications so you can make it easier or harder depending on your fitness level or how you are feeling that day. I really enjoyed these workouts. Jessica has a great attitude that shines through and makes working out fun to do.

These may be strength workouts, but I definitely broke a sweat doing them. I can honestly say that I felt it in my muscles the next day. Jessica shows options for a more advanced move, while Debbie shows modifications to make it easier. As usual, Jessica keeps things fun and upbeat while delivering a great workout. Thats one of the reasons why I love doing her workouts.

When I first got this DVD, I thought the workouts would be pretty easy. Having done many of Jessicas workouts though, I shouldve known better. These are low-impact workouts, but you will get a lot out of them. Jessica shows you options for a more advanced move, while Debbie shows modifications for those who need an easier option. I love the workouts on this DVD because they are low-impact, but are very effective. I definitely felt it in my muscles after doing them. It was fun doing the workouts too, so the time flew by. Ill be getting a lot of use out of this one.

After years of doing advanced workouts and having an all or nothing approach to exercise, it was starting to take a toll on my knees. I needed to find something that still gave me a decent workout, but wouldnt kill my knees. I bought a couple of other Jessica Smith DVDs and really enjoyed them and felt that they were pretty good workouts and werent too hard on my knees. I decided to try some more of her DVDs and opted to get this set. Im finishing week 2 and have done all of the workouts and I have to say that I like it better than I thought I would. Theres a really great mix of strength, cardio and stretch in this plan. Since she included a chart to follow, you dont have to try and figure out which workout to do which day. When you finish the 6 weeks, if you go to her website she has another 6 week plan that you can print out. That plan has workouts from this set of DVDs and has suggested workouts from previously released ones that you can do as well, but even if you dont have those workouts you can use what you do have. I would have to say that this program is doable for anybody. There are modifications shown to make it easier or harder so you can tailor it to your needs. Im really glad that I bought this because I know itll get a lot of use.

This DVD has a great mix of toning and cardio. Jessica manages to keep your heartbeat elevated even while doing the toning portions. I love that I can create my own workout so that it doesnt get boring and I can make it fit into the time I have that day. Whenever I do one of her workouts Im always surprised at how fast the time goes by. She keeps them fun so you look forward to working out. This is a great DVD and I highly recommend it.
A better job was done by Albert Finney and Vanessa Redgrave.
This was not nearly as good as the book, which obviously written to be a small movie.
This is as silly as it is pretentious. The screenwriters dont seem to know, among other things, that Wittgenstein wrote a second book saying his first one got it all wrong.
It is not as good as Morse, but it is better than nothing. Faint praise, I know, but the best I can do for this formula-ridden series.
An absolute stinker. Everybody involved ought to be ashamed.
It had the reek of a stinker in the first couple of minutes.
Bruce Willis is good in anything, but this comes very close to cheesiness.

Same old same old. Insubordinate cop, black superior officers, the system yata yata yata. If youre going to get into content, Amazon, do something different. And hire some British actors who can do America accents. Our native thespians just cant cut it.
Farce is hard. Here is proof.
I dont think the Italians do comedy well. It would have been better if the film was just about the woman and they dumped the farcical husband figure.
We only lasted about five minutes.

I had the same problem with the series as with the book. The characters are wooden and unbelievable. I stopped reading the book half way through and knew enough after the first episode to stop the series. The British with their superlative actors, stately homes surrounded by beautiful scenery can make even mediocre material look good, but not this time.
Hi, very good transfer and top notch quality. I deducted one star for lack of captions.
Hi, not very historically accurate but an exciting adventure. Well made and well acted, its worth your time. Be aware it has violent and bloody scenes.
Hi, Wahlberg is awesome. He plays a great character and his rapid fire dialog is well done and interesting. 90 minutes was gone before I knew it.

Hi, weak script poor writing and unbelievable story lines. This is a fantasy but it still needs to be logically scripted. Its padded with fillers like characters gazing in the distance and music playing without dialog. I guess after 8 seasons they are finally running out of ideas. They need some new writers with new ideas.
Wow what a great show. A prequel to Breaking Bad but better.

Hi, one of the few shows that are getting better. A few interesting "cliff hangers" have me looking forward to next season. Peter Stomare is awesome as the crazy survivalist Chance Gilbert. Not to be missed.

Hi, first part was boring and the plot was somewhat uninspired. I guess the writers have run out of ideas. Bjorn goes to the Mediterranean then turns around and goes home. The first Seasons were very good and entertaining. Never noted for good acting or speech patterns, this Season was really bad. If you have watched the last 312 seasons, like me , you will probably want to see this. Just dont get too excited by the glowing reviews.
Hi the writers are running out of ideas. Im a big fan of this show but a King? and scavengers that talk with a strangled syntax, kind of like Yoda. I was disappointed and a little bored.

Hi, a wonderful and engaging series. Taking the series 1-4 as a whole a little too much on Native American spiritualism. The series has a few glaring technical mistakes. The ones Ive noticed are, there is no gun registration in Wyoming. You cant get finger prints from the DMV. The "rare" rifle that was used to commit a murder is readily available and the 45-70 caliber is quite popular. Maybe a little too "inside baseball" but maybe someone should go to Wyoming and talk to some one that actually has lives there. The series is filmed in New Mexico. People punch and kick the Deputies and Sheriff but never get arrested. People obstruct justice and hinder investigations with out any consequences ; I guess this is just poetic license. I still enjoy this series and liked Season 1. I purchased the rest and was not disappointed. These are priced right too.
This series just gets better and better. Unlike most series the writing is getting stronger. After 5 years its still fresh and interesting.

Hi, great topic but weak script. Doesnt mention Newton Knights being head of the militia nor his appointment as US Marshall. Glosses over the fact that he volunteered to serve in the CSA army. This was boring and disjointed in its telling.

Hi, Im not a historian nor do I play one on the internet. That being said this thing is wildly inaccurate. Its so inaccurate it actually distracts from the story. I especially liked the love affair between the rebel and the Generals wife, LOL. The founding founders were a bunch a rich crooks and grafters who just wanted to line their pockets ! ?,WOW. How they planed to make money fighting the richest most powerful empire in the world is the script writers Marxist fantasy. I wonder where the phrase "not worth a continental" came from. John Hancock told the Rhode Island delegate,"well buy all our saltpeter from Rhode Island." The Rhode Islanders would make more money selling to the British. I can live with this but I couldnt live with the boring story. I fell asleep twice.
Hi, Good film and interesting story. I thought that the story needed some editing as it was over long. It dragged in spots. Coupled with over acting I had to resort to fast foward.
Saw this fantastic movie 2x at the theatre and could not WAIT to own. Love that you get the BluRay DVD, the regular DVD AND the digital copy! Excellent product, fantastic movie!
Loved this series when it was on TV! Great humor and fun, wonderful cast. Always love to watch when I need a good laugh!

Extremely entertaining story of the lifelong feud resulting from competition for movie roles and oscars between Bette Davis and Joan Crawford. Not sure how much is taken from true facts, but it is a wonderfully entertaining mini series so well done I bought it! Both Jessica Lange and Susan Sarandon are superb and perfectly cast.

For anyone who grew up in the 70s, and wasnt on the Deans list, this film is a must see. Captures with pretty gritty realism, with allowances made for its general audience rating, the tenor of the times, particularly in the white middle class suburbs that sprang up from the white flight from city centers which were being decimated by liberal welfare policies, high taxation and crumbling infrastructure. The neighborhoods that resulted were themselves beset by changing cultural mores.It turned out that kids needed more than tree lined streets and good school districts to thrive; they needed structure, good parenting and a solid moral education, things which were often lacking in these affluent enclaves. The results were predictable. Indeed, one sees many of the same symptoms today, with the rampant drug use, delinquency and the feelings of pessimistic aimlessness which afflict many of todays middle class youth.Matt Dillon really shines as a natural actor, and this was to come to full fruition in the 1983 underappreciated masterpiece, Francis Ford Coppolas Rumble Fish, but as an early vehicle, while he was still learning, he is a strong screen presence and the glue which holds all the mayhem together.

Chaotic, yes, but This Is 40 delivers on the reality of living at the beginning of the 21st century, albeit from the pov of an upper middle class family. The laughs are deep belly laughs of recognition, as Apatows roving eye captures perfectly the spirit of the times we live in. As good as the script is, the film is really pushed forward by Leslie Manns exasperated character. In one of the finest performances Ive seen in a while, Ms Mann delivers the goods with this depiction of a woman trying to be a good wife, a good Mom, and a good lay - all the while struggling with the indignity of turning 40 and facing up to the fact that the people in her life do not always have her best interest at heart. It is a joy to watch her, and the reason I will be returning to this comedy again and again.

However, being a relative newcomer to Tarantino, I expected this film to follow in the tradition of the ones Ive seen so far in having great, quirky dialog punctuated periodically by violence. This movie reverses the formula, however, and we have here an almost non-stop carnival of gore which pauses periodically to propel the storyline forward with dialog which, IMHO, is not up to the the standards Id come to expect from QT.While the directors tongue is still kept snugly in his cheek throughout, and there are a great many paeans to films from the past, I felt the video game violence and comic book stick figures were not able to carry the moral weight of a revenge film like this. While the film was fun to watch, and the simple plot left lots of room for the hilarious diversions Tarantino is known for, I just felt a little less gore and a little more dialog would have created a happier balance.

One of the greatest films of the golden era of Hollywood was a religiouslythemed film about the private revelations of the Blessed Virgin toBernadette Soubirou, an illiterate peasant girl from the town of Lourdes inthe year 1858. It made a star of Jennifer Jones, and won her the Oscar thatyear. The film was nominated for Best Picture as well as 10 other Oscars,and won for best score Alfred Newman and cinematography as well.One of the intriguing things about the movie is how it came to be made. Thewriter, Franz Werfel was living in Germany with his wife, Alma the widow ofthe great composer Gustav Mahler when they had to escape to France toescape the nazi terror. Settling near Lourdes in the south of France in theshadow of the Pyrenees, they became acquainted with the miraculous springof Lourdes, where the Catholic faithful had been coming for nearly a hundredyears.Inspired by the faith and hospitality of the French peasantry who flocked tothe shrine, Werfel vowed to God to write about them if He saved the couplefrom annihilation. Though a Jew, Werfel was impressed by the humility andgoodness of the people among whom he had settled.Escaping finally to America, and settling in California, he set to work in1942 writing The Song of Bernadette. Upon publication, it was immediatelyrecognized by David O. Selznick of 20th Century Fox as a great property, andwas purchased for the rights to adapt it to the screen.One of the singular things about the film is how closely it hues to thebook, which was an historically accurate novelization of the phenomenon ofLourdes. It presents in stark terms the disbelief of the political,religious and scientific leaders of the day, and the grief they causedBernadette Soubirou and her family. Further, it presents Bernadettesvisions without explanation or judgement, and leaves it to the viewer tomake his own mind up about them.Made in 1943, at the height of WWII, when the world was in turmoil such asit had never been before, and faith in God was severely put to the test, fewfilms have been as appropriate to their time and place as this was. It isone of the greatest films of all time. It has recently been digitallyrestored on DVD, with commentary and other extras.

Eraserhead is filled with strange, uncanny scenes. What is it to be uncanny? Dictionary.com defines it as having or seeming to have a supernatural or inexplicable basis; beyond the ordinary or normal; mysterious; arousing superstitious fear or dread; uncomfortably strange. I would want to define it for this film as the quality of being familiar and strange at the same time. One has the sense of having never seen such weirdness and having vaguely remembered seeing it somewhere.The movie does not have a linear, logical storyline. It is a mood piece, for want of a better term. A visual poem, which depends on what the viewer brings to the interpretation as much as what appears on the screen. If you let your mind play among these images, it will begin to invent meaning for itself. You may be surprised and enlightened at what meanings you find in it.The cinematography is stunning, not beautiful in any traditional meaning of that term, but arresting: you simply cannot turn your head away.Will you like it? Well, I think this is one of those movies you either love or hate. Think of it as a Rorshach - how interesting you find it may just depend on how interesting you are!

I am a 41 year old man, and this is the best movie Ive everwatched. It is amazing because most of the movie is the moviea young lady invents inside her own mind to explain and subsumeher real life. In other words the images and speeches are allfiltered through her troubled mind, and any details of her reallife, aside from a few brief minutes in the film, must beinferred from the film-inside-her-head, which is most of themovie.That said, let me proceed with the explanation, as I think it isnot too hard to figure out. The chief problem in figuring outthe film, is deciding what is dreamfantasy sequence, and whatis real. Leaving aside the disturbing questions that Lynchraises about the illusory quality of life in general, I believethere is a definite part of the film that can be called real-lifeand another that can be called dreamfantasy.The first short sequence of the dancers is fantasy. The seconds-long scene which follows - the first-person camera going down tothe red pillow - is real, probably Diane Selwyn as she drifts offto sleep or death. The rest of the movie, up until the descentinto the secret box, is fantasy. The scenes and characters andlines are inventions of Diane Selwyn. Whether they are based onreal people, or are composites based on several people, or arecompletely unconscious formations is not revealed; we can onlyinfer.The next real life scene begins after the box thing, when shewakes up and lets in her ex-roommate to pick up her things. Shesoon descends into madnessfantasy again, with the hallucinatorysexual fantasy of Camille. In my opinion the hit man scene, andthe dinner party are hallucinations they are simply not logicalenough to be real life, and the real Diane Selwyn doesntreturn until the ominous knocks on the door propel her into themad despair which causes her to take her own life at the end.One of the more interesting things about the film is when in realtime the fantasy takes place. Is it a life-in-fantasy reviewas she lays dying, a haunting dream, or a premonition? I thinkLynch is telling us something very important about the illusoryquality of our lives, and how life imitates art in very importantrespects.Thank you for reading this review.
