This is an amazing movie that tells its inspiring story with a restrained and thoughtful hand. The telling details bring home the harsh impact of the the segregated south through the story of one brilliant black woman. It is deserving of all the praise it has received. Share this with young people in your family. It is a story everyone should know.

This is a classic film. It is by turns touching, funny, heart wrenching and beautiful. I had seen it years ago and am delighted to report that it holds up well. The filming is breathtaking and the actors create honest, touching characters in this coming of age film. It brings depth, humor and truth to the story a young men coming of age. Timeless.

I loved this show. It reminded me of when we were raising our two sons. Like many series, it went downhill later in the run, but the first ones are still a joy to watch. It is a lovely, family friendly but realistic. look at a typical family. Lots of fun and many touching moments.

This is not a perfect movie, but there is plenty to enjoy along the way, including some fine acting turns and lovely scenery. The ending rather falls down. It story just stops, rather like they ran out of money andor time to do a good edit and closing. But I really enjoyed the overall tone of the film. It had some fine moments.

I bought this movie because Nick Hornby wrote the screen play. His script is of the high standard that his fans have come to expect. The story follows a young Irish woman who, like so many before her, travels to the States to find work and a future. The film is quiet, heartfelt, funny and touching. In the end, you will care a good deal about these characters and the decisions they have to make. Life is never easy, but it can be joyful.

This is a a charming and well made movie about growing older, and growing up. De Niro dos a fine job as always. This is one of those "small movies" that gives the actors a chance to remind us just who talented they are. The cast takes a rather slim plot and turns it into a fine movie indeed.

I flat out loved this movie. Set in the 1950s, it plunges the viewer into the cold war story of a lawyer trying to win the release of a U.S. pilot spy plane pilot shot down over the U.S.S.R. Tom Hanks does an amazing job as the lawyer charged with the task. I am not usually one for "spy movies" but this story of moral, and physical, courage will keep you holding your breath right to the last moment. An excellent cast and script carry the day. Well done on all fronts.

This is a brilliant movie. I couldnt imagine how anyone could translate Richard Russos complex novel of manhood and failed dreams into a movie. I was proved wrong by this excellent adaptation. Set in a fading, blue collar town, Paul Newman and the rest of the talented actors in the cast captured the spirit and mood of the book. The film is by turns, dark, funny, touching and painful, just like most real lives. I had read the book and my husband had not. We both enjoyed the movie. It is clearly a story that Mr. Newman and the rest of the cast wanted to make. The resulting film is well worth watching and will prompt discussion afterward. I am sure we well watch it again.

This is an engaging film with an excellent cast. A displaced family from India opens a restaurant in a small French town, a cultural and culinary war breaks out. Throw in a bit of romance, an exceptionally gifted chef and the plot thickens. The talented actors in this film bring touching life and depth to the story. Well done.

This is an amazing movie. The plot is a bit magical, the actors are gifted and it is a joy to watch. Funny, touching and original, this is a film you will want to return to. By turns funny and heartbreaking, with more than a bit of magic thrown in, it is an engaging, well acted story of two grumpy and rather mysterious old men seen through the eyes of a lonely young boy left in their care. And, in the end it is a deeply felt story of coming of age and growing old on your own terms. Watch it, and then, watch it again. It is that good.

The plot seems a little disjointed and of course, a bit dated for modern viewers. I assume that it would be of interest to students of film. All that said, I was rather charmed by its slightly old school look and feel.

This is a long running series in the U.K. and it well deserves its success. The writing and character development are spot on. The basic story line centers around a team of retired police detectives some less willingly retired than others. who are brought back to work on old cases and some new ones as well. They are led by a once rising officer, who had her career stalled by a very unfortunate incident involving a dog. This assignment is both her punishment, and her chance to work her way back to the fast track. No one does mystery series better than the Brits, and this is a good example of why.

I discovered this series when traveling in the UK, and am pleased that is now available in the U.S. The series involves a group of unwillingly retired police detectives, who are brought back to look into old, unsolved cases. They are under the leadership of a once rising police officer, whose career has been derailed by a rather horrible misstep. It is great fun to watch the characters past unfold from episode to episode. I look forward to watching every episode.

This is such a funny vintage BBC show. It centers around a young couple who decide to chuck their careers and go back to living off the earth. Unfortunately for their neighbors, they decide to do it right in their lovely suburban home. Both couples try to maintain their friendship, but it gets put to the test on a regular basis. It is a light, funny look at British class distinctions, and changing times.

This series takes a different spin on detective shows. The squad is a group of retired detectives, each with their own quirks and issues. They are led by a once rising younger detective who is trying to restore her career after a huge blot on her record. It is so funny in a dry, British way, and the crimes they investigate and solve are well done. I ran into this show in the UK, and am happy to have the shows to enjoy here in the States.

Like many low-star reviewers I found this series difficult to watch in the first several episodes even though I love atmospheric, slow-paced mysteries. The characters were not people I would root for, but more than that, the pace was very, very, slow, such that most of the time nothing seemed to be happening. The last episode however reveals the truth behind all of the hints, secrets, tensions and cross-currents. So, I had been thinking three stars or lower throughout the first four episodes, and then felt more in the five-star area on the last two.
There are many reviews discussing in detail why this is such a compelling series. I cant wait for more, and I wish there were many others of this caliber.

While this movie could be considered a royal romance it does have other elements which I enjoyed. The relationship between Esther and her uncle Mordecai is beautiful and every time Mordecai speaks it is like poetry. The fact that Esther trusts Mordecai to pick out her future husband is probably true for the times but shows how much value she puts in Mordecais opinion. He only wants the best for her. So when she is chosen to present herself to the king as a future possible queen we know this is going to be an interesting decision. I thought Joel Smallbone was an excellent king. He had a majestic air about him and made his proclamations with conviction. Jen Lilley is a favorite Hallmark actress and she plays her part so wonderfully in this meaningful movie. Esther was one of historys bravest women and she must decide if she is willing to risk her life to save her people.~The Rebecca Review

From the lows of despair to the heights of joy, Kelsey Grammer definitely is the best Ebenezer Scrooge in movie land. I was amazed at his performance and his spiritual transformation from grumpy and horrid to happy and appreciative of life was a wonder to behold.I am a fan of Patrick Stewarts version of this movie and had never imagined a musical version at all. Until I found this movie the other day I did not know it existed. The only thing Id say is that there is a little swearing so it might not be appropriate for young viewers, but it aptly portrays Scrooge in the worst possible light.What I also thought while viewing is this has more horror elements than most versions. They really play up those aspects, especially the ghosts. The scenes in the graveyard are quite scary but not too much.I also thought Jane Krakowski as the ghost of Christmas past lent some beauty to the film I had not otherwise seen in other versions. Her gown is just gorgeous and they make sure to keep a fan blowing on her dress as it seems she is constantly in a breezy state even while standing in indoor scenes.What this really is is a little bit of horror and a lot of singing and dancing. Id call it a bit of an extravaganza to be honest. At times this movie is boisterous and busy and at times deeply thoughtful. I thought it was very well done even though I could have done without the occasional swearing. It was at least part of the character development. And the ending is magnificent. Better than Ive ever seen.To be honest I was a bit grumpy myself the past few days but after I saw this movie I totally got back into the Christmas spirit. I think it changed my heart just that little bit and that is what counts.~The Rebecca Review

A Charlie Brown Christmas is at first pensive with scenes of snowfall. Christmas is not making Charlie Brown happy, in fact to me he seems a little depressed. Snoopy of course meanwhile steals the show by decorating his dog house.Some of the kids say really mean things to Charlie Brown which doesnt help his mood. The whole story line leads up to the moment where everyone finds out the real meaning of Christmas.Probably this is the highest rated Christmas special because everyone is really like Charlie Brown who is seeking deeper meaning in life.My husband remembers seeing this when he was only two years old and has seen it so many times since. This was probably the second time Ive seen this and the first time I got myself a copy. I just love seeing Snoopy jumping around being his happy dog self. You gotta love that! Merry Christmas!~The Rebecca Review

If you are looking for a Christmas concert with all your favorite music and Andrea Bocelli singing his heart out with an orchestra, several choirs and David Foster on piano, this will absolutely delight you. The stage is beautiful with frosted Christmas trees and special lighting effects and then the stage keeps changing keeping things very interesting throughout.This has serious songs and humorous songs that will make you laugh. The witty banter between Andrea Bocelli and David Foster keep you entertained while waiting for the next song. Andrea even plays the piano while singing the most famous song in Italy. Whether hes singing in Italian, English or French, listening to his voice is a spectacular experience that may make you feel a little misty eyed because of the beauty. I admit he made me cry a few times.To top it all off there is even a fireplace while singing The Christmas Song with Natalie Cole. Reba McEntire is perfect singing Blue Christmas and Mary J. Blige adds a lot of soul to What Child Is This? I had never heard Katherine Jenkins before but she sings like an angel. When singing with The Muppets, Miss Piggy looks on adoringly as Andrea sings. It was the cutest!Many of these songs will make you feel nostalgic, especially Silent Night sung in Italian and English. The powdery blue lights made everything look so peaceful and calm.This was filmed at the formerly named Kodak Theatre in Los Angeles, California. To be honest this was quite the production! The last song White Christmas even had snow falling on the stage. It was just magical.In the extras, Andrea Bocelli also has many profound and beautiful things to say about the music of Christmas. His singing in this special really does unite us all in the wonder that is Christmas. I recommend watching this every year as a Christmas tradition. I definitely will be doing so now that I have discovered this concert.~The Rebecca Review

Rarely have I laughed with delight so many times while watching a movie. The comedic timing, the fascinating smart Siamese cat and the brilliant actors and actresses make this the most memorable movie Ive recently seen.No I did not see this as a child because at that time I was living in Africa. My husband remembered when this first was shown! Years later it is still witty, relevant, entertaining and cute. As far as cats go, D.C. is a miracle. Each night he prowls around his neighborhood getting into mischief. One night he arrives home with a wristwatch around his neck instead of a collar. Patti Hayley Mills figures out that someone has written the start of Help on the back. This leads her to get in contact with FBI Agent Kelso Dean Jones who spends his nights figuring out where D.C. is going so they can solve the case.What I loved so much about this Siamese cat is he has that cute cross eyed trait. Hes an adorable cat. I think humans of any age can enjoy this movie. I would however say it is more rated PG these days. Some moments are however hilarious. I think you will laugh out loud if you love cats. Or if you remember this movie from your childhood you will go down a trip to memory lane. Im so happy to finally have this in my movie collection. Well worth owning to watch again and again!~The Rebecca Review

Usually Hallmark movies have great happy endings, Ive never seen an ending that was sad. However I have to ask myself why Im not happy about the ending in this one? It seems romantic for childhood sweethearts to get back together as adults. That seemed realistic. But when a man has made a commitment to marry a woman can you trust him when he changes his mind in a few days? Will he change his mind again after marrying the new woman? Metcalfe and Reeser are great actors but I just did not feel like the movie was totally realistic. It is definitely a fantasy written by a hopeless romantic. Who wants a guy who just got rid of his woman? Doesnt he need some time to change gears? Well at least two people get what they want. That is all that counts in this movie. The woman he was supposed to marry seemed nice enough although very ambitious. I personally enjoyed seeing all the horses, that was great. :~The Rebecca ReviewP.S. One of my good friends says this movie pushes my buttons. I figured out it was because a man who had given me a promise ring decided he did not want to marry me after all. I forgive him, but I guess I have yet to forget!

If you like your walking workouts fast paced and intense you will probably like these. Ive done a lot of Jessica Smith workouts before and never had so much trouble keeping up with her. Literally she is a blur on the screen while you are trying to keep up. Since Im over 50 I find these very speedy and just cant seem to do them at such a fast pace. I love Jessica Smith but I wish shed make some workout DVDs for us over 50 crowd. A little less energizer bunny please! I can do one of the workouts on this DVD set if I modify it throughout. It would just be nice to actually be able to follow along at a normal pace. So youve been warned if you are over 50 and not in total top shape.~The Rebecca Review

You will laugh, you will smile, you will be so enthralled with this version of Pride and Prejudice. Ive seen four versions and this is the most romantic and has the most wonderful flirting between Darcy and Elizabeth.Greer Garson and Laurence Olivier really had the best onscreen chemistry Ive ever seen. Greer Garson positively sparkles and Laurence Olivier is truly chivalrous in this part. But what I loved most about this movie is the scene between Darcy and his Aunt when the Aunt has just finished talking to Elizabeth. This is now my favorite black-and-white movie Ive ever seen. The sisters are all delightful and the mother is the most likeable. The father is charming too.It took me two days to watch this since it is so long but it was worth the effort. So if you are a fan of Jane Austen adaptations, this is a must see because it is the most romantic and emotionally fulfilling version. Id go all out and say you will just be totally charmed by this movie. It is a true classic and worth collecting. Witty repartee included!~The Rebecca Review

Annie and Ben are young and in love when they run away to get married without Annies fathers permission. They think they are going to New York because Ben has a good job offer. Little does he know his plans are going to be ruined because Annies father catches them at the church before they can get too far. However they have already been married. So Ben agrees to an annulment because he thinks it is best for Annie. After thinking their marriage is over they wind up in relationships with other people and are well on their way to each getting married again. Only one problem! They discover they are still married to each other. What to do? This is a predictable movie but you cant help loving it every step of the way. I thought this was the best movie ending Ive ever seen. True Love does Win in the End! Its a happily ever after that makes you feel good and right. Im happy I watched this and will enjoy watching it again! Definitely one of the classic Hallmark movies you want to own.~The Rebecca Review

Laurel is extremely talented as a fashion designer who is looking for a change of pace. When she realizes she could have a full-time job as a personal assistant she jumps into the game and starts to work for Danny who is down on his luck with a minor football injury. Danny isnt so sure it is going to work out, but decides to give Laurel a chance.As his personal assistant, Laurel has to learn a lot quickly, plan schedules and even decorate for special occasions. This movie has plenty of surprises and is humorous and quirky. You will laugh a lot! With the football theme this is a movie guys will love and women will adore! My husband and I agree that Tyler Hynes delivers the funniest lines in any Hallmark movie weve ever seen. The laughs just kept coming and his witty comments made his character David alive and interesting. Ive never heard any man utter such romantic lines in a movie and he sounded so compassionate and genuine.Erin Krakow as Elizabeth is so beautiful in this movie and her heart is so open and profoundly intimate. You can literally see her falling in love with David - it looks so real! That is great acting when you are so immersed in the story you forget you are watching a movie!This movie has two love stories going at the same time and you will be very happy with both endings. The scenes are all cozy and the dreary weather makes it all so nice to have a fireplace and some warm coffee.Some of the dancing at the parties by the other actors was a bit silly, but when David and Elizabeth slow dance there is sure chemistry that sizzles. One of my favorite Tyler Hynes movies for sure. I think hes my favorite Canadian actor. You will laugh and even feel like crying a little. Great acting, the best Ive ever seen!~The Rebecca Review

When a woman in the 1800s writes a letter to her imagined love she has no idea that way into the future a man will find her letter in her antique desk. It is too much to hope for, that this man will mail a letter and it will travel into the past, but it happens nonetheless.This movie made me think that if two people are supposed to meet, they will no matter the obstacles. In this captivating romantic drama there is time travel and period romance.If youve ever refinished a desk you will even relate to this story more. The hidden letter adds a thrill of suspense and mystery.What I loved about this movie was the antique furniture, the velvet sofas and the magical gardens. This movie also effectively captures the emotions and takes you on a romantic journey to a happy ending which is surprising to say the least.I enjoyed this and will watch it often. I love the romance and the actors have great onscreen chemistry. There are about two kisses in this movie at the start and middle and unlike most Hallmark movies, no kiss at the end! But you will in no doubt agree that the ending is perfect.~The Rebecca Review

When I first heard about the Chocolate Chip Cookie Murder Mystery I thought someone was going to be killed by eating a poisoned cookie. Not what happened, even though they made it look that way. The Baker, Hannah, in this series is actually more of the detective Mikes go-to-girl for extra information on all the suspects. She is great about finding details even the police officers miss. Sometimes her curiosity is what solves the case.If you love movies and TV shows that have a lot of cooking or delicious foods displayed you will love the two bakeries in one of these shows. Make sure youve baked some brownies or have a nice plate of cookies before watching! Chocolate truffles are optional. :The 2 DVD set includes all 5 movies. The first disc is double sided however only labeled on one side. Turn it over and movie 5 is on the other side. Movie one is on the first side that is labeled. Then the second DVD has the three middle movies.If you are considering getting the whole series of shows, this is the DVD set to get. I first got just the cookie murder one and loved it. Then I found out there were four more shows. So got this.What I enjoyed about these shows was how funny Hannahs mother is. She is always up to something and a lot of the time she knows the killer.The whole trick with all these shows is figuring out who is going to end up with Hannah. She has chemistry with Mike and one spectacular kiss but with Norman she mostly acts like friends and he helps he solve some mysteries. I wont say who I was voting for the whole time but I got my wish. She ends up with the right guy!The order to watch these is as follows:A Chocolate Chip Cookie Mystery - Did a guy die from the cookies in his truck or was he shot?A Plum Pudding Mystery - Ideas for how to make pudding without plums.A Peach Cobbler Mystery - a completely unexpected ending. A little dancing and drinking champagne.A Deadly Recipe - a nice moment of forgiveness between two people.Just Desserts - this one gets a bit scary as Hanna is targeted and gets hurt.These stories increase in scariness as they progress. Most of the murders are done with guns, but the last spontaneous murder in Just Desserts was a little more creative.Either way all the movies present the opportunity to figure out who the killer is and many times it is really obvious if you are paying attention to facial expressions and attitudes. People in these shows do not hide their guilt as well as you think they would.Did I mention that Mike also looks great in a uniform. Norman gets his chance to be an assistant coach for a basketball team which made him seem very manly. Near the end it was difficult to know which guy was going to get the girl.Im looking forward to seeing other mystery shows with Alison Sweeney in them.~The Rebecca Review

Alison Sweeney is the perfect actress for playing the part of a baker who likes solving mysteries as much as she likes creating new recipes. This is an adorable mystery with lots of baking.Before watching this I made chocolate chip cookies for my husband. I thought someone was going to die from eating poisoned chocolate chip cookies. Not! They do make it look that way however.So we watched the movie for New Years Eve. I found it very entertaining because it had so many characters who I definitely suspected were the murderer. I was wrong in the end even though the murderer is introduced earlier in the movie. I thought it was probably one of the guys who was just far too nice. You will think it is him too just by a look he gives that is very deceptive.Anyways, my husband thought the ending was a little cheesy but I thought it was cute. With two men competing for a womans attention you are wondering who she will end up with. This is the first Hallmark movie Ive watched that did not have a kiss at the end! But the ending is a nice surprise and left me laughing. I now want to watch more of these book adaptations.~The Rebecca Review

The Kendrick Brothers know how to make movies that cause you to wake up spiritually while really solving tough life issues everyone deals with. In these five movies you will meet characters who are struggling and see how they solve their problems with real-world solutions.One of the things I noticed a lot is the topic of forgiveness and how it changes lives. These movies also have humorous moments that will make you laugh out loud with delight. Fireproof while mostly serious has three of the funniest moments Ive ever seen in any movie.What you will notice about the men in these movies is how they fight for their marriages in the end. The men start off really flawed and transform spiritually into the type of men women can really respect.War Room is amazing in that so much can go wrong and you think nothing will work. Then a miracle happens between two people who are drifting far from each other.Courageous is about a group of men who support one another through thick and thin and make a commitment to be the best fathers and husbands they can be.Facing Giants is more about football and how a team changes their attitude and has great success when they give their lives to God.Flywheel has two really funny guys in it and a miracle occurs when a used car salesman decides to deal honestly with the public.Fireproof is about a couple headed for divorce and what the husband does to save the marriage. It is truly amazing what can happen when people turn their lives around spiritually.I cant think of five better movies for guys to watch with their wives. These are stunning in their portrayal of men who become leaders in their family and do the right thing. I personally am humbled by these movies to be honest. I just think anyone who watches these will learn how to live life more victoriously and with more commitment to God. These movies especially show how a soul submitted to God can have great success in life and love.~The Rebecca Review

If you are looking for a highly entertaining story about two women who get what they deserve, this movie may interest you. It is not rated but Id say it was PG 13. There is one swear word hell but otherwise it is very much like a Jane Austen movie. Id go as far as to say it is like a mean girls meets Jane Austen. There is enough tension and intrigue to keep you watching right up to the last moments. And what a satisfying ending it really is! The horse race is also very exciting. Watching a woman compete with men is part of the thrill of this story.~The Rebecca Review

I was first introduced to the music of Rodgers and Hammersteins Cinderella while watching the Disney version with Brandy and Whitney Houston. This musical Cinderella has all the same music but was made for TV with quaint sets and a few special effects.Lesley Ann Warren was a very optimistic, kind, sweet and dreamy Cinderella. Stuart Damon made a very thoughtful prince. This DVD has chapters so you can watch your favorite songs and when Lesley and Stuart are singing to each other it is just magical.So watching this DVD is a bit like watching a stage production. The moonlit set is very well done and captures the romance of the moments.As someone who is trying to watch all the Cinderella musicals, I must say this one is worth viewing to see how other musicals evolved from this one.~The Rebecca Review

The Adventures of Robin Hood is my favorite Errol Flynn movie as he is an absolute joy to behold. His laugh, his mischievous spirit and his talent at archery makes this movie a real adventure with lots of humor. Olivia de Havilland adds in a touch of romance and beauty.This movie is almost a romantic comedy at times and the witty banter is very enjoyable to listen to no matter who Robin Hood is talking to. The plot elements are great and the story moves along at a rapid pace leaving you waiting for even more adventure. You just cant imagine how Robin Hood is going to escape again and again! The fact that he stands up for the hurting and oppressed is impressive.The other movie I enjoy watching that has Errol Flynn and Olivia de Havilland in is The Private Lives of Elizabeth and Essex. I have only seen two Errol Flynn movies so far but he had acting abilities far beyond what most have today. He just comes across as really genuine and clever. The fact that he was so handsome is just a bonus.Reviewing this movie is not a recommendation of other movies and extras featured on this DVD. I have not seen them all!Enjoy!~The Rebecca Review

I Still Believe is a deeply meaningful, emotionally intense and beautifully spiritual journey of love, loss and hope. Miracles happen, but as in any life there are struggles and disappointments.This movie is about two people in love who have to face the ultimate challenge. The story will move you to tears because you really care about the main characters and what they have to go through.Jeremy Camp showed such sacrificial love at a young age and Melissa demonstrated spiritual faith and patient endurance. So this is a dramatic story with an unexpected ending.The acting is stellar and the songs are amazing. Ive heard most of the songs in this movie on KLOVE and yet they never affected me as deeply as in this movie with all their meanings revealed!The only thing I wondered about was why this Christian college seemed to allow men and women to be in each others dorms - no one in the movie goes into anyones room however. That was not how it worked at my Christian college - men and women had their own dorms and rules.~The Rebecca Review

Is your body feeling the stress of life? Are you stiff in your spine and have started to notice mobility issues after 50? Sometimes it feels as if you want to do more stretching along with strengthening exercises. This 2 DVD set has one workout that is mostly stretching with some strengthening for the abs and one workout that is a full-body routine with hand weights. Both workouts require a chair.Stretching Workout 44 minutesAnne Pringle Burnells gentle, calming instruction is just what you need to melt away stress, help you feel more creative and increase your mobility and flexibility. The movements are fluid with a few static stretches, but plenty of reaching your hands above your head to get the blood flowing.Some of the stretches in the first workout feel so good if you have an inflexible spine. Not all the exercises are easy at the beginning so there are a few challenges. What you will notice right after you do the stretching routine is how straight you are standing and how your posture has improved.Strengthening Workout 51 minutesThis requires a small hand weight or you can use a can of soup. There is a warm-up, aerobics section, weight section and balancing with a chair for support.Most of the exercises with weights are done for 8-10 reps. There is swimming, toe tapping and neck stretching too as well as stretches for the whole body. This workout presents quite a few coordination challenges in the aerobics section by having you move your legs and arms at the same time in different ways. It is amazing how much you can do while sitting!The last part of the workout is done standing in front or behind the chair and includes some gentle squats.The original music and unique exercises makes these routines a pleasure to do. Id recommend these for adults of any age, but especially for those over 50 who are starting to feel their age. After doing both workouts I felt stronger, more stable, walked with more purpose and felt my posture really improve. Plus my back felt great and flexible again. I will definitely look for other workouts by this instructor. She has a great fun personality and a soothing voice.~The Rebecca Review

This movie has long been a favorite of mine and Im happy to finally have my own copy. The DVD is double sided so you do have to turn it over to see the rest of the movie. Annes antics are all very funny and I laughed and laughed so much during this movie. There are also some sad moments but mostly this movie has scenes of loving interactions between the characters.
